chapters.title: Chapter 1801: Beast Race Facing Danger
paragraphs: When she arrived at the fifth ground floor, Gongsun Zhilan froze in her spot; her eyes were wide open, and her mouth fell open. Her eyes rippled due to shock and excitement, watching Zhang Fei single-handedly hunt down the mindless demons on the floor.

Gongsun Zhilan herself was a demon god, but she had no confidence that she could attack all the mindless demons on that floor at the same time. Yet, Zhang Fei could unleash multiple attacks that covered the entire area of the floor at once, allowing him to kill all his enemies in one fell swoop.

Furthermore, Zhang Fei used almost all of his elements, except void and darkness elements, which were simply unbelievable. Gongsun Zhilan rubbed her eyes several times to make sure she didn’t see wrongly. "Fire, light, wind, ice, water, lightning, wood, and metal elements!"
"Why are you here?" Yuan Xiajie’s question woke Gongsun Zhilan from her awe. "Are you here specifically to watch Zhang Fei?"

"Humph!" Gongsun Zhilan snorted as she thought Yuan Xiajie was not on her level, so she was too lazy to talk to her. She looked at Mo Cangyue, raised her eyebrows, and thought about capturing her. However, she suddenly heard Zhang Fei’s voice in her mind, which prohibited her from making a move against the young female demon. "Tch! I’m a demon god, but he always orders me as he pleases!"

Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue almost laughed when they heard Gongsun Zhilan’s anger. Zhang Fei had already told them about his actions against her, and she was under his control now, even though he didn’t enslave her.

"Hmm?" Hearing the sound of two steps coming down, Gongsun Zhilan turned around. Her gaze was filled with longing and infatuation when she saw Mo Qingwen, but she was furious when she saw Gu Yanshu walking beside him while hugging his arm.
Additionally, Gu Yanshu had already swallowed Zhang Fei’s two beauty pills, and she became prettier and sexier compared to their last meeting, which fueled Gongsun Zhilan’s jealousy.

A mere thought flashed through Gongsun Zhilan’s mind, and she was certain that Zhang Fei was helping Gu Yanshu enhance her appeal. ’Tch! He knows I hate this woman, and he helps her for that, yet he doesn’t help me.’
Gu Yanshu’s lips curled up, smiling mockingly at Gongsun Zhilan. "Long time no see, Zhilan. Your face has become more beautiful than our last meeting."
Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue exchanged glances, laughing in their hearts. The two women had hated each other for tens so many years, and Gu Yanshu’s change inflamed Gongsun Zhilan’s anger even more.

Tang Zhiyao, who was hiding in a corner of the floor, also laughed as she listened to Gu Yanshu’s provocation towards Gongsun Zhilan. She herself felt jealous of the woman, and she was sure that Zhang Fei was helping her enhance her beauty.
’This bitch!’ Gu Yanshu’s open ridicule caused Gongsun Zhilan’s face to turn red with anger, and many black lines appeared on her forehead.
Mo Qingwen glanced at his wife before asking Gongsun Zhilan, "Did you come here to meet Zhang Fei too, Zhilan?"
"Tch!" Gongsun Zhilan’s chest heaved with anger. "I—"
Zhang Fei suddenly moved next to Gongsun Zhilan, hugged her waist, and pulled her into his embrace. He looked at Mo Qingwen and asked. "What brought you here?"
Gongsun Zhilan wanted to free herself from Zhang Fei, but her body suddenly couldn’t move, and neither would her voice. ’What happened to me? Why can’t I speak or move?’
Gongsun Zhilan still didn’t realize that Zhang Fei had already duplicated her soul, and he merged her duplicated soul with his, giving him full control over her.
Mo Qingwen extended his hand to Zhang Fei. "At least, let’s have a proper introduction first. You must already know my identity. I am Mo Qingwen, the ruler of this domain."
"Zhang Fei, the leader of the Moonlit Passion Temple." Zhang Fei shook Mo Qingwen’s hand for a moment. "My sect is in the Paradise Realm, so you’ve never heard of it."

Mo Qingwen nodded in understanding. "I know you did what you did to Yan Washeng and Gongsun Zhilan for your own personal gain, but your actions also indirectly helped me, so I came here to meet you and thank you."
Gongsun Zhilan clenched her teeth; she was really frustrated with her situation, and she was really eager to bite Zhang Fei to death.

"If you want to thank me, you can help me look for those demon materials to upgrade demon ranks." Zhang Fei didn’t want to have too close a relationship with Mo Qingwen, but he would never waste an opportunity that presented itself to him. "I have dozens of demon wives, and their demon ranks have been stuck in the Empress Rank for a long time, so I want to help them upgrade theirs."
Mo Qingwen had already heard about Zhang Fei’s situation from his wife, so he knew he needed a lot of those materials. "Is that all you need from me?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "All my wives are an important part of my life, and I already have everything you have. Thus, I don’t need anything else from you, and I only need those materials."

"Alright." Mo Qingwen turned to his wife. "You should return to the fourth floor, wife. Gongsun Zhilan and I are enough to help him, so you can help all his wives look for those materials on the fourth floor."
Gu Yanshu nodded in agreement with her husband; she cast a side glance at Gongsun Zhilan before walking up to the fourth floor.
Mo Qingwen looked at Gongsun Zhilan, who looked angry and frustrated. "What are your plans for her?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei grabbed Gongsun Zhilan’s face and kissed her lips in front of Mo Qingwen, which infuriated and embarrassed her.
Gongsun Zhilan wanted to strangle Zhang Fei to death for kissing her in front of Mo Qingwen, but she was powerless to refuse him because her body couldn’t move.
Mo Qingwen smiled at Zhang Fei’s boldness, but he was overjoyed to see them kiss, and he was sure that Gongsun Zhilan would never bother him again after this.
Yuan Xiajie was no longer surprised by Zhang Fei’s rogue behavior, but Mo Cangyue was different from her, and there was a glimmer of jealousy when she saw them kissing.

Despite her initial reluctance, Gongsun Zhilan slowly began to enjoy her kiss with Zhang Fei. She immediately wrapped her arms around his neck as soon as he released her, even more so when he groped and fondled her breasts, giving her a jolt of pleasure. ’Sigh! To hell with Mo Qingwen! I just want to enjoy my kiss with this brat!’

In hiding, Tang Zhiyao laughed to herself when she saw Gongsun Zhilan enjoying her kiss with Zhang Fei. She was sure that the venomous demon god would fall to him soon. ’If Hua Qianmei were here, she would definitely laugh with satisfaction.’

After a few minutes, Zhang Fei broke off their kiss, and Gongsun Zhilan buried her embarrassed face into his chest like a bashful rabbit, biting him there. Hi ignored her and asked Mo Qingwen. "Hahaha! With this, you should already know my plans for her, right?"
"Yes," Mo Qingwen nodded with a smile. "This way, I won’t have to worry anymore, and my family’s life will be peaceful again."
Gongsun Zhilan glanced at Mo Qingwen and inwardly scoffed. ’Humph! I will never stop chasing you, and I will snatch you from your wife one day!’

’Do you think I would allow that?’ Gongsun Zhilan froze and looked up at Zhang Fei, and his cold gaze sent a chill down her spine. ’I already said that you are my woman, so you should forget about your desire to get Mo Qingwen, or I will lock you away for the rest of your life.’
Gongsun Zhilan gritted her teeth; she still couldn’t understand how Zhang Fei could read her mind, and his cold gaze was quite frightening for her.
Mo Qingwen didn’t say anything else; he briefly glanced at Gongsun Zhilan and went to another area to help Zhang Fei collect those demon materials.
Zhang Fei kissed Gongsun Zhilan again before releasing her, and he went to the area opposite Mo Qingwen to continue his hunt.

Gongsun Zhilan was at a loss as she looked at Zhang Fei and Mo Qingwen in turn. She had always loved the latter, and her love for him had become a deep obsession, but the former’s appearance changed the situation.

Since Mo Qingwen had helped Zhang Fei on that floor, Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue decided to return to the fourth floor; otherwise, they would only waste time dawdling with the two of them hunting on that floor.
Gongsun Zhilan sighed inwardly before joining Zhang Fei and Mo Qingwen. The three of them dominated the entire area on the fifth ground floor, forcing other demons who wanted to hunt there to leave.

Since they were busy hunting in the dungeon, time became fleeting for them, and a month had passed since that day. Over the past month, they had gathered quite a bit of demon materials, but the materials Zhang Fei needed were incredibly difficult to obtain.

In the past month, Zhang Fei has frequently switched positions with his clones to help his main harem members improve their cultivation. His clones also assisted their respective wives in their cultivation, preventing them from falling behind the others.
Without her realizing it, Gongsun Zhilan slowly began to change after Zhang Fei repeatedly treated her intimately, but her feelings for Mo Qingwen were still quite strong.
In the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, Tianshi Lingyue, Long Lixuan, Feng Jinhuang, Feng Shizhu, and the other beast race leaders stood on the balcony of the golden palace.
"Have you contacted Zhang Fei, Brother Bailong?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1802: Reinforcements
paragraphs: "Hahaha!" Tianshi Bailong and the others saw Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Shengjie, and Puyang Yeyu walking side by side toward them. "Why are you so tense, Brother Xukong?"
Long Xukong finally found relief. "How can I not be tense after learning that the four perils are leading their subordinates to attack our domain?"
"I’m glad you’re finally back, Brother Wuzhao." Tianshi Bailong looked at his daughter and questioned her. "Why are you back here, Shengjie?"

Tianshi Shengjie looked up at her father. "Even though I’m Zhang Fei’s wife, I’m still part of this domain. Thus, I can’t possibly stay behind if the four perils want to attack us, right? Even though my strength is insufficient to fight against Taotie and the others, I can still fight against their subordinates, especially their new ten generals."
"Alright." Tianshi Bailong knew he wouldn’t be able to persuade his daughter, and he didn’t have time to argue with her, so he agreed. "Welcome back to our domain, Senior Puyang."
"Thank you." Puyang Yeyu answered briefly, nodding her head. "Zhang Fei will arrive soon."

Just as Puyang Yeyu finished speaking, dozens of gates opened in midair, and many people walked out of them. The first to appear was Feng Bingying, and she led the female elders who previously cultivated in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain.

Long Wuzhao and the others could feel that the aura of those female ice phoenixes became extremely cold, and some of them had also reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. After all, they have cultivated in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain for years, and the amount of qi there is ten times richer than in other domains.

Feng Jinhuang took a deep breath after he saw them. Even though he was the one and only golden phoenix, he knew that Feng Bingying and the female elders had become much stronger than him, thanks to Zhang Fei’s support.

Feng Jinhuang was jealous and envious of them because Zhang Fei had helped them so much. When Feng Shizhu returned several years ago, he felt depressed because the difference in their strength had become quite stark despite their similar cultivation levels, and he had to experience that feeling once again with the appearance of Feng Bingying and the others.
Feng Bingying and the others landed in front of Feng Shizhu. "Ancestor, we are back."
"I’m glad you guys are back." Feng Shizu nodded in satisfaction. "Since those evil beasts are near, you guys should prepare now."
"We were prepared before coming here, Ancestor."
"Hahaha!" Jia Leixuan laughed as he landed beside them along with Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu. "Please forgive us; we came uninvited! Zhang Fei came to us, and he asked us to help."
Long Wuzhao nodded to him. "Thank you for taking the time to help us, Fairy King."

"Today will be our final battle with those evil beasts." Ju Jushen, Lu Wangyi, and the other natural race leaders landed at the same time. "The beast races and natural races have always coexisted together, so we came to help as soon as Zhang Fei asked us to."

Long Huoyan led his two wives, Huo Jinying and Si Yingwu, to land there. "Even though our race is not as good as the beast and natural races, we cannot remain silent when this domain is facing danger. Therefore, I lead the members of my race to help you face the four evil beasts, Emperor Long."
"Thank you."

Not long after, Sha Mo, Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, Ku Shenzu, and Ye Futian also arrived. They led many people from their demon races to help the beast races deal with the four perils. After exchanging pleasantries with Long Wuzhao and the others, they immediately prepared their subordinates.
To their surprise, Zhang Fei also asked several members of the Winged Race to assist them, such as Tian Yizu, Tian You’an, Tian Wei, and Tian Xuanyin.
However, the surprises didn’t stop there, as several human cultivators also arrived simultaneously.
Dugu Yuanshen led people from the War God Pavilion.
Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru led people from the Emerald Bamboo Sect.
Qiao Tianze led people from the Qiao Clan.
Zhang Long led people from the Zhang Clan.
You Ran and Tan Yunxi led people from the You Clan.
Liao Hanxue’s grandfather led people from the Liao Clan.
Zhi Yongbo led people from the Zhi Clan.
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi led people from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
Those overseers were not left behind, and Zhang Fei also sent them to that domain.
Yue Ningxue, Yue Xuelian, and Yue Qianrou led people from the Celestial Moon Sect.
Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing led people from the Spring Zenith Sect.

Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling led people from the Moonlit Passion Temple. Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng also joined them. Even Serpentera and Tian Kui, who served as guardians of their sect, decided to join them.
Since Feng Yao couldn’t leave Zhang Fei’s beast space, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu led the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain.
Puyang Shangren and Xuanyuan Zhuanxu led people from the Puyang and Xuanyuan Clans.

Long Wuzhao was overwhelmed by the arrival of those people, and he was grateful to Zhang Fei. If it weren’t for him, those people wouldn’t have come to their domain when they were facing serious trouble, especially the people from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans.

Long Wuzhao was confident in dealing with one or two of the four perils, but he wasn’t confident that Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong could handle the other two. Furthermore, there was a possibility that Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi would appear again in their domain in the battle later, and they wouldn’t be able to face the two primordial beasts even if they were only using their avatars.
"The atmosphere is lively." Long Wuzhao and the others looked at Zhang Fei, who had just arrived with several women.

Long Wuzhao and the others recognized Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, Nalan Shizhe, Mo Zainan, and Yuan Xiajie. However, they couldn’t recognize the other four women, and they felt that those women were much stronger than them, even though their cultivation was at the same level.
"Who are these women, son?" Tianshi Bailong asked.

"Let me introduce them." Zhang Fei pointed to the five women. "Hua Qianmei is the Bewitching Demon God; Gongsun Zhilan is the Venomous Demon God; and Mo Cangyue is the daughter of their domain ruler. The last woman is my new wife, Gongsun Jiuxue."

Sha Mo, Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, and Ku Shenzu were completely shocked after Zhang Fei mentioned Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan. The four men were demon gods, but they were certain that the two women were stronger than them.

At first, Gongsun Zhilan didn’t want to go with Zhang Fei because the Paradise Realm was lower than the Ancient Realm, but he had explained many things to her about the cultivators in that realm over the past month, especially about the unity of all races. In the end, she decides to join him to see the truth for herself, and the sight in front of her has proven his story. ’It turns out this brat didn’t lie to me, and he really succeeded in uniting all the races.’

Hua Qianmei nodded in satisfaction after witnessing all the races present in one place, gathered together to fight the four perils and their subordinates. ’No wonder Zhang Fei can move so quickly in our domain, and several demon gods are already in his clutches.’

Mo Cangyue’s jaw dropped after seeing those people. She had heard many things about Zhang Fei from Yuan Xiajie, including about his personal relationship with all his wives and his connections with those people. At first, she found it difficult to believe all that, but the proof was before her eyes now. ’Incredible! My father couldn’t unite all the demon gods in our realm, but Zhang Fei managed to unite people from various races!’

Just like Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Jiuxue was satisfied after seeing those people. Moreover, she had already chosen Zhang Fei as her husband, and she was completely satisfied that she had not chosen the wrong man. Besides, many of those people were much stronger than her, but they were willing to follow his orders.
After Long Wuzhao and several others flew over, Zhang Fei introduced them to the four female demons of the Myriad Abyss Domain.
"With their help, we will definitely triumph over the four perils, son."
Zhang Fei nodded to Tianshi Bailong. "The four perils are merely Xu Yuanzhi’s subordinates, so we must take care of them today."
"Are you planning to kill them?"

"Why should I kill them?" Zhang Fei turned to ask Feng Jinhuang. "The four perils are immortal-rank beasts, like some of you, and we will be the ones to lose if we kill them. Besides, I have decided to bring many people to move to the Ancient Realm in the future, and I can use those four as temporary guardians."
"Temporary guardians? Does that mean you’ve found some beasts that are stronger than them?"

"I’ve found two people, but they’re not beasts. They’re demons, and they’re much stronger than everyone present." Long Wuzhao and the others perked their ears. "Their names are Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin, and their strength is far greater than the combined strength of everyone present. However, I won’t talk much about them for now, and we should prepare for the four perils."
"Are they close?"
Huo Ling suddenly emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "The four perils and their subordinates will arrive in two hours."
Long Wuzhao and the others immediately returned to their respective subordinates, instructing them to prepare for battle.
"Why do you want them to fight? If you want, I can solve the four perils for you."
Zhang Fei pinched Huo Ling’s cheeks. "Even if you can deal with them, I don’t want these people to rely on us, as it would be detrimental to them in the future."

"Ancestor, we are back."
"I’m glad you guys are back." Feng Shizu nodded in satisfaction.
"Since those evil beasts are near, you guys should prepare now."
"We were prepared before coming here, Ancestor."
"Hahaha!" Jia Leixuan laughed as he landed beside them along with Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu.
"Please forgive us; we came uninvited!
Zhang Fei came to us, and he asked us to help."
Long Wuzhao nodded to him.
"Thank you for taking the time to help us, Fairy King."
"Today will be our final battle with those evil beasts." Ju Jushen, Lu Wangyi, and the other natural race leaders landed at the same time.
"The beast races and natural races have always coexisted together, so we came to help as soon as Zhang Fei asked us to."
Long Huoyan led his two wives, Huo Jinying and Si Yingwu, to land there.
"Even though our race is not as good as the beast and natural races, we cannot remain silent when this domain is facing danger.
Therefore, I lead the members of my race to help you face the four evil beasts, Emperor Long."
"Thank you."
Not long after, Sha Mo, Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, Ku Shenzu, and Ye Futian also arrived.
They led many people from their demon races to help the beast races deal with the four perils.
After exchanging pleasantries with Long Wuzhao and the others, they immediately prepared their subordinates.
To their surprise, Zhang Fei also asked several members of the Winged Race to assist them, such as Tian Yizu, Tian You’an, Tian Wei, and Tian Xuanyin.
However, the surprises didn’t stop there, as several human cultivators also arrived simultaneously.
Dugu Yuanshen led people from the War God Pavilion.
Li Tianyu and Lan Yueru led people from the Emerald Bamboo Sect.
Qiao Tianze led people from the Qiao Clan.
Zhang Long led people from the Zhang Clan.
You Ran and Tan Yunxi led people from the You Clan.
Liao Hanxue’s grandfather led people from the Liao Clan.
Zhi Yongbo led people from the Zhi Clan.
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi led people from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
Those overseers were not left behind, and Zhang Fei also sent them to that domain.
Yue Ningxue, Yue Xuelian, and Yue Qianrou led people from the Celestial Moon Sect.
Gong Wei and Lu Shaqing led people from the Spring Zenith Sect.
Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling led people from the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng also joined them.
Even Serpentera and Tian Kui, who served as guardians of their sect, decided to join them.
Since Feng Yao couldn’t leave Zhang Fei’s beast space, Feng Tian and Feng Jiu led the women from the Blazing Nirvana Domain.
Puyang Shangren and Xuanyuan Zhuanxu led people from the Puyang and Xuanyuan Clans.
Long Wuzhao was overwhelmed by the arrival of those people, and he was grateful to Zhang Fei.
If it weren’t for him, those people wouldn’t have come to their domain when they were facing serious trouble, especially the people from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans.
Long Wuzhao was confident in dealing with one or two of the four perils, but he wasn’t confident that Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong could handle the other two.

Furthermore, there was a possibility that Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi would appear again in their domain in the battle later, and they wouldn’t be able to face the two primordial beasts even if they were only using their avatars.
"The atmosphere is lively." Long Wuzhao and the others looked at Zhang Fei, who had just arrived with several women.
Long Wuzhao and the others recognized Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, Nalan Shizhe, Mo Zainan, and Yuan Xiajie.
However, they couldn’t recognize the other four women, and they felt that those women were much stronger than them, even though their cultivation was at the same level.
"Who are these women, son?" Tianshi Bailong asked.
"Let me introduce them." Zhang Fei pointed to the five women.
"Hua Qianmei is the Bewitching Demon God; Gongsun Zhilan is the Venomous Demon God; and Mo Cangyue is the daughter of their domain ruler.
The last woman is my new wife, Gongsun Jiuxue."
Sha Mo, Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, and Ku Shenzu were completely shocked after Zhang Fei mentioned Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan.
The four men were demon gods, but they were certain that the two women were stronger than them.

At first, Gongsun Zhilan didn’t want to go with Zhang Fei because the Paradise Realm was lower than the Ancient Realm, but he had explained many things to her about the cultivators in that realm over the past month, especially about the unity of all races.

In the end, she decides to join him to see the truth for herself, and the sight in front of her has proven his story. ’It turns out this brat didn’t lie to me, and he really succeeded in uniting all the races.’

Hua Qianmei nodded in satisfaction after witnessing all the races present in one place, gathered together to fight the four perils and their subordinates. ’No wonder Zhang Fei can move so quickly in our domain, and several demon gods are already in his clutches.’
Mo Cangyue’s jaw dropped after seeing those people.
She had heard many things about Zhang Fei from Yuan Xiajie, including about his personal relationship with all his wives and his connections with those people.
At first, she found it difficult to believe all that, but the proof was before her eyes now. ’Incredible!
My father couldn’t unite all the demon gods in our realm, but Zhang Fei managed to unite people from various races!’
Just like Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Jiuxue was satisfied after seeing those people.
Moreover, she had already chosen Zhang Fei as her husband, and she was completely satisfied that she had not chosen the wrong man.
Besides, many of those people were much stronger than her, but they were willing to follow his orders.
After Long Wuzhao and several others flew over, Zhang Fei introduced them to the four female demons of the Myriad Abyss Domain.
"With their help, we will definitely triumph over the four perils, son."
Zhang Fei nodded to Tianshi Bailong.
"The four perils are merely Xu Yuanzhi’s subordinates, so we must take care of them today."
"Are you planning to kill them?"
"Why should I kill them?" Zhang Fei turned to ask Feng Jinhuang.
"The four perils are immortal-rank beasts, like some of you, and we will be the ones to lose if we kill them.
Besides, I have decided to bring many people to move to the Ancient Realm in the future, and I can use those four as temporary guardians."
"Temporary guardians?
Does that mean you’ve found some beasts that are stronger than them?"
"I’ve found two people, but they’re not beasts.
They’re demons, and they’re much stronger than everyone present." Long Wuzhao and the others perked their ears.
"Their names are Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin, and their strength is far greater than the combined strength of everyone present.
However, I won’t talk much about them for now, and we should prepare for the four perils."
"Are they close?"
Huo Ling suddenly emerged from Zhang Fei’s body.
"The four perils and their subordinates will arrive in two hours."
Long Wuzhao and the others immediately returned to their respective subordinates, instructing them to prepare for battle.
"Why do you want them to fight?
If you want, I can solve the four perils for you."
Zhang Fei pinched Huo Ling’s cheeks.
"Even if you can deal with them, I don’t want these people to rely on us, as it would be detrimental to them in the future."

chapters.title: Chapter 1803: The Enemies Are Near
paragraphs: Zhang Fei and the four female demons of the Myriad Abyss Domain stood side by side on the roof of the golden palace, watching the people who were already preparing to fight the four perils and their subordinates.
Puyang Yeyu suddenly landed in front of them. "Are you going to bring all your wives to this domain, Zhang Fei?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "They are already prepared in that place, and I will summon them out once our enemies are close to this domain."

Naturally, Puyang Yeyu knew about Zhang Fei’s private space, having trained there for over a year. He didn’t mention it explicitly due to the presence of Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, and Mo Cangyue. As for Gongsun Jiuxue, she knew he hadn’t brought her there for some reason, but she didn’t intend to ask about it.
"You are a member of the Puyang Clan, right?" Hua Qianmei asked Puyang Yeyu, her tone full of certainty.

"Demon God Hua Qianmei, I’ve heard your name many times in the past, but this is our first meeting." Puyang Yeyu’s words confirmed Hua Qianmei’s previous question. "I knew that Zhang Fei went to the Myriad Abyss Domain, but I didn’t expect the two of you to have such a good relationship, and you followed him here."

"Haha," Hua Qianmei’s breasts bounced around as she laughed. "My Xiajie brought Zhang Fei to me over a month ago, and he gave me some pills. Since he needs help, I have to help him, or I’ll be ungrateful. What do you think if we write off the enmity between my demon race and your Puyang Clan?"
"Did you two have any problems in the past?" Hua Qianmei and Puyang Yeyu nodded to Zhang Fei. "Tell me."
Hua Qianmei and Puyang Yeyu explained the roots of their problems to Zhang Fei. Both women had slightly different versions of the story, but the gist wasn’t much different.

"Honestly, the root of the problems between you two is too trivial, but it became a major issue because of the enmity between the demon and human races." Hua Qianmei and Puyang Yeyu agreed with Zhang Fei. "Since Qianmei has offered peace, Yeyu only needs to speak to her grandmother to resolve everything. If necessary, I will speak to Senior Shenmi myself; I’m sure she will agree with me."

Puyang Yeyu refused with a shake of her head. "You don’t need to talk to my grandmother, Zhang Fei. I will talk to Puyang Shangren after our problems in this domain are resolved, and he will convey everything to her."
"If so, let Senior Shangren speak to your grandmother regarding the matter." Zhang Fei turned to Gongsun Zhilan, who was seriously observing the people below. "Why is your expression this serious?"
Gongsun Zhilan sighed, looking at Zhang Fei. "How did you unite these people? These people don’t hate demons, and they work together for a common goal, which is unheard of."

"Didn’t I tell you before that I am a human, a demon, and a beast?" Gongsun Zhilan remembered that, but she knew that uniting all races wasn’t that easy. She believed there were many stories behind it that Zhang Fei hadn’t told her. "I never hid my three identities from these people, and my women came from all races, so it wasn’t difficult for me to build a strong alliance with them."

Mo Cangyue and Hua Qianmei also believed there was some other story behind Zhang Fei’s success in uniting all the races in Paradise Realm, but he hid everything because he hadn’t known them for too long.
Gongsun Jiuxue was also curious about that, but she didn’t ask anything, and she believed that Zhang Fei would tell her everything when their relationship was truly close.
"Zhang Fei, why did you refuse my parents’ help?" Mo Cangyue suddenly asked.
Zhang Fei looked at her. "Honestly, I never thought about getting too close to your parents, as it would only bring trouble for me."
"What do you mean by that? Do you think my parents are troublemakers?" Mo Cangyue asked in a dissatisfied tone.

"Princess Mo, you know that your parents have many enemies in your domain, right?" Mo Cangyue was annoyed because Zhang Fei always addressed her like that. "Jian Washeng is already under my control, but Gui Ye and several others are still out there. The other demon gods may be calm now, but they might bare their fangs someday. That’s why I choose to keep my distance from your parents; otherwise, they will drag me into their future troubles."

"Cough." Mo Cangyue turned to Gongsun Zhilan, who was pretending to cough. "You don’t know it, but Mo Qingwen has long been aware of the matter. Apart from Yan Washeng and his group, there is another group that wants to overthrow him. As Zhang Fei said just now, they are still waiting for the right moment, and they will make their move when the time comes."
"Who are they?"
"One of them is Hou Wuyan, and you should ask your father for the rest."
Mo Cangyue was shocked when she heard the name Hou Wuyan. "By the way, do you still have feelings for my father?"

Noticing the mischievous smile on Zhang Fei’s face, Gongsun Zhilan chose not to answer Mo Cangyue’s question. The past month was enough for her to know a lot of things, and he repeatedly punished her due to her feelings for Mo Qingwen.

Gongsun Zhilan had never been afraid of anyone, but Zhang Fei was different from them, and she was terrified of him. She wasn’t afraid that he would kill her because she knew he would never do that, but she was afraid of his punishment.
"Haha," Hua Qianmei laughed at Gongsun Zhilan’s expression. "You no longer look as fierce as before, and you look more docile now."
Gongsun Zhilan glared at Hua Qianmei, but she didn’t say anything to refute her. "Hey! Where are all your women?"

"Some of them are already here." Zhang Fei pointed to several women below, such as Yue Ningxue, Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, and Tianshi Shengjie. He told the four female demons the identities of his six women.

The beauty of Zhang Fei’s six women made Gongsun Zhilan’s heart filled with jealousy and envy. "When are you going to give me other pills? You’ve already given them to my niece, Hua Qianmei, and Gu Yanshu, but you haven’t given them to me yet."
"Didn’t I give you lots of pills?"
"That’s not the pills I meant!"
"Then, which pills do you mean?"
"Pills that make them beautiful and young!"

"Oh." Zhang Fei clasped his hands. "I gave your niece those beauty pills because she chose me as her husband. Hua Qianmei provided a special place for my demon wives to cultivate, and Gu Yanshu exchanged them for demon materials to concoct a hundred Demon Soul Elixirs. As for you, you haven’t given me anything, and you still harbor feelings for Mo Qingwen, so I haven’t given them to you."
Gongsun Zhilan was furious after hearing that, and she raised both her hands as if she wanted to strangle Zhang Fei to death, but he immediately moved away from her.
Hua Qianmei, Yuan Xiajie, Mo Cangyue, Gongsun Jiuxue, and Puyang Yeyu laughed at their antics.
Zhang Fei smirked, pulled Gongsun Zhilan into his embrace, and kissed her.
After spending a month with Zhang Fei and being kissed by him repeatedly, Gongsun Zhilan was no longer shy about kissing him in front of others; instead, she became accustomed to it.
A while later, Zhang Fei stopped kissing Gongsun Zhilan and rubbed her cheek. "We’ll talk about that after we get back from this realm, okay?"
"Humph." Gongsun Zhilan harrumphed and turned her face to the side.
Zhang Fei looked at Puyang Yeyu before pulling her closer and briefly kissing her. "Yeyu, it’s time, right?"
"Okay." Puyang Yeyu answered with a smile.

"Great!" Zhang Fei looked outside the domain before giving instructions to the people below. "They’re getting closer, so I’ll bring all my wives here, and they can use those evil beasts for their training."

After saying that, Zhang Fei opened a portal to the training space. All his women quickly walked out of it, except Ru Xue, who was still in the process of evolution. Their beauty made Gongsun Zhilan’s heart even more filled with jealousy; even Mo Cangyue was also jealous of them.

After introducing the four female demons to all his wives, Zhang Fei informed Luo Yunxiao and the others about several things. "Your main target is the four perils’ subordinates, and you must kill as many of them as possible."
"Do you have any information about their new generals, husband?" Yao Qilin asked.
Fei Lian also asked him. "Is the number of their new generals still the same as in the past?"

"Their number of new generals is still ten, as it was in the past, but I have no information on them." Zhang Fei summoned seven evil beasts out of the beast space. "You guys must prepare to face the four perils’ new generals, and I allow you to kill them."
"Yes, Master." Xie Heilong and the others immediately spread out, preparing to welcome their enemies.
Zhang Chen hugged Zhang Fei and asked, "You asked us to fight those evil beasts, but you haven’t told us your target."

"Didn’t you already guess, Chen’er?" Zhang Fei kissed her for a moment. "Those evil beasts wouldn’t make a move without reason, and Xu Yuanzhi should have ordered them to capture Emperor Long. I’m sure that the two primordial beasts will appear today, so I won’t fight those evil beasts, and I’ll wait for the two of them to arrive."
"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding. "Leave the four perils’ subordinates to us, and you only need to focus on the two primordial beasts."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1804: Raid Enemy Palace
paragraphs: While the people in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain were anxious and wary, Zhang Fei’s four clones stood in front of a majestic black palace, which belonged to none other than the four perils.
[Haha! Taotie and the others will vomit blood if they know you raided their palace, Master. By the way, hundreds of evil beasts will arrive soon.]
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Zhang Fei’s four clones looked up to the sky, where hundreds of evil beasts were arriving to protect the palace. They were only ordinary beasts; their strength was far inferior to that of the four perils’ ten generals, and even their beast rank had not reached the mythical rank.
"What a bunch of dogs."

As soon as Zhang Fei’s four clones released their aura, hundreds of evil beasts became stiff with fear. While they were panicking, small qi needles penetrated their heads, killing them without them realizing it.
Within seconds, the corpses of those beasts fell to the ground with a loud bang, which quieted the atmosphere in the palace again.
[Why did you kill them, Master?]
"They were enemies, and enemies must die."
Mei was speechless.
Zhang Fei’s four clones directly entered the palace, but four fierce auras greeted his arrival.
Soon, the avatars of Taotie and his three friends appeared before them, releasing their killing intent.
Zhang Fei’s four clones sneered, countered their auras, and suppressed the four perils’ avatars.
The four perils’ eyes widened in shock and stared at them in horror, especially when four golden swords appeared above them.

"Heh!" Zhang Fei [5] sneered. "Long time no see, but you’ve become senile, Taotie. Back then, my strength wasn’t enough to fight your avatar, but I’ve changed over the past few years, and your avatar is no longer my opponent."
"Zhang Fei!" Taotie roared.
"You guys led the troops to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, right? What will happen to you if I destroy your avatars?"

The four perils trembled at the thought of their fate, but Zhang Fei’s four clones ignored them. In an instant, the four golden swords beheaded their avatars; the four of them instantly disappeared from the palace.

"They are powerful, but I have already surpassed them. Unfortunately, my strength is still insufficient to face the real Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, but I still have plenty of time to prepare myself before I go to the Primordial Realm."
[If you succeed in defeating Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, you will become the strongest in this universe, Master.]

Zhang Fei’s four clones casually walked into the palace, looking for the treasure chamber. "Becoming the strongest in this universe isn’t easy, Mei. Have you forgotten the existence of the core creature? That creature is much stronger than all living creatures, including Feng Yao. Even if I evolve into a ten-tailed fox, I don’t have the confidence to defeat it. In my opinion, the only way to defeat it is to obtain the Chaos Flame, but it’s difficult because the Chaos Beast protects the flame."
[There’s another solution, Master.]

"The Primal Origin Physique, right? Feng Yao knows the location of that physique, but I don’t want to think about it now because my strength isn’t enough to enter that place yet." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly remembered something, and he checked the system map to look for someone. "Where did the four perils lock up that person?"
[Are you looking for the owner of the Myriad Dao Physique, Master?]
Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Feng Yao once told me that Taotie and the others enslaved that person, so I wanted to free him and bring him to my side."
[I will search this entire palace for you, Master.]
"Thank you, Mei."

Before long, Zhang Fei’s four clones arrived at the treasure chamber. They didn’t expect that the four perils hoard had so many useful treasures. Although those treasures were not very useful for him and all his wives, they were useful for the people on his side. Without wasting time, they looted all the treasures in that place and stored them in the system inventory.
"Haha! Taotie and the others will vomit blood once they find their treasure vault completely empty." Zhang Fei [5] was really satisfied with that. "Did you manage to find that person, Mei?"
[The four perils seem to be hiding that person somewhere else, Master. The only way to find him is to defeat them, and you just have to force them to take you to him.]
"Let’s see later."
As Zhang Fei’s four clones left the palace, a male beast appeared before them. They immediately guessed that he was Wu Mian. "Why are you still here?"
"Haha," Wu Mian laughed. "I have nothing else to do, and your people are enough to stop the four perils, so I’m going around several domains to check on something."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Has Mo Shentian arrived at the Endless Domain?"
"Not yet." Wu Mian shook his head. "As soon as Mo Shentian arrives at that domain, I will inform you immediately. By the way, what are your plans for him?"
"What else?" Zhang Fei [5] shrugged. "The Celestial Demon Race can’t be without a leader, right? I will defeat Mo Shentian, and I will force him to pass on his strength to Mo Tianshen."

Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "If Mo Tianshen becomes the next Celestial Demon God, the eight demon races will be on your side, and you only need to persuade the remaining two. Shang Zhanluo probably won’t mind joining you after you save him, but he might have some demands."
"Sha Mo."
"That’s right! Sha Mo was the mastermind behind Shang Zhanluo’s condition back then, and the Asura Demon God is quite vengeful, so he might ask you to hand over the Heavenly Fiend Demon God to him."
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Sha Qingge is my future wife, so Sha Mo will be my future father-in-law. If Shang Zhanluo doesn’t know his limits, I will face him and beat him up."
"Isn’t Shang Zhanluo also your future father-in-law? After all, Shang Xueli is your future wife, right?"

Zhang Fei [5] knew Shang Xueli’s feelings for him, but he had some understanding of Shang Zhanluo’s character, and he wouldn’t submit to him so easily. He didn’t make a move against her because of her father, as they might fight to the death someday. "Forget it! I will return to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain now because the four perils are almost there."
"Alright."
In their flying artifacts, the faces of the four perils were quite pale, which happened after Zhang Fei’s four clones destroyed their avatars.
"That bastard!" Taotie roared, clutching his chest.
Qiongqi was the same as him. "Our injuries from a few years ago haven’t fully recovered, but we have to suffer another injury today."
"Zhang Fei’s strength is truly terrifying now." Taowu wiped the sweat on his forehead. "No wonder our master is so eager to capture him and Long Wuzhao."

Hundun lay on the floor, breathing heavily. "How could Zhang Fei’s strength become this strong in just a few years? As I recall, he ran away from Taotie’s avatar when they met in the Three Mortal Realms many years ago, but he destroyed our avatar with a single attack today."
Taotie, Qiongqi, and Taowu’s expressions became gloomy after Hundun mentioned that.
"Are we going to continue attacking the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain?"
"With our injuries, our chances of defeating Long Wuzhao and the others are slim."
"Besides, Zhang Fei should be in that domain right now, and he will definitely help them fight us."
Taotie took a deep breath. "We have no other choice but to move forward, right? If we retreat now, our master will punish us or even kill us."
"Do you think our master will come to our aid?"

"I think he will because he had fought Zhang Fei before, and he said that he couldn’t defeat that brat back then." Taotie and the other three agreed with Qiongqi. "Come on! The Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain is already within sight; we must prepare to attack them now."

"They’re coming." Zhang Fei’s voice echoed throughout the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, signaling everyone to prepare. "Emperor Long! Taotie and the other three have just been injured, so you and the others can focus on them."
"Were you the one who injured them, Zhang Fei?"

Zhang Fei chuckled. "I destroyed their avatars that they left behind in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain. This way, our victory is guaranteed, but we must remain careful because Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi could appear at any time."

Everyone’s expressions turned grim remembering the time Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi appeared at Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding, and none of them could have moved under the pressure of the two if not for Huo Ling and Feng Yao’s help.
"Alright! Don’t think about Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi! Leave them both to me and Ling’er; instead, you guys should focus on slaughtering those evil beasts."
Everyone present in the domain cheered as soon as Zhang Fei said that, and they became even more impatient to slaughter those evil beasts.

On the roof of the golden palace, Zhang Fei was busy observing the entire domain to ensure that no enemy was missed. Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, Gongsun Jiuxue, and Puyang Yeyu stood behind him and did not disturb him.
Meanwhile, Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue decided to join Zhang Fei’s wives, preparing to fight those evil beasts.

Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes, seeing tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands, of evil beasts entered the domain. Their presence filled the airspace of the domain, blocking out the light. "Taotie and three others are hiding behind their subordinates, and the ten beasts in front are their new ten generals."
"Do you want me and my niece to make a move, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei shook his head at Gongsun Zhilan. "Let them face those evil beasts first."

chapters.title: Chapter 1805: Join Force Againts Evil Beasts
paragraphs: "Kill them!" Zhang Fei’s shout echoed throughout the domain.
Before the evil beasts attacked, all the cultivators who had been waiting for them immediately launched their first attacks. They targeted the beasts at the very front of their group.

Most of these people were cultivators with cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, and their attacks were extremely effective against the evil beasts. In one attack, their vanguard suffered heavy blows; the corpses of those evil beasts fell freely from the air.

Some of the cultivators immediately moved into the sky, using their techniques to dismember those evil beast corpses. In normal situations, people would be excited about getting lots of free beast meat, but they didn’t care about any of that and focused on attacking the defending evil beasts.
Fei Lian and Yao Qilin swiftly led the other seven evil beasts on Zhang Fei’s side to attack the ten generals of the four perils, followed by Serpentera and Tian Kui.
The ten generals of the four perils were shocked by their aggressiveness, but all ten of them returned to their beast forms before scattering in different directions.
Fei Lian, Yao Qilin, Serpentera, Tian Kui, and the seven evil beasts on Zhang Fei’s side also used their beast forms before fighting against their enemies.

The cultivators of all races, who joined the alliance, immediately flew into the sky to fight the evil beasts. Zhang Fei had arranged those people not to attack the four perils, and their main task was to slaughter their subordinates.

Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, Dugu Yuanshen, and all the senior cultivators who joined the war collaborated with others to attack the subordinates of the four perils due to their overwhelming numbers. People from the winged race, the natural race, and the demihuman race also joined them, causing the number of those evil beasts to decrease rapidly.

Even though the people from the Puyang and Xuanyuan Clans were powerful enough to fight against Taotie and his three brothers, Zhang Fei forbade them to fight against the four evil beast leaders; instead, he assigned them to protect the others from behind.

The people of the Puyang and Xuanyuan Clans naturally understood Zhang Fei’s purpose of using those evil beasts as training opponents for other cultivators, so they followed his assignment and protected them from behind.
Yue Ningxue, Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, and Puyang Yeyu led Zhang Fei’s other wives.
Feng Tian and Feng Jiu led all the women of the Blazing Nirvana Domain.
Yuan Xiajie, Mo Cangyue, and Gongsun Jiuxue also joined them, and they seemed to enjoy killing those evil beasts.
Meanwhile, Qi Qingxiu, Dong Xuanyin, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhu, and the other demon gods became backups to protect them.
"Bastard!" Taotie shouted in rage after they saw those people.

Qiongxi frowned as he watched the battle unfold. He hadn’t expected such a large number of people to be waiting for them in the domain. What shocked him most was that they came from all races. "It must be Zhang Fei who gathered them."
"How could these people gather in this domain? They even teamed up to fight us!" Taowu shouted in frustration.
"We were trapped." Hundun showed a grim expression. "They knew from the start that we would attack today, and they deliberately waited for us."
Taotie and his three brothers wanted to attack those people to save their subordinates.
However, Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, Feng Shizhu, and Feng Jinhuang swiftly blocked their path.

"You four didn’t expect that today would turn out like this, did you?" The four perils were furious to hear that from Long Xukong. "Since you guys have come from a long way, let’s fight then, and we will solve our old problems today."

Taotie and his three brothers returned to their beast forms to fight with them, and they scattered in four different directions. However, Long Wuzhao and the others also did the same, and they followed their four enemies.
Long Wuzhao faced Taotie.
Tianshi Bailong faced Qiongxi.
Long Xukong faced Taowu.
Feng Shizhu and Feng Jinhuang joined forces to fight Hundun.
Since the four perils were injured after Zhang Fei destroyed their avatars, they had a difficult time facing Long Wuzhao and the others.

Zhang Fei asked Long Wuzhao and the others not to kill the Four Perils, as he needed them to be the guardians of the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. He wanted Zhen Mo and Zhen Yin to become one, but Feng Yao forbade him from releasing the two ancient demons from their imprisonment, fearing that those creatures would attack the domain.
Zhang Fei, who was watching the battle in the sky, nodded several times in satisfaction. "This fight is one-sided."
"How did you know the steps they took?"

"I have a cheat." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan looked at Zhang Fei with curiosity in their expressions. "My cheat is Feng Yao, and she monitors the enemy’s movements so I can prepare everything much earlier."
"How did Feng Yao do that? Where is she now?"
"Feng Yao is inside my beast space, and she can’t come out because her cultivation has exceeded this limit realm."
"Limit?"
"I’ll explain to you two later."
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan simply nodded and looked at the war again. ’The outcome was predetermined from the start, and those evil beasts were certain to lose this war!’

Zhang Fei was truly satisfied with the fighting abilities of all his wives, which proved their decades of training had not been in vain. He looked solemnly at the sky because Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi still hadn’t appeared, even though the number of those evil beasts continued to decrease rapidly.

"Ling’er." Huo Ling came out of Zhang Fei’s body and sat on his shoulder. "You must protect Long Wuzhao. I’m afraid that Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi come from another domain, and we won’t be prepared if they suddenly appear and attack him."

"Alright." Huo Ling spontaneously agreed because she didn’t need to worry about Zhang Fei. After all, he had the ability to borrow Feng Yao’s strength, and Long Wuzhao did not have such an ability. "Tch! I’m itching to beat up those two primordial beasts, husband."
Zhang Fei chuckled as he pinched her cheek. "If you beat them up, how can I use them as my sparring partners?"

"You don’t need them," Huo Ling pouted like a little girl. "If you want to train, you can fight those demon gods from the Myriad Abyss Domain. If you don’t want to fight them, you can look for Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, or Qian Yan."

Zhang Fei gave her a nod of agreement. "I will face Mo Shentian soon, but I will wait for him to arrive at the Endless Domain first. Actually, I was thinking of meeting Shang Zhanluo after this, and our fight depends on his decision. As for Qian Yan, I’m still hesitant to meet him, and I’m still worried about the capabilities of his middle eye."
"What is the ability of Qian Yan’s middle eye?"

Zhang Fei looked at the two female demon gods and explained. "Qian Yan’s middle eye can see through anything, including private spaces. If we meet, he will lock my aura, and he can find me wherever I hide."
"Oh?" Hua Qianmei was quite surprised to hear that. "Does that mean he can see all the way to the Ancient Realm?"
"I can’t confirm that yet, but he can see everything in this Paradise Realm."

Hua Qianmei nodded in understanding. "Even though he’s a demon beast god, I believe you can defeat him easily, even if you have to borrow Feng Yao’s power. If necessary, Zhilan and I can go with you to meet him, and we will help you to defeat him."
"No matter how powerful that demon beast god is, he won’t be immune to my poison like you, and I can kill him easily." Gongsun Zhilan nonchalantly spoke.
Zhang Fei naturally knew that Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei could defeat Qian Yan, but he was reluctant to ask for their help in a fight with him.
Huo Ling spoke immediately. "Husband, I think it’s time you settled all the remaining matters in this realm, and you can focus on other things afterward."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded. "My remaining problems in this realm are the three demon gods and the Divine Samsara Sect. As for Hun Lingwu, I don’t really care about him because I can defeat him, but Feng Yao forbade me from killing him."

Huo Ling immediately gave him an idea. "Since my master forbade you to kill Hun Lingwu, you should go to the Immortal Soul Palace to enslave him. After all, he is an expert soul cultivator, and you can use him to help your people improve their soul power."
"Let’s deal with that later." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as he sensed the change in the strength of the four perils. "Their strength has suddenly increased significantly!"

Huo Ling looked at the four perils, who reversed the course of the battle against Long Wuzhao and the others. "Xu Yuanzhi seems to have given those beasts something to increase their strength, husband! If their strength is this great, I’m afraid Long Wuzhao and the others will lose, so you should make your move now."
"Let the two of us move." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei’s side.
Zhang Fei did not stay still, and his four clones moved to change the course of the battle.
*Roar*
Taotie, who was in his beast form, suddenly released a powerful roar, and the two eyes in his armpits turned blood red.
Long Wuzhao was quite shocked by Taotie’s increased power, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately appeared in front of him. "He used something forbidden to increase his strength."

Zhang Fei was truly satisfied with the fighting abilities of all his wives, which proved their decades of training had not been in vain.
He looked solemnly at the sky because Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi still hadn’t appeared, even though the number of those evil beasts continued to decrease rapidly.
"Ling’er." Huo Ling came out of Zhang Fei’s body and sat on his shoulder.
"You must protect Long Wuzhao.
I’m afraid that Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi come from another domain, and we won’t be prepared if they suddenly appear and attack him."
"Alright." Huo Ling spontaneously agreed because she didn’t need to worry about Zhang Fei.
After all, he had the ability to borrow Feng Yao’s strength, and Long Wuzhao did not have such an ability.
"Tch!
I’m itching to beat up those two primordial beasts, husband."
Zhang Fei chuckled as he pinched her cheek.
"If you beat them up, how can I use them as my sparring partners?"
"You don’t need them," Huo Ling pouted like a little girl.
"If you want to train, you can fight those demon gods from the Myriad Abyss Domain.
If you don’t want to fight them, you can look for Mo Shentian, Shang Zhanluo, or Qian Yan."
Zhang Fei gave her a nod of agreement.
"I will face Mo Shentian soon, but I will wait for him to arrive at the Endless Domain first.
Actually, I was thinking of meeting Shang Zhanluo after this, and our fight depends on his decision.
As for Qian Yan, I’m still hesitant to meet him, and I’m still worried about the capabilities of his middle eye."
"What is the ability of Qian Yan’s middle eye?"
Zhang Fei looked at the two female demon gods and explained.
"Qian Yan’s middle eye can see through anything, including private spaces.
If we meet, he will lock my aura, and he can find me wherever I hide."
"Oh?" Hua Qianmei was quite surprised to hear that.
"Does that mean he can see all the way to the Ancient Realm?"
"I can’t confirm that yet, but he can see everything in this Paradise Realm."
Hua Qianmei nodded in understanding.
"Even though he’s a demon beast god, I believe you can defeat him easily, even if you have to borrow Feng Yao’s power.
If necessary, Zhilan and I can go with you to meet him, and we will help you to defeat him."
"No matter how powerful that demon beast god is, he won’t be immune to my poison like you, and I can kill him easily." Gongsun Zhilan nonchalantly spoke.
Zhang Fei naturally knew that Gongsun Zhilan and Hua Qianmei could defeat Qian Yan, but he was reluctant to ask for their help in a fight with him.
Huo Ling spoke immediately.
"Husband, I think it’s time you settled all the remaining matters in this realm, and you can focus on other things afterward."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei nodded.
"My remaining problems in this realm are the three demon gods and the Divine Samsara Sect.
As for Hun Lingwu, I don’t really care about him because I can defeat him, but Feng Yao forbade me from killing him."
Huo Ling immediately gave him an idea.
"Since my master forbade you to kill Hun Lingwu, you should go to the Immortal Soul Palace to enslave him.
After all, he is an expert soul cultivator, and you can use him to help your people improve their soul power."
"Let’s deal with that later." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as he sensed the change in the strength of the four perils.
"Their strength has suddenly increased significantly!"
Huo Ling looked at the four perils, who reversed the course of the battle against Long Wuzhao and the others.
"Xu Yuanzhi seems to have given those beasts something to increase their strength, husband!
If their strength is this great, I’m afraid Long Wuzhao and the others will lose, so you should make your move now."
"Let the two of us move." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan immediately disappeared from Zhang Fei’s side.
Zhang Fei did not stay still, and his four clones moved to change the course of the battle.
*Roar*
Taotie, who was in his beast form, suddenly released a powerful roar, and the two eyes in his armpits turned blood red.
Long Wuzhao was quite shocked by Taotie’s increased power, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately appeared in front of him.
"He used something forbidden to increase his strength."

chapters.title: Chapter 1806: Meet Shang Zhanluo
paragraphs: "He—"
"He’s lost his mind."

Zhang Fei [1] swiftly used his void element to confine Taotie. He also activated his soul domain to weaken the beast’s soul. He looked in three different directions and discovered that Qiongxi, Taowu, and Hundun were experiencing the same changes.

Taotie roared loudly and slammed his head against Zhang Fei [1]’s void prison. However, the void element was different from other elements, and one couldn’t destroy it without possessing and understanding it.
Zhang Fei’s three other clones also moved to restrain Qiongxi and Hundun. Their transformation was too powerful even for Long Wuzhao, and he didn’t want to risk the four beasts hurting people.
Long Xukong could handle Taowu by himself, as he was a void dragon. However, Puyang Yeyu immediately moved beside him, helping him to restrain the beast’s movement.

Hua Qianmei helped Tianshi Bailong, who previously fought against Qiongxi. Even though one of Zhang Fei’s clones had already confined the male beast using the void prison, she still restrained his movements.
Hundun had the worst luck among the four perils; Gongsun Zhilan poisoned him before Zhang Fei’s clone locked him using the void element, causing him to continue screaming in pain.

Gongsun Zhilan informed Zhang Fei’s clone that her poison was not potent, and Hundun would not die from it, but he would suffer for a very long time. Feng Shizhu and Feng Jinhuang were speechless by the action of the female demon god; they did not expect that she would torture the beast using her poison.
The four perils’ ten generals had been defeated by Fei Lian, Yao Qilin, and all the evil beasts on Zhang Fei’s side. They didn’t kill the ten beasts, and they only sealed their cultivation.

Meanwhile, more than half of the four perils’ subordinates had already died, and most of them were killed by Zhang Fei’s wives. Although these women weren’t as strong as Luo Fenghan and the others, they had been training in the training space for decades.

Qi Qingxiu, Dong Xuanyin, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhu, and the other demon gods wanted to move against the four perils’ subordinates, but they abandoned their plans because those people were enough to defeat them.

Zhang Fei [1] breathed a sigh of relief because they had won the war. He observed Taotie, who was still trying to free himself from his void prison. "I don’t know what Xu Yuanzhi has given them, but they will be useless after this."
"You mean?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [1] nodded in disappointment. "After they use that forbidden thing, their bodies will become crippled, and their cultivation will slowly disappear."
Long Wuzhao frowned. "Doesn’t that mean Xu Yuanzhi intended to sacrifice them from the start?"

"Xu Yuanzhi was so desperate to capture the two of us, and he thought that the four perils would succeed in weakening us before he showed up." Zhang Fei [1] opened the system map to search for the whereabouts of the two primordial beasts. ’Can you detect them, Mei?’
[They haven’t arrived in this domain yet, Master.]
Zhang Fei [1] sighed regretfully. "After today, those evil beasts will lose their leaders, and I also lost four prospective guardians."

Long Wuzhao smiled bitterly because Zhang Fei had once told him that he wanted to use the four perils as guardians in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, but his plans were thwarted by Xu Yuanzhi’s cruel actions against them.
"Husband." Zhang Fei [1] turned to Dong Xuanyin. "Can you recover Taotie and the others’ condition?"
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head. "I don’t know what Xu Yuanzhi has given them, so I can’t do anything for them."
"What about Sister Yao?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [1] thought for a moment before knocking Taotie unconscious, and he brought him to the beast space so Feng Yao could check on his condition.
Dong Xuanyin looked at Long Wuzhao. "Are you disappointed? You’ve worked so hard to unite all the beasts, but both benevolent and evil beasts ended up on the battlefield today."
"A bit." Long Wuzhao looked at the dead evil beasts. "Even though many of them are dead today, many of them are still alive in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, right?"
"That’s for sure."
Long Wuzhao thought about some things. "Can you lead the remaining evil beasts?"
"It would be a waste of my time, so I won’t do that." Dong Xuanyin pointed at Xie Heilong and the others. "You should talk to my husband and have him send one of them to lead those evil beasts."
"Alright." Long Wuzhao hurriedly approached Zhang Fei, who was still watching the situation from the roof of the golden palace, and explained everything to him. "What do you think about that?"
Since Feng Yao resided in his beast space, Zhang Fei didn’t need Xie Heilong and the other six evil beasts. "I’ll send them to that domain so they can control the situation there."
Xie Heilong and the other six evil beasts came to Zhang Fei, who immediately sent them to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain after explaining everything.
"Where exactly are those two primordial beasts hiding?" Just as Zhang Fei was thinking about that, a qi screen suddenly appeared in front of him and Long Wuzhao. "Xuanyuan Yue?"
Long Wuzhao was shocked when he saw the qi screen, even more so when he saw Xuanyuan Yue on it. ’Who is this woman? What is her relationship with Zhang Fei?’
"Hehe," Xuanyuan Yue giggled. "We meet again, Zhang Fei."
Zhang Fei’s lips twitched. "A month ago, you came all the way to the dungeon, but you didn’t want to show up to see me."

"Haha," Xuanyuan Yue stuck out her tongue. "I wanted to tell you that the two primordial beasts are in the Paradise Realm; to be precise, they were hiding in a domain not far from the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. However, they knew that you managed to capture the four perils, so they didn’t dare come to your domain."
"Tsk! They are really cowards!" Zhang Fei couldn’t help but curse. "By the way, do you have anything to restore the condition of the four perils?"

Xuanyuan Yue shook her head. "I don’t know what they’re used for the four perils, so I don’t have a solution to cure them. After today, the two primordial beasts won’t bother you for long, so you can take care of your other business, and I’ll wait for you here."
"I will definitely meet you one day, and you must not run away again at that time."
"Don’t worry, I will meet you at that time." Zhang Fei suddenly saw Huli Chenying’s face on the qi screen, but Xuanyuan Yue hurriedly cut off their communication.
"Who was that woman just now?"
"That woman is Xuanyuan Yue, and she’s the woman who accidentally killed me."
"I see." Long Wuzhao didn’t ask for further details. "I’ll help the others first."
Zhang Fei’s three clones knocked Qiongxi, Taowu, and Hundun unconscious. He sent them into his beast space. As for their subordinates, he allowed them to kill them.
"What are your next plans?" Puyang Yeyu asked.
Zhang Fei looked at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan. "After all these evil beasts are dead, I plan to visit the Asura Demon God after this."
"Oh?" Hua Qianmei remembered that Zhang Fei had once told her that there was an Asura Demon God in the Paradise Realm. "I’ll accompany you to meet him."
"Me too." Gongsun Zhilan was curious about the demon domains in the Paradise Realm.
"Let’s wait first."
"What exactly did Xu Yuanzhi give to the four of them? Can you restore their condition?"
Feng Yao shook her head. "I can’t do anything to save them because Xu Yuanzhi gave them those Soulburn Crystals, and their condition will continue to deteriorate until they become crippled."
"Soulburn Crystals?"

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded. "The crystal’s effect will increase one’s strength severalfold, but it also burns their body and soul essence. Once we use the crystal, we have no turning back. I know your wishes regarding the four perils, but there’s nothing we can do now."
Zhang Fei [1] couldn’t help but feel disappointed. "Since they won’t be of any use to me, I’ll send them back to their domain, and they can stay there until they die."

After his clone left the beast space, Zhang Fei sealed the cultivation of the four perils and sent them back to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain. He asked Xie Heilong and the others to take care of them.

A few hours later, all the evil beasts that had come to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain were dead. Long Wuzhao had everyone rest in his golden palace, and he ordered people to prepare a banquet for the guests.
Zhang Fei left his four clones and all his women there, and then he took Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan to the Slaughter Blood Domain to meet Shang Zhanluo.
Shang Zhanluo, who was chatting with Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui, was surprised by their sudden arrival.
"Zhang Fei?" Shang Luohu asked in surprise. "What brings you here today? Who are the two women with you?"
The last time they saw each other was half a year ago. At that time, Zhang Fei healed Shang Zhanluo, and he never came to their domain again even though Shang Luohu asked him to.
"I’ve been too busy in the past half year, so I haven’t had time to come here." Zhang Fei pointed to the two women. "They are Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, and they are demons like you."

Shang Zhanluo got down from his throne and approached Zhang Fei. "I’ve long wanted to meet you to express my gratitude. If it weren’t for you, I would still be under Sha Mo’s control, and he might use me to do things I don’t want."
