chapters.title: Chapter 1807: Zhang Fei Vs Shang Zhanluo I
paragraphs: Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui took a serious look at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, discovering that both women were demon gods like Shang Zhanluo. However, they had never known about any other demon gods besides the existing ten, which made them curious about the two women’s races and origins.
"You don’t need to thank me." Zhang Fei paused for a brief moment. "Honestly, I helped you because I have another purpose, and I came here today to discuss that matter with you."
Shang Zhanluo momentarily raised an eyebrow. "Did you come here to discuss your relationship with my daughter?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fei was momentarily taken back before looking at Shang Luohu, who nodded to him. "Do you want to meet your daughter?"

"Naturally!" Shang Zhanluo’s face turned excited and impatient. "My wife already told me that you freed my daughter from Mo Shentian’s control, and she also told me that you trained her in your private place from then on. I haven’t seen her for a long time, so I hope you’re willing to bring her here."
"Alright." After his clone sent Shang Xueli into the Yin-Yang Space, Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal and let her out of it.
"Xueli!" Shang Zhanluo shouted as he hugged his beloved daughter, leaving Shang Xueli stunned for several seconds.
Shang Xueli turned to Zhang Fei with a questioning look, as his clone didn’t explain anything to her, so she didn’t expect that he would bring her to see her father.
After Zhang Fei nodded, Shang Xueli hugged Shang Zhanluo back, rubbing her face against her father’s chest like a kitten. "Father, I missed you so much."
"I missed you too, Xueli." Shang Zhanluo hugged his daughter tighter. Even a powerful demon god like him couldn’t help but shed tears, feeling the warmth of his daughter’s body.
Gongsun Zhilan briefly glanced at them before whispering to Hua Qianmei. ’This asura demon god is much better than the one in our realm, right?’

’Yes,’ Hua Qianmei nodded slightly, but her expression turned annoyed when she remembered the Asura Demon God in the Ancient Realm. ’This man clearly loves his family, unlike Shang Jingyuan. That guy is so selfish, and he doesn’t hesitate to sacrifice his family members for his own interests. If I remember correctly, he handed his wife to Xing Zhixun because he was bored with her.’
Anger flashed in Gongsun Zhilan’s eyes. ’I’ve wanted to kill Shang Jingyuan for a long time, but he took the members of his race to a distant domain, and we’ve never seen each other since.’
’Forget it! We don’t need to care about him, and he won’t dare set foot in our domain again.’
’Yeah.’

After hugging his daughter for a while, Shang Zhanluo released Shang Xueli and rubbed her cheek. "Please forgive me, Xueli. I’m a useless father, and I couldn’t do anything when Mo Shentian took you away back then. I’ve heard everything from your mother, and I’m so glad you’re finally free from that hell."

"I never blame you for past events, Father." Shang Xueli wiped her tears, shaking her head at her father. "The most important thing is that I am free, and my life is much better now. Since Zhang Fei freed me from that hell, I’ve been training hard, and I can protect myself now."

Shang Zhanluo looked at Zhang Fei with a grateful and heartfelt expression. If it weren’t for him, his daughter would still be under Mo Shentian’s control, and she would have suffered even more because of it.
Zhang Fei didn’t think much of it. "Since you two are reunited now, it’s time we discussed my purpose in coming here."

Shang Xueli’s face turned worried, as she could guess Zhang Fei’s reason for seeing her father today. She wanted to say something to him, but she hastily shut her mouth the moment their eyes met. ’Sigh! I hope they won’t fight to the death today.’
Shang Luohu walked to her husband and asked. "Did you come here to ask us to join you?"
"Smart." Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu exchanged glances, thinking that the day had finally arrived. "At the moment, seven of the ten demon gods had already joined me, so—"
"What?" Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu screamed in shock at the same time.
"Since when did Sha Mo and Ku Shenzu join you?"
Zhang Fei created two qi screens that displayed two different images. One screen showed his actions towards Sha Mo and Sha Yuan, while the other showed his actions towards Ku Shenzu and Ku Biyun.
Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu were stunned when they saw the two qi screens, not expecting Zhang Fei to have defeated Sha Mo and Ku Shenzu.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan laughed at Shang Zhanluo’s and Shang Luohu’s shocked expressions. The two women were clearly stronger than the two asura demons, but Zhang Fei could easily handle them, let alone those demon gods from the Paradise Realm.

Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath. "Zhang Fei, you saved my daughter and gave her a chance to develop herself, so I have no problem joining you. However, I need something from you, and I hope you’ll be willing to fulfill my request."
"Tell me."
"Please hand over Sha Mo to me."
"I can’t fulfill your request." Zhang Fei’s rejection made Shang Zhanluo frown. "I can’t hand over Sha Mo to you because he is my future father-in-law."
Truly bizarre! Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu find it hard to believe that Sha Mo is Zhang Fei’s future father-in-law.
Shang Xueli spoke to her parents directly. "Father! Mother! All these years, I lived and trained with Sha Qingge, so Zhang Fei didn’t lie to you two."

Shang Luohu didn’t mind if Zhang Fei didn’t want to hand over Sha Mo, but her husband was different. Shang Zhanluo held a grudge against the Heavenly Fiend Demon because of his actions several years ago.
Shang Zhanluo clenched his fist until both of them were red, and the muscles in his face also bulged out.

"For me, my family members are untouchable, and I will kill anyone who dares to touch them. If you want to get Sha Mo, you must fight and defeat me first." Shang Xueli wanted to plead with Zhang Fei not to fight with her father, but Shang Luohu hurriedly stopped her and asked her not to interfere. "By the way, you should be able to sense the power of these two female demon gods, and they are far stronger than you, even though the three of you have the same cultivation and demon rank. If you choose to fight me, you will probably die by my hands, and your family will mourn your death."
Shang Zhanluo stole a glance at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, and he could see that both women were looking down on him, especially the latter.
"Would you like to try my poison?" Gongsun Zhilan asked with a playful smile. "For years, no one has been immune to my poison, and I dare guarantee that you will die within seconds."

Shang Zhanluo involuntarily shivered in fear upon hearing Gongsun Zhilan’s words. From their raw strength, he knew that she was much stronger than him, but he had never heard of her name or her abilities before. "Can you two tell me about your origins?"
"What do you think about that?" Zhang Fei responded to Hua Qianmei with a shrug. "I can tell you that neither of us are natives of this Paradise Realm, and our home is located in a higher realm."
"The Ancient Realm."
Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu looked at Shang Zhui, who had been silent all this time.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan also looked at Shang Zhui before turning their gazes to Zhang Fei. "I haven’t told Old Zhui about the Ancient Realm, but his son, Tian Shuixiang, already knows that I went there."
"I see." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan nodded in understanding.

Shang Xueli spoke to her parents again. "Actually, I’ve been cultivating with Zhang Fei’s demon wives in their domain for over a month now, and the qi there is much stronger than here. Besides, there are more than twenty demon gods there, and these two seniors are two among them."

"Husband." Shang Zhanluo looked at his wife. "I understand your feelings and your desire to take revenge on Sha Mo, but I think you should put that aside for the sake of greater interests, such as our daughter’s feelings."
Shang Zhanluo looked at his daughter, and he could see her silent plea in her eyes. After thinking about it, he looked at Zhang Fei again. "Fight me and defeat me."
"Are you sure about that?"
"Yes."
Zhang Fei nodded. "Let’s go to the training area then."
Zhang Fei and Shang Zhanluo were already standing opposite each other in the middle of the training ground.

"I know you’re strong, but you don’t need to hold back your strength, and I will use my best ability to spar with you." After saying that, Shang Zhanluo used his Bloodline Awakening technique, which caused his strength to increase severalfold. His eyes turned bloody red, a blood-red aura enveloped his body, and strange symbols appeared on his skin.
Seeing that, Shang Xueli clasped her hands tightly; she was truly frightened that Zhang Fei and Shang Zhanluo would fight to the death.
Shang Luohu embraced her daughter, understanding the fear in her heart. "Don’t worry, everything will be fine."
"I hope they won’t kill each other, Mother." Shang Xueli said with fear in her tone.

This time, Zhang Fei did not use the soul link, but he used the War God’s Berserk Method just like when he fought Shang Dongzhu seven months ago. A war god silhouette appeared behind him after he used the fifth sub-technique, the War God’s Descent. "Let’s fight."

sentences.text: Shang Luohu and Shang Zhui took a serious look at Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, discovering that both women were demon gods like Shang Zhanluo.
However, they had never known about any other demon gods besides the existing ten, which made them curious about the two women’s races and origins.
"You don’t need to thank me." Zhang Fei paused for a brief moment.
"Honestly, I helped you because I have another purpose, and I came here today to discuss that matter with you."
Shang Zhanluo momentarily raised an eyebrow.
"Did you come here to discuss your relationship with my daughter?"
"Huh?" Zhang Fei was momentarily taken back before looking at Shang Luohu, who nodded to him.
"Do you want to meet your daughter?"
"Naturally!" Shang Zhanluo’s face turned excited and impatient.
"My wife already told me that you freed my daughter from Mo Shentian’s control, and she also told me that you trained her in your private place from then on.
I haven’t seen her for a long time, so I hope you’re willing to bring her here."
"Alright." After his clone sent Shang Xueli into the Yin-Yang Space, Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal and let her out of it.
"Xueli!" Shang Zhanluo shouted as he hugged his beloved daughter, leaving Shang Xueli stunned for several seconds.
Shang Xueli turned to Zhang Fei with a questioning look, as his clone didn’t explain anything to her, so she didn’t expect that he would bring her to see her father.
After Zhang Fei nodded, Shang Xueli hugged Shang Zhanluo back, rubbing her face against her father’s chest like a kitten.
"Father, I missed you so much."
"I missed you too, Xueli." Shang Zhanluo hugged his daughter tighter.
Even a powerful demon god like him couldn’t help but shed tears, feeling the warmth of his daughter’s body.
Gongsun Zhilan briefly glanced at them before whispering to Hua Qianmei. ’This asura demon god is much better than the one in our realm, right?’
’Yes,’ Hua Qianmei nodded slightly, but her expression turned annoyed when she remembered the Asura Demon God in the Ancient Realm. ’This man clearly loves his family, unlike Shang Jingyuan.
That guy is so selfish, and he doesn’t hesitate to sacrifice his family members for his own interests.
If I remember correctly, he handed his wife to Xing Zhixun because he was bored with her.’
Anger flashed in Gongsun Zhilan’s eyes. ’I’ve wanted to kill Shang Jingyuan for a long time, but he took the members of his race to a distant domain, and we’ve never seen each other since.’
’Forget it!
We don’t need to care about him, and he won’t dare set foot in our domain again.’
’Yeah.’
After hugging his daughter for a while, Shang Zhanluo released Shang Xueli and rubbed her cheek.
"Please forgive me, Xueli.
I’m a useless father, and I couldn’t do anything when Mo Shentian took you away back then.
I’ve heard everything from your mother, and I’m so glad you’re finally free from that hell."
"I never blame you for past events, Father." Shang Xueli wiped her tears, shaking her head at her father.
"The most important thing is that I am free, and my life is much better now.
Since Zhang Fei freed me from that hell, I’ve been training hard, and I can protect myself now."
Shang Zhanluo looked at Zhang Fei with a grateful and heartfelt expression.
If it weren’t for him, his daughter would still be under Mo Shentian’s control, and she would have suffered even more because of it.
Zhang Fei didn’t think much of it.
"Since you two are reunited now, it’s time we discussed my purpose in coming here."
Shang Xueli’s face turned worried, as she could guess Zhang Fei’s reason for seeing her father today.
She wanted to say something to him, but she hastily shut her mouth the moment their eyes met. ’Sigh!
I hope they won’t fight to the death today.’
Shang Luohu walked to her husband and asked.
"Did you come here to ask us to join you?"
"Smart." Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu exchanged glances, thinking that the day had finally arrived.
"At the moment, seven of the ten demon gods had already joined me, so—"
"What?" Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu screamed in shock at the same time.

Zhang Fei created two qi screens that displayed two different images.

"Tell me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1808: Zhang Fei Vs Shang Zhanluo II
paragraphs: Hearing that Zhang Fei and Shang Zhanluo were going to spar, Shang Dongzhu and the three asura guardians rushed to the training ground. The sound of explosions and a strong wave of wind greeted them upon their arrival, pushing them back several steps.

Shang Dongzhu trembled when he saw the war god’s silhouette. When they fought seven months ago, Zhang Fei had also used that technique against him, which resulted in his crushing defeat. At that time, he suffered severe injuries, and seven months had passed since then, but he had not fully recovered.

Shang Nanzhui and the other two did not pay attention to the war god’s silhouette. Their gazes were completely on Zhang Fei and Shang Zhanluo, who were standing so close to each other, with their right fists colliding with each other.
They were shocked to see that Shang Zhanluo had already used the Bloodline Awakening technique, yet Zhang Fei was able to stand his ground and block his attack, which was unbelievable.

Shang Dongzhu’s face turned pale after witnessing that; he himself was unable to withstand Shang Zhanluo’s attack when he used his Bloodline Awakening technique, but Zhang Fei was able to do that without using his strengthening technique.

Shang Zhui and Shang Luohu didn’t show their shock on their faces, but they were truly shocked deep inside. They knew that Zhang Fei was powerful, but Shang Zhanluo’s attack, which utilized his Bloodline Awakening technique, surpassed many expectations, and Zhang Fei blocked it with his fist.
Unlike them, Shang Xueli was no longer surprised at Zhang Fei’s strength; he had defeated the two avatars of the primordial beasts, who had superior strength to her father.

Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, who were watching from the sidelines, only smiled at that. Over the past month, they had witnessed Zhang Fei hunting those mindless demons in the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon, so they were more or less familiar with his strength.

Shang Zhanluo’s eyes trembled as he looked at Zhang Fei in disbelief; he tried to push his hand forward, but he still couldn’t push him back. "Your cultivation is still at the Celestial Emperor Realm, but your strength far surpasses my expectations! I’ve already used my Bloodline Awakening technique, yet you can still withstand my attack."

Zhang Fei smirked and punched Shang Zhanluo’s fist, causing him to stumble several steps back. "You don’t need to be surprised by that because I’m an expert body cultivator, and my body cultivation level has reached the Divine Body Stage. Besides, I’ve mastered nine body cultivation techniques, and I’m also using my strengthening technique right now."

"Hmm?" Shang Zhanluo was shocked to hear that Zhang Fei mastered nine body cultivation techniques, which was unheard of before. As far as he knew, all body cultivators could only learn one body cultivation technique due to its complexity, and those who were talented in that cultivation path could learn two techniques, yet he mastered nine techniques. "How did you manage to master that much?"
"Because I’m special."
Shang Zhanluo became alert as soon as Zhang Fei disappeared from his sight. His eyes kept moving around, and he also spread his senses to track Zhang Fei’s movements.
Unfortunately, Zhang Fei’s speed had already surpassed that of a normal cultivator, as he had perfectly adapted to level eight gravity.
Although Shang Zhanluo was a demon god, he was a demon who relied entirely on physical strength, which made his speed as slow as a snail in front of Zhang Fei.
Even so, Shang Zhanluo’s fighting instincts were sharp, and he managed to block Zhang Fei’s surprise attack, though not completely.
Shang Zhanluo stabilized his body and activated his defense. A blood-red sphere enveloped his surroundings, and he tried to predict Zhang Fei’s next movement.
*Bam*
Shang Zhanluo staggered back again, and his blood-red sphere disappeared after being hit by Zhang Fei’s attack. ’Impossible! How could he destroy my blood sphere with just one attack?’
"Don’t think too much."
"Shit!" Shang Zhanluo wanted to spin around to block the next attack, but Zhang Fei’s attack was too fast and landed squarely on his back. "Gah!"
In that moment, Shang Zhanluo was sent flying forward and nearly hit the wall, but he immediately rolled in midair and planted his feet on it, causing it to crack.
Shang Zhanluo jumped down and looked at Zhang Fei, who was standing in mid-air a little distance in front of him.
Shang Zhanluo took a deep breath and spoke. "How about we end this spar using our strongest attacks?"
"How do you want to end it?"
Shang Zhanluo raised his right hand and clenched his fist. "Fist against fist."
"Are you sure about that?" Zhang Fei didn’t look down on Shang Zhanluo, but he was confident in his physical strength. If they really did that, he was afraid his opponent’s hand would be crushed.
"I’m sure." Shang Zhanluo unleashed his full strength and prepared to attack Zhang Fei. "If I lose, I will join you unconditionally, and I will hand over my daughter to you."
Hearing that, Shang Xueli blushed and lowered her head. In fact, she had long looked forward to becoming Zhang Fei’s wife, but he had no intention of making a move on her because of her father.
Shang Luohu looked at her daughter with a smile on her face. She caressed her daughter’s head. "Are you happy?"
"Uhm." Shang Xueli shyly nodded.

Zhang Fei’s lips twitched. "Your daughter has long been in love with me, and the outcome of our battle will not affect the situation. If I manage to defeat you, you must hand over your Asura Demon Race treasure to me."
"Eh?" Shang Zhanluo looked at Zhang Fei in surprise. "How did you know about my race’s treasure?"
"The Slaughter Blood Phantom told me about it."

Shang Zhanluo didn’t believe Zhang Fei because his race guardian couldn’t talk, and it didn’t know about the treasure either. He took out a blood crystal and showed it to him. "Actually, this treasure is not that useful, and it is just a symbol of being the leader of our race. If you defeat me, I will give it to you, and my race will follow you."
’Is it possible that the system will give me useless quests?’ Zhang Fei shook his head and unleashed his strength. "Let’s do it then."
"Let’s go!"
Zhang Fei and Shang Zhanluo flew towards each other, and their fists collided moments later.
*Boom*
The explosion from Zhang Fei’s and Shang Zhanluo’s attacks sent the four asura guardians flying and rolling backwards.
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan moved in front of Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli; they protected the two women from the effects of Zhang Fei’s and Shang Zhanluo’s attacks.
Moments later, they saw that the training ground had become a mess, and Shang Zhanluo was kneeling inside the crater while looking at Zhang Fei, who was standing above him.
"I lost." Shang Zhanluo manfully acknowledged Zhang Fei’s superiority, and he threw the treasure to him.
[Quest: Defeat the Asura Demon God.]
[Status: Done.]
[Quest rank: Abyss.]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x1 sent to the inventory.]
[Quest: Obtain Asura Demon Race Treasure.]
[Status: Done.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction after the two notifications appeared, indicating that all quests for the Asura Demon Race had been completed. He looked at the treasure for a moment before putting it into the inventory, and he threw a few pills to Shang Zhanluo. "Those pills will help you recover faster."
"Thank you." Shang Zhanluo immediately swallowed the pills, stood up, and wiped his blood.
"Husband!"
"Father!"
Shang Luohu and Shang Xueli flew quickly towards Shang Zhanluo, and they immediately checked his condition. They breathed a sigh of relief after finding that he hadn’t suffered any serious injuries.
Shang Luohu looked at Zhang Fei. "Thank you for not using all your strength; otherwise, my husband would have been seriously injured."

"You’re wrong about that, you know? I used all my strength in my attack just now, but I didn’t use my strengthening technique." Zhang Fei looked at Shang Zhanluo and continued. "Your husband is a fighter, and he is very proud of his strength, so he will be disappointed if I don’t use all my strength."

"Zhang Fei is right, wife. His attack just now used up all his strength, and I lost to him. If he had used his strengthening technique, I would have died on the spot." Shang Zhanluo patted his daughter’s head. "I wronged you in the past, but I won’t repeat the same mistake. From now on, you can follow him, and you must cultivate more diligently. When your cultivation has reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, I will pass on my power to you, and you will be the next leader of our race."
Shang Xueli looked at her father and blinked a few times. "Father, I’ve never thought about becoming the leader of our race, and I want to live my own life."
"But—"

"You have to impregnate my mother again, and your second child will be the next leader of our race." Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu smiled bitterly upon hearing that, but then Shang Xueli pointed to Zhang Fei. "If my mother has difficulty conceiving again, he can help you two make it happen."
Zhang Fei landed in front of them. "When do you want to impregnate your wife again?"
"Can you really help me get pregnant again?" Shang Luohu asked without getting her hopes up.
Zhang Fei shrugged. "One of my sisters-in-law is a female spirit, but I managed to help her get pregnant, and her son is quite old now."
Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu exchanged glances for a moment. "In that case, we need your help."
"Alright."

"I wronged you in the past, but I won’t repeat the same mistake.
From now on, you can follow him, and you must cultivate more diligently.
When your cultivation has reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, I will pass on my power to you, and you will be the next leader of our race."
Shang Xueli looked at her father and blinked a few times.
"Father, I’ve never thought about becoming the leader of our race, and I want to live my own life."
"But—"

"You have to impregnate my mother again, and your second child will be the next leader of our race." Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu smiled bitterly upon hearing that, but then Shang Xueli pointed to Zhang Fei.
"If my mother has difficulty conceiving again, he can help you two make it happen."
Zhang Fei landed in front of them.
"When do you want to impregnate your wife again?"
"Can you really help me get pregnant again?" Shang Luohu asked without getting her hopes up.
Zhang Fei shrugged.
"One of my sisters-in-law is a female spirit, but I managed to help her get pregnant, and her son is quite old now."
Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu exchanged glances for a moment.
"In that case, we need your help."
"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1809: Hu Tianlang, Huang Yuanzhi, and Xu Yuanzhi
paragraphs: In a realm, two men stood side by side; their expressions were ugly, a mix of indignant, frustrated, and embarrassed. The two men were none other than Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi.

They had deliberately exploited the Four Perils and their subordinates to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, hoping to obtain hostages to force Long Wuzhao and Zhang Fei to surrender. However, the alliance of all races defeated all their chess pieces, causing their plan to fail miserably.
They wanted to attack the domain directly, but they were truly terrified of Feng Yao. Furthermore, the memory of Zhang Fei defeating them more than two months ago was still fresh in their minds.

Although they were primordial beasts, they still found it difficult to understand Zhang Fei’s method to borrow Feng Yao’s strength, which boosted his strength to be on par with their two avatars. Additionally, they were still confused by the speed he had displayed that day, and they were unable to keep up with it.
"What are we going to do now? Those foolish four perils are no longer useful, and their strength will continue to decline until they become cripples."
Xu Yuanzhi thought deeply. "Since the four perils are no longer useful, we can only use our last key."
"The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God." Huang Yuanzhi muttered under his breath.

"That’s right." Xu Yuanzhi nodded. "Even though that beast hasn’t reached our level yet, he’s stronger than the four perils, and his middle eye ability is unique. We can’t find Zhang Fei’s hiding place because Shen Yuanzhi is protecting him, but I’m sure he’ll be able to find their hiding place using his abilities. However, I’m worried that the woman will appear and kill him."

Huang Yuanzhi shook his head. "Shen Yuanzhi’s cultivation has already reached the Supreme God Realm, and the universe will never allow her to stay in this realm. If she decides to appear, the universe will directly send her back to the Primordial Realm."

"That’s true." Xu Yuanzhi nodded in agreement. "It’s been more than two months since Shen Yuanzhi’s cultivation broke through to that stage, but she hasn’t ascended to our realm yet. Could it be that Zhang Fei was hiding her? But how could he do that?"
"I don’t have an answer to that question, and we have no choice but to use the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God to track their location."
"If that’s the case, we should go to his domain now, and we’ll force him to look for them."
"Let’s go."

"Two foolish beasts." Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi froze as soon as they heard the man’s voice; even their bodies visibly trembled. "Heh! You two are still so scared of me after we haven’t seen each other for so long."

"Hu Tianlang!" Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi screamed in shock as soon as they saw Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul standing in the air. Both of them were frightened by his appearance, and they thought of running away.

Hu Tianlang grinned. "Even though I’m long dead, this soul carries much of my past power, and it’s enough to destroy both of your avatars. However, I won’t do that because it would only spoil my fun, and I came to greet two old friends."
"What do you want from us?"

"As I said just now, I just want to greet two old friends." Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi didn’t buy that, and they believed that Hu Tianlang had a special purpose in appearing in front of them. "You’ve met my sole heir, right?"
Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi frowned. "So, Zhang Fei really is your sole heir, huh?"

"That’s right," Hu Tianlang admitted. "That kid is still weak now, but he is my soul heir. In the future, he will reach the same level as both of you, and you will have no choice but to submit to him when the time comes."
"Heh!" Xu Yuanzhi snorted. "Do you think that brat is you? Even if he’s your sole heir, I don’t believe he’ll ever reach our level."
"Even if he is your soul heir, he will never be able to become the next ten-tailed fox, so I also don’t believe that he will be able to reach our level." Huang Yuanzhi spoke confidently.

"Hahaha," Hu Tianlang laughed at their ignorance, but he had no intention of explaining himself to them. "I’d love to talk to you two a little longer, but I still have some other matters to attend to, so I won’t waste your time any longer."

After saying that, Hu Tianlang disappeared from Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi’s sight. Even though they didn’t believe that Zhang Fei would succeed in reaching their level, his words left many questions in their hearts.
"Do you think Hu Tianlang is hiding something from us?"
"That sly fox is always secretive, and his attitude clearly shows that he is hiding something from us."
"If his words are true, Zhang Fei might reach our level in the future, so we must eliminate him as soon as possible."
"Let’s go to that domain for now."
"Go!"
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had finished helping Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu. "You two will see the results soon, but I can’t guarantee the gender of your second child."
"It’s okay." Shang Zhanluo hugged his wife. "I hope our next child is a boy, but I don’t mind if it’s a girl."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I have to go back now, but I will leave Shang Xueli here for now."

"Thank you." After Zhang Fei took Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan away, Shang Luohu got off her husband’s lap and straightened her dress. "I’ve been waiting for our second child for a long time, husband."

"Haha," Shang Zhanluo stood up and straightened his clothes. "We just need to be patient for now, and we will have our second child in a few months. By the way, our daughter is waiting for us outside, so we have to meet her now."

When they arrived outside, Shang Xueli looked at them with a teasing smile. "Are you two satisfied, Mother? Bing Xingying managed to have a son with her husband because of Zhang Fei’s help, so I’m sure that you’re pregnant now."

"Let’s not talk about that for now, and we’ll see the results in a few days." Shang Luohu took her daughter’s hand. "Your father hasn’t seen you for a long time, and Zhang Fei won’t be picking you up anytime soon, so you should accompany us."
Shang Xueli herself missed her father so much, so she didn’t have a problem with that, and she went with them afterwards.

Upon returning to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, they saw leaders from all races and clans gathered in the golden palace. After Zhang Fei, Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan joined them, Long Wuzhao immediately ordered the palace staff to bring out all the dishes.

Long Wuzhao stood at the front of the table and raised a golden cup. "We will toast you all as a token of our gratitude. If it weren’t for your help, we definitely wouldn’t have been able to defeat the four perils, and many members of the beast race would have surely died."
Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, Feng Jinhuang, Feng Shizhu, and the others stood up one by one and raised their cups.
Zhang Fei and the others had no choice but to follow them, and they immediately raised a toast to celebrate their success in defeating the evil beasts.

After finishing, Zhang Fei spoke to them. "Although those evil beasts are no longer a threat to us, we still have another threat that is far more dangerous than them, and the two primordial beasts will probably use their final key against us soon."
"The Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God, Qian Yan."

"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "Qian Yan may hold the last rank among all demon gods, but in reality, he is the strongest among them. He is a demon beast god, and he has a special ability in his middle eye."
"What is the ability of the middle eye?"

Dong Xuanyin immediately answered Feng Jinhuang. "Qian Yan’s middle eye can see through all space, including the void. Apart from that, he has several other abilities that are no less terrifying, and one of them can imprison our souls without our knowledge."
"Oh? There’s a demon beast with that kind of ability in this realm, huh?" Everyone looked at Gongsun Zhilan, but she ignored them and looked at Zhang Fei. "Is that demon beast god immune to poison?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I’ve never met Qian Yan before, and he rarely appears in this realm, so I don’t have any information about his abilties. Besides, the two primordial beasts will probably be assisting him from behind, so we can’t underestimate him."
"Why didn’t you destroy both of their avatars, son?" Tianshi Bailong believed that Zhang Fei could defeat both Xu Yuanzhi’s and Huang Yuanzhi’s avatars.

Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "Father-in-law, I can’t destroy their avatars without borrowing Feng Yao’s power, and I’ll run into trouble if I borrow her true strength. Besides, I think they still have other avatars, so we can’t completely destroy them. I don’t know if Qian Yan is willing to carry out their orders, but we must be prepared for that possibility."
"What if Qian Yan chooses to carry out their orders?"

Zhang Fei looked at Feng Shizhu. "Honestly, I still don’t want to face Qian Yan in battle, but I have no choice but to fight him if he chooses to follow their orders. Right now, Wu Mian is helping me keep an eye on him, so I’ll wait to hear from him before I decide on my next move."
"Do you think we can defeat Qian Yan?

chapters.title: Chapter 1810: Qian Yan, Huang Yuanzhi, and Xu Yuanzhi
paragraphs: Zhang Fei looked at Feng Jinhuang. "Defeating Qian Yan is out of the question, but we must ensure that we won’t suffer too many casualties in the process. After all, we don’t have detailed information on all of his eye abilities, and he might have some abilities that he’s never shown to the public in the past."

"Don’t look at me." Dong Xuanyin shook her head at Feng Jinhuang, as did Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhu, and the other demon gods. "The main reason Qian Yan holds the last rank of the ten demon gods is because he never showed his true abilities. However, you should be able to guess his strength since Mo Shentian didn’t dare attack him, and the latter always avoided direct confrontation with him."

"In fact, I have fought with Qian Yan in the past, but I only lasted a few minutes in our fight." Everyone’s attention immediately fell on Jiu Moze. "I don’t know what kind of ability he used on me at that time, but I felt that I fought with him for hundreds of years. When I returned to my senses, I realized that only a few minutes had passed since our fight began, and my nine subordinates were already dead by my side. Even though he didn’t kill me, the gaze he gave me was full of contempt, disgust, and ridicule. Since then, I didn’t dare challenge him again, and I always avoided getting into trouble with him."

"Me too." Ku Shenzu joined in. "I tried challenging Qian Yan once, but I ended up losing miserably, and I suffered a heavy injury for several hundred years because of it. I don’t know what kind of ability he used on me back then, but I was already lying on the ground covered in blood when I regained consciousness, and all my internal organs were badly damaged. Fortunately, he didn’t cripple my cultivation; otherwise, my demon race would have perished for a long time ago."
"What about you?"

Sha Mo smiled bitterly at Zhang Fei’s question. "Like Jiu Moze and Ku Shenzu, I also fought Qian Yan in the past. At that time, he didn’t use his true strength or abilities, but I didn’t stand a chance against him from the start, and our fight ended with my crushing defeat."
"So, among the ten demon gods, only Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, my mother-in-law, and Wu Mian have never fought with Qian Yan, right?" Sha Mo and the other four nodded to Zhang Fei.

Dong Xuanyin suddenly remembered something. "Husband, the four perils once fought Qian Yan in the past, and he toyed with them. I don’t know the exact details of their fight back then, but he emerged victorious even though the four of them ganged up on him."

"Qian Yan is the most troublesome opponent in this Paradise Realm! Mo Shentian’s abilities are also troublesome, but they are nothing compared to his." Zhang Fei fell silent for a few minutes. "If I can’t find a way to fight him without bloodshed, I’ll ask Huo Ling to fight him."

Zhang Fei actually didn’t want to rely on Huo Ling to defeat Qian Yan, and he wanted to subdue him with his own abilities; only then would he submit to him completely. He had already fought with the illusion of the demon beast god in the Tower of Eternity, which gave him a little bit of understanding about some of his abilities.
Thereafter, the banquet continued with light-hearted discussions, including Zhang Fei’s plan to move all races to move to the Ancient Realm, which excited them.

After the banquet was over, Zhang Fei sent everyone back to their respective domains. Like before, he sent Long Wuzhao back to his beast space because the two primordial beasts were still targeting him, and he couldn’t stay in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain forever.
Zhang Fei sent Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, Gongsun Jiuxue, Mo Cangyue, Yuan Xiajie, Nalan Shizhe, and all his demon wives back to the Myriad Abyss Domain.

Zhang Fei’s demon wives, except for Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Dong Xuanyin, went to the secluded place to continue their cultivation. The rest went to the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon to continue looking for demon materials.
As for Zhang Fei’s other wives, they decided to enter the training space and carry out seclusion there.

One of Zhang Fei’s clones accompanied by Huo Ling went to the Frozen Yin Domain. He captured two female yin demons and took them to the training space, where four of his clones absorbed their yin qi and cultivated. As for his last clone, he was on standby in the Paradise Realm to anticipate the two primordial beasts’ next move.

"Hmm?" Qian Yan, who was sleeping, immediately opened his eyes as soon as he felt the appearance of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi. He was quite confused by their sudden arrival, and he immediately reverted to his human form. "Why did you come here?"

"I want you to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain." Qian Yan was slightly surprised by Xu Yuanzhi’s answer. "If you manage to capture Long Wuzhao for us, I will give you a good opportunity to improve yourself by taking you to the Ancient Realm."
"The Ancient Realm?" Xu Yuanzhi explained to Qian Yan some things about the Ancient Realm that caught his attention. "A realm higher than the Paradise Realm really exists, huh?"
"The Ancient Realm truly exists, but no cultivator from this Paradise Realm has ever been able to reach that place, except for one person."
"Who?"
"Zhang Fei."
"Who is he?"
"Zhang Fei is the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
Qian Yan had heard of the legend of Hu Tianlang, but he had never met him before. "Are you serious about that?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Xu Yuanzhi created two qi screens. One of them showed his previous meeting with Hu Tianlang, and the other showed Zhang Fei’s figure. "That male fox is Hu Tianlang, and the other is Zhang Fei."
Qian Yan squinted his eyes, observing Zhang Fei’s figure. "How could he know about the Ancient Realm and go there? Is it because he is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Apart from being Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, he has a close relationship with the strongest female cultivator of this Paradise Realm."
"Empress Huo Yanling." Qian Yan could immediately guess that because he himself was afraid of Feng Yao.
Xu Yuanzhi nodded. "That woman has many identities, and one of them is Shen Yuanzhi."
"Shen Yuanzhi?" Qian Yan had never heard that name before.
"You could say that Shen Yuanzhi is on our level."
Qian Yan took a deep breath as he stared at Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi. He knew that the two male beasts in front of him were powerful, but they didn’t dare attack him for some reason.
"Shen Yuanzhi showed Zhang Fei the path leading to the Ancient Realm, and they had already gone there several months ago."
Qian Yan was silent for a moment. "What is Zhang Fei’s relationship with Long Wuzhao?"

"Zhang Fei is Long Wuzhao’s ally, and they defeated us twice." Qian Yan was a little surprised. "Our first fight was a few months ago; he was helped by Shen Yuanzhi to defeat us. The second fight just ended, and the four perils were lost at his hands."
Qian Yan was shocked because he knew that Taotie and his three brothers were quite powerful. "Are the four perils dead?"
"They’re not dead yet, but they’re not far from their deaths."
Qian Yan thought about it deeply. "If Zhang Fei, Empress Huo Yanling, and Long Wuzhao succeed in defeating the four perils, doesn’t that mean you are sending me to die?"

"The situation has changed a bit, and that woman won’t be able to help them anymore." Xu Yuanzhi showed Qian Yan the process when Feng Yao’s cultivation broke through. "That woman’s cultivation has already exceeded the limits of this Paradise Realm, and she cannot appear in this realm again forever. Without her help, Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao don’t have enough strength to fight you, let alone defeat you."

"What do you mean by her cultivation has exceeded the limits of this Paradise Realm?" After all, none of the cultivators in the Paradise Realm knew the stages of cultivation after the Five Celestial Realms, including Qian Yan.
Huang Yuanzhi, who had been silent for a long time, immediately spoke. "Why do you ask so many questions?"

"Heh! Both of your avatars are indeed stronger than me, but you won’t be able to defeat me like you defeated the four perils." Huang Yuanzhi was furious with Qian Yan, but Xu Yuanzhi stopped him because the demon beast god was their final key. "I’m quite interested in the Ancient Realm, so I might help you guys capture Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao. However, I won’t help you two without valid proof, and I want you to take me to that realm first before I make a move on them."
Huang Yuanzhi snorted. "If you want to die, we’ll take you to the Ancient Realm."
"What do you mean by that?" Qian Yan narrowed his eyes.

"The situation in the Ancient Realm is unsafe, and many powerful creatures are roaming there." Xu Yuanzhi changed the image on the qi screen and displayed those shadowy creatures. "I don’t know their origins, but they have invaded many domains in the Ancient Realm and controlled many living creatures there. We can take you to that realm, but they will come for you as soon as you set foot there, and they will control you by taking over your body."
"In that case—"

"Wait." Xu Yuanzhi stopped Qian Yan. "According to our observations, those creatures are targeting Zhang Fei because he is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir. If you capture him, we will hand him over to them, and they will not attack you."
"Are you sure about that?"

I don’t know what kind of ability he used on me back then, but I was already lying on the ground covered in blood when I regained consciousness, and all my internal organs were badly damaged.
Fortunately, he didn’t cripple my cultivation; otherwise, my demon race would have perished for a long time ago."
"What about you?"
Sha Mo smiled bitterly at Zhang Fei’s question.
"Like Jiu Moze and Ku Shenzu, I also fought Qian Yan in the past.
At that time, he didn’t use his true strength or abilities, but I didn’t stand a chance against him from the start, and our fight ended with my crushing defeat."
"So, among the ten demon gods, only Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, my mother-in-law, and Wu Mian have never fought with Qian Yan, right?" Sha Mo and the other four nodded to Zhang Fei.
Dong Xuanyin suddenly remembered something.
"Husband, the four perils once fought Qian Yan in the past, and he toyed with them.
I don’t know the exact details of their fight back then, but he emerged victorious even though the four of them ganged up on him."
"Qian Yan is the most troublesome opponent in this Paradise Realm!
Mo Shentian’s abilities are also troublesome, but they are nothing compared to his." Zhang Fei fell silent for a few minutes.
"If I can’t find a way to fight him without bloodshed, I’ll ask Huo Ling to fight him."
Zhang Fei actually didn’t want to rely on Huo Ling to defeat Qian Yan, and he wanted to subdue him with his own abilities; only then would he submit to him completely.
He had already fought with the illusion of the demon beast god in the Tower of Eternity, which gave him a little bit of understanding about some of his abilities.
Thereafter, the banquet continued with light-hearted discussions, including Zhang Fei’s plan to move all races to move to the Ancient Realm, which excited them.
After the banquet was over, Zhang Fei sent everyone back to their respective domains.
Like before, he sent Long Wuzhao back to his beast space because the two primordial beasts were still targeting him, and he couldn’t stay in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain forever.
Zhang Fei sent Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, Gongsun Jiuxue, Mo Cangyue, Yuan Xiajie, Nalan Shizhe, and all his demon wives back to the Myriad Abyss Domain.
Zhang Fei’s demon wives, except for Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Dong Xuanyin, went to the secluded place to continue their cultivation.
The rest went to the Myriad Abyss Demon Dungeon to continue looking for demon materials.
As for Zhang Fei’s other wives, they decided to enter the training space and carry out seclusion there.
One of Zhang Fei’s clones accompanied by Huo Ling went to the Frozen Yin Domain.
He captured two female yin demons and took them to the training space, where four of his clones absorbed their yin qi and cultivated.
As for his last clone, he was on standby in the Paradise Realm to anticipate the two primordial beasts’ next move.
"Hmm?" Qian Yan, who was sleeping, immediately opened his eyes as soon as he felt the appearance of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi.
He was quite confused by their sudden arrival, and he immediately reverted to his human form.
"Why did you come here?"
"I want you to attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain." Qian Yan was slightly surprised by Xu Yuanzhi’s answer.
"If you manage to capture Long Wuzhao for us, I will give you a good opportunity to improve yourself by taking you to the Ancient Realm."
"The Ancient Realm?" Xu Yuanzhi explained to Qian Yan some things about the Ancient Realm that caught his attention.
"A realm higher than the Paradise Realm really exists, huh?"
"The Ancient Realm truly exists, but no cultivator from this Paradise Realm has ever been able to reach that place, except for one person."
"Who?"
"Zhang Fei."
"Who is he?"
"Zhang Fei is the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
Qian Yan had heard of the legend of Hu Tianlang, but he had never met him before.
"Are you serious about that?"
"Do I need to lie to you?" Xu Yuanzhi created two qi screens.
One of them showed his previous meeting with Hu Tianlang, and the other showed Zhang Fei’s figure.
"That male fox is Hu Tianlang, and the other is Zhang Fei."
Qian Yan squinted his eyes, observing Zhang Fei’s figure.
"How could he know about the Ancient Realm and go there?
Is it because he is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Apart from being Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, he has a close relationship with the strongest female cultivator of this Paradise Realm."
"Empress Huo Yanling." Qian Yan could immediately guess that because he himself was afraid of Feng Yao.
Xu Yuanzhi nodded.
"That woman has many identities, and one of them is Shen Yuanzhi."
"Shen Yuanzhi?" Qian Yan had never heard that name before.
"You could say that Shen Yuanzhi is on our level."
Qian Yan took a deep breath as he stared at Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi.
He knew that the two male beasts in front of him were powerful, but they didn’t dare attack him for some reason.
"Shen Yuanzhi showed Zhang Fei the path leading to the Ancient Realm, and they had already gone there several months ago."
Qian Yan was silent for a moment.
"What is Zhang Fei’s relationship with Long Wuzhao?"
"Zhang Fei is Long Wuzhao’s ally, and they defeated us twice." Qian Yan was a little surprised.
"Our first fight was a few months ago; he was helped by Shen Yuanzhi to defeat us.
The second fight just ended, and the four perils were lost at his hands."
Qian Yan was shocked because he knew that Taotie and his three brothers were quite powerful.
"Are the four perils dead?"
"They’re not dead yet, but they’re not far from their deaths."
Qian Yan thought about it deeply.
"If Zhang Fei, Empress Huo Yanling, and Long Wuzhao succeed in defeating the four perils, doesn’t that mean you are sending me to die?"
"The situation has changed a bit, and that woman won’t be able to help them anymore." Xu Yuanzhi showed Qian Yan the process when Feng Yao’s cultivation broke through.
"That woman’s cultivation has already exceeded the limits of this Paradise Realm, and she cannot appear in this realm again forever.
Without her help, Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao don’t have enough strength to fight you, let alone defeat you."

"What do you mean by her cultivation has exceeded the limits of this Paradise Realm?" After all, none of the cultivators in the Paradise Realm knew the stages of cultivation after the Five Celestial Realms, including Qian Yan.
Huang Yuanzhi, who had been silent for a long time, immediately spoke.
"Why do you ask so many questions?"
"Heh!

Both of your avatars are indeed stronger than me, but you won’t be able to defeat me like you defeated the four perils." Huang Yuanzhi was furious with Qian Yan, but Xu Yuanzhi stopped him because the demon beast god was their final key.
"I’m quite interested in the Ancient Realm, so I might help you guys capture Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao.
However, I won’t help you two without valid proof, and I want you to take me to that realm first before I make a move on them."
Huang Yuanzhi snorted.
"If you want to die, we’ll take you to the Ancient Realm."
"What do you mean by that?" Qian Yan narrowed his eyes.
"The situation in the Ancient Realm is unsafe, and many powerful creatures are roaming there." Xu Yuanzhi changed the image on the qi screen and displayed those shadowy creatures.
"I don’t know their origins, but they have invaded many domains in the Ancient Realm and controlled many living creatures there.
We can take you to that realm, but they will come for you as soon as you set foot there, and they will control you by taking over your body."
"In that case—"
"Wait." Xu Yuanzhi stopped Qian Yan.
"According to our observations, those creatures are targeting Zhang Fei because he is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir.
If you capture him, we will hand him over to them, and they will not attack you."
"Are you sure about that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1811: Qian Yan Plays Tricks
paragraphs: "We’re sure about that."

Even if they weren’t sure about it, Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi wouldn’t tell Qian Yan the truth that they didn’t know anything about those creatures, let alone tell him that they were afraid of them.

Qian Yan stared at them with his sharp eyes, thinking. He hadn’t met those creatures himself, so it was difficult for him to find any loopholes in their words. "Can’t Zhang Fei and Empress Huo defeat those creatures?"
"They are strong, but those creatures are much stronger than them."
"What about you two? Can you two defeat those creatures?"
Huang Yuanzhi smiled mockingly when Qian Yan asked that. "These avatars only have more than half our strength, but we can easily kill them if we use our real bodies."

Qian Yan himself didn’t know the depth of Xu Yuanzhi’s and Huang Yuanzhi’s true strength. However, he knew they were truly powerful, and while he couldn’t defeat their avatars, they couldn’t defeat him either due to his abilities. "Before we continue, tell me about the cultivation levels that exceed the limits of this Paradise Realm."

"The name of that stage is the Three God Realms, which is divided into three minor stages: God King Realm, God Emperor Realm, and Supreme God Realm." Qian Yan stared at the two men before him seriously, and he was certain that their cultivation was already at the final stage. "The three stages don’t have minor stages because each stage already requires a lot of qi. To break through from the Celestial God Realm to the God King Realm, we need more or less the total qi from the Celestial Lord Realm to the Celestial God Realm. From the God King Realm to the God Emperor Realm, the amount of qi we need is double that. From the God Emperor Realm to the Supreme God Realm, the amount of qi we need is triple that."
Qian Yan was completely shocked to hear that. "Is the Qi required to break through from the Celestial God Realm to the God King Realm really that much?"

"Haha!" Yu Yuanzhi laughed. "Do you now understand why no cultivator from the Paradise Realm has ever managed to reach that stage? The total amount of qi from the Celestial Lord Realm to the Celestial God Realm is extremely vast, and the universe has already limited the maximum cultivation level in this Paradise Realm. You will never be able to reach it even if you cultivate for your entire life, and your only hope is to go to the Ancient Realm."
Qian Yan frowned. "How can the universe limit cultivation in this Paradise Realm?"
"Actually, it is not the universe that limits it, but those hidden forces."
"Those hidden forces?"

Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi shook their heads at Qian Yan. "We can’t talk about them, or they’ll hunt us down. However, you should know one of them because it relates to the fate of all living beings."
"Fate, huh?" Qian Yan mumbled under his breath. "I’ll help you two capture Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao, but you have to take me to the Ancient Realm first; otherwise, you can forget about it."
"You—"

"You said yourselves that those creatures have invaded many domains in the Ancient Realm, which means they haven’t invaded all of them yet." Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi were furious. "There must still be many safe domains in that realm, right? Although I’ve never been to that realm, I’m sure there are many demon domains there, so you two should take me to one of them."
Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi exchanged glances for a moment. "In fact, there are not many demon domains in the Ancient Realm, but we know of one domain with the largest demon population there."
"What is the domain name?"
"The Myriad Abyss Domain."
"Show me the domain."

’Tch! This fucking demon beast! I really want to kill him!’ Despite his anger, Xu Yuanzhi changed the display on the qi screen to the Myriad Abyss Domain. "That’s the domain! There are dozens of demon gods there, and some of them are much stronger than you."
"Oh? Demon gods stronger than me, huh?" Qian Yan’s eyes brightened, and his face showed excitement. "How do we go to that realm? How long will it take us to arrive at that domain?"

’This bastard is trying to take advantage of us!’ Huang Yuanzhi really wanted to kill Qian Yan, but the demon beast god showed no fear at all. "There’s a portal connecting this Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm not far from your domain, but the people in this realm can’t see it."
"Where is the portal located?"

"The Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain." Qian Yan frowned again because that domain was the birth of the Four Perils and their subordinates. "You’re right about that, but we never told them about the portal, and we went to this realm through it."
"Does that portal connect us to the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
Xu Yuanzhi shook his head. "That portal will take us to the Raging Thunder Domain, and it normally takes us a month to reach the Myriad Abyss Domain, but I can bring you there in three days."

"We’re willing to compromise with you, but don’t think we’re afraid of you." Huang Yuanzhi’s gaze turned sharp. "Since we can take you to the Ancient Realm, we can also bring you back here by force. If you try to pull tricks on us, we will have no qualms about killing you."

Qian Yan responded to Huang Yuanzhi’s threat with a flat expression. "In that case, take me to that domain, and I’ll take a look at the situation there for a few days before returning to this realm. Once we return, I will go to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain to capture Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao. Do we have a deal?"
"You should take him to that domain."
Xu Yuanzhi nodded in understanding to Huang Yuanzhi, who immediately disappeared from the place. "Get ready! I’ll take you there soon."
After Xu Yuanzhi left, Qian Yan summoned his sons and daughters. Soon, several people, including Qian Yu and Qian Qin, arrived there. "Why did you summon us, Father?"

"Yu’er, I’ll be leaving our domain for a few days, so I need you to take over my position while I’m gone." Qian Yu was quite surprised to hear this, as Qian Yan had not left their domain for a long time. "I want you to prepare our race members for war, and we will attack the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain once I return."
Qian Yu and the others were shocked when they heard that. "Are we really going to wage war against the beasts of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Father?"

"Did you not hear what I said?" Qian Yan suppressed all his children with his aura, causing some of them to turn pale. "I am the demon god of our demon race, and my word is absolute. Even though you all are my children, I will never spare you if you dare to question my orders."
Qian Yu and the others shivered in fear. "We... we will carry out your orders today, Father."
"Leave!" They wasted no time and left the room, but Qian Yan suddenly stopped Qian Qin. "Qin’er, I have a task for you."
Qian Qin stopped in her spot and looked at her father. "What kind of task, Father?"
"Do you remember Zhang Fei?"
Qian Qin’s expression turned furious as soon as her father mentioned the name. "Father, I remember Zhang Fei, but what should I do with him? Besides, my brother is not his opponent, let alone me."
"Don’t you have your body?" Qian Qin stiffened as she stared at Qian Yan with wide eyes. "You have to seduce him using your body, and I will handle the rest."

Even though she had long known that Qian Yan only considered her and her siblings as his tools, Qian Qin still felt sadness and disappointment in her heart. "Do you know where Zhang Fei is now, Father?"

"If I’m not mistaken, he should be in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain now, so I’ll send you to that domain to look for him." Qian Qin became even more sad when she heard that; she felt that Qian Yan wanted to dispose of her. "Are you willing to accept the task?"

"Yes, Father." Qian Qin had no other choice but to accept the task; otherwise, Qian Yan would have killed her straight away. "However, I’m not confident that I will succeed in my task, and I will probably die at his hands."

"If he kill you, I will avenge you." Qian Yan moved in front of Qian Qin, touched her chest, and implanted something into her soul. After he finished, he immediately used his ability, and a portal appeared beside them. "Disguise your appearance and enter the portal."
If Zhang Fei were there, he would definitely be shocked to see the portal, as it resembled his warp portal ability.
Qian Qin touched the pendant around her neck, and her appearance instantly changed; even her demon aura disappeared. "I’ll go now, Father."
Qian Yan closed the portal and muttered to himself, "If she dies in that domain, then so be it. She’s the weakest of all my daughters, so I won’t be disappointed by her death."
After that, Qian Yan left his palace, and Xu Yuanzhi immediately took him to the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain.

Not long after they left, a male demon beast appeared in front of the palace and looked in the direction they were leaving. He was none other than the faceless demon god, Wu Mian, who controlled the body of the demon beast. "Sigh! That stupid demon beast is truly a heartless father, and he considers all his children as his tools."

chapters.title: Chapter 1812: Meeting Qian Qin Again
paragraphs: Xu Yuanzhi and Qian Yan had already arrived at the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, which shocked the latter.

Qian Yan was a demon beast god with a cultivation that had reached the upper limit of the Paradise Realm, but he couldn’t move as fast as Xu Yuanzhi. Normally, it would take him a month or more to arrive at the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain from his own domain, but the latter brought him to that domain in the blink of an eye.

Qian Yan followed behind Xu Yuanzhi, deep in thought. ’How strong would this guy be if he used his real body? His avatar only has more than half of his true cultivation, but his speed is already this fast. If he and his friend attack me using their real bodies, I will definitely die at their hands.’

Qian Yan was one of the ten demon gods, and he always displayed an arrogant attitude, even towards his children. However, for the first time in his life, he felt like he was nothing compared to Xu Yuanzhi.
Soon, they arrived at a remote area in the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain; even the four perils never knew about that place, even though they were the leaders of that domain.
Qian Yan momentarily raised an eyebrow as the portal appeared before them, but Xu Yuanzhi didn’t explain anything and led him into the portal.
After they disappeared, the place returned to normal, and the portal seemed to disappear by itself.

A male evil beast appeared there and scanned the area, but he was knocked back when he tried to touch the area in front of him. He was none other than Wu Mian, who controlled the bodies of many races. "I have to inform Zhang Fei about this portal."
As soon as they arrived at the Raging Thunder Domain, Qian Yan tried to absorb the qi there. He was elated after noticing the difference in quality and quantity of qi there compared to his own.
Xu Yuanzhu sneered in his heart at Qian Yan’s expression. "Let’s go! I’ll take you to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and we’ll arrive at that domain in three days!"
"Alright."
Qian Qin had just arrived at the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain; she was extremely nervous. She had never been to that domain before, and she was worried that the beasts could see through her disguise.

Qian Qin looked at the golden palace in the distance, thinking about how to infiltrate there. With her current cultivation, she was no match for the beasts living there, and she would die if they could see through her disguise.

"Long time no see." Qian Qin froze when she heard a man’s voice from behind her, and she could recognize that the owner of the voice was Zhang Fei. She jumped away as she turned to face him. "Haha! Did you miss me, Qin’er? We haven’t seen each other in eight months, right?"1
"I am not—"
"Your disguise can fool others, but you won’t be able to fool me." Zhang Fei [5] moved in front of Qian Qin and pulled off the pendant around her neck, revealing her true form.

As soon as the pendant came off, Qian Qin’s demon aura immediately spread out, and two male beasts appeared behind Zhang Fei. Her face turned deathly pale after she saw them; she didn’t expect that her cover would be blown before she made her move.
"Isn’t this girl Qian Yan’s daughter, son?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Tianshi Bailong. "Qian Yan sent her to seduce and capture me, but he didn’t realize that I had already done something to his daughter’s soul months ago, and I had known his plans from the start."

Qian Qin froze after Zhang Fei [5] said that, but she didn’t remember him ever approaching her or doing anything to her soul. After all, he erased her memories before returning to her domain, so she didn’t remember any details about their meeting in the forest.

"You don’t need to be afraid of me because I won’t catch you, let alone kill you." Zhang Fei [5] touched Qian Qin’s forehead and brought back her memories. Back then, he had copied her memories before he erased them, and he prepared them if they met again.
Within seconds, several memories appeared in Qian Qin’s mind, including memories of their intimate activities in the forest months ago. "Zhang Fei."
"Don’t worry," Zhang Fei [5] pulled Qian Qin into his embrace. "You’re safe with me, Qin’er."

Feeling the warmth of Zhang Fei [5]’s body, Qian Qin instinctively hugged him and cried aggrievedly. "My father never cared about me, Zhang Fei. He... he knew that this domain was dangerous for me, but he sent me here to die."

Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong exchanged glances for a moment, feeling sorry for Qian Qin because Qian Yan only saw her as a tool he could dispose of at any time. After all, they were fathers too, and they would never use their children for that kind of thing.
Zhang Fei [5] inwardly sighed as he listened to Qian Qin’s heartbroken cry. He pushed her back a little, lifted her chin, and kissed her.

"Zhang Fei," Zhang Fei [5] wiped tears from both of Qian Qin’s eyes. "Please take me away from this place. If I stay in this realm, my father will definitely find me and control me again, and I cannot refuse his order."

Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "I’ll take you somewhere, and your father shouldn’t be able to find you there. However, I haven’t moved there yet, and my people are building the place, so I can’t accompany you there."
"It doesn’t matter," Qian Qin replied with a shake of her head. "As long as my father can’t find me, I don’t mind living anywhere, even if I have to live alone."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong before opening the gate to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. He took Qian Qin and disappeared into it.
Tianshi Bailong released a soft sigh. "I didn’t expect that Xu Yuanzhi would bring Qian Yan to the Ancient Realm, Brother Xukong."

"Me too," Long Xukong nodded. "However, Zhang Fei said that Qian Yan won’t stay there for long, and Xu Yuanzhi will bring him back to this realm to attack us. We’ve just resolved our issues with the four perils, but we’ll have to face him and his demon race soon."
"Can we win against Qian Yan?"

"As long as Senior Huo Ling helps us, we should be able to defeat Qian Yan." Long Xukong was silent for a moment. "However, Zhang Fei seems like he wants to fight with him, but he is worried about his middle eye’s ability. Besides, there is still Mo Shentian, and that guy is also quite troublesome, especially with his ability to bend reality."
Tianshi Bailong nodded in agreement. "If Zhang Fei succeeds in defeating Mo Shentian and Qian Yan, this paradise realm will be completely peaceful, and we can focus on our cultivation after that.

"Yes." Long Xukong’s expression turned strange as he remembered the conditions for breaking through to the Three God Realms. "I’m not sure if we can break through to that stage, Brother Bailong. Empress Huo said that we can only break through to that stage if we go to the Primordial Realm, but we can’t go there with our strength. We have no choice but to rely on Zhang Fei, but he can’t possibly go there with his current strength."

Tianshi Bailong patted his brother’s shoulder. "For now, we don’t need to think about that, and we should focus on the matter at hand. Furthermore, our lifespan is still very long, so we don’t need to rush our cultivation."
"Let’s go back."
In the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, Zhang Fei [5] sat beside Qian Qin, who laid her head on his shoulder.
Qian Qin looked at the scene in the area below, where people from various races were building many things in the domain. "Is the domain really in the Ancient Realm?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "This domain was already destroyed and abandoned when I found it, but there are many remnants of the ancient civilization. All of those relics are useful for dual cultivators, so I decided to rebuild this domain, and I will bring all my people here in the future."
Qian Qin nodded in understanding. "Can my father find me in this domain?"
"Feng Yao told me that your father won’t be able to find you here as long as he stays in the Paradise Realm, so you don’t need to worry about him." Zhang Fei [5] said to calm her down.
Qian Qin looked up at him. "But—"

"I know your father left with someone, and that person brought him to this realm." Qian Qin was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] said that. "That person is Xu Yuanzhi, one of the two primordial beasts. He will take your father to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and they will arrive there in three days."
"How did you know about that?"

"Let’s just say someone helped me to keep an eye on your father, and he never noticed it." Zhang Fei [5] looked at her. "After your father leaves the domain, I will take you there, and you can cultivate in peace there.

Qian Qin nodded slightly, laying her head on his shoulder again. "Thank you, Zhang Fei. I was born to be a tool, and I always thought that I would never be able to escape my fate. If my father hadn’t sent me to the Tower of Eternity, I would never have met you, and I would never have experienced peace like this."
"No one is born to be a tool, but sometimes fate plays tricks on us." Zhang Fei [5] clenched his fist. "When I am ready to fight your father, I will free you from his control."

Qian Yan was a demon beast god with a cultivation that had reached the upper limit of the Paradise Realm, but he couldn’t move as fast as Xu Yuanzhi.
Normally, it would take him a month or more to arrive at the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain from his own domain, but the latter brought him to that domain in the blink of an eye.
Qian Yan followed behind Xu Yuanzhi, deep in thought. ’How strong would this guy be if he used his real body?
His avatar only has more than half of his true cultivation, but his speed is already this fast.

chapters.title: Chapter 1813: New Demon Items
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] took Qian Qin to one of the houses in the southern area of the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, allowing her to calm her mind first.
Zhang Fei [5] accompanied Qian Qin to rest while thinking about some things.
[I couldn’t find anything about the Asura Demon Race treasure, Master. I thought it could only be used by members of their race, but Shang Zhanluo didn’t seem to know its use.]

Zhang Fei [5] took the treasure from the system inventory and examined it seriously, but it looked like a junk item, which confused him. He believed that the Asura Demon Race couldn’t possibly keep a junk item and make it a treasure of their race, and he believed that it had a special purpose. "Do you think I should hand this thing over to Shang Xueli?"
[I think you can try it, Master. The item is useless for you because the quest has already been completed, and Shang Xueli is the princess of the asura demon race.]
"I’ll see Shang Xueli later." Zhang Fei [5] checked the system inventory and found many quest rewards in it. "Mei, open those rewards except for the rewards from the daily quests."
[Wait a minute, Master.]
[You obtained 1 Frost Moon Lotus Seed.]
[You obtained 1 Immortal Soul Crystal.]
[You obtained 1 Life Spring Water.]
[You obtained 1 Ancient Divine Tree Seed.]
[You obtained 1 Asura Ancestral Token.]
[You obtained 1 Asura Blood Origin Crystal.]
[You obtained 1 Asura Demon Battle Flag.]
[You obtained 1 Six Paths Asura Tablet.]
[You obtained 1 Asura Emperor Halberd.]
[You obtained 1 Celestial Ancestral Token.]
[You obtained 1 Celestial Blood Origin Crystal.]

Zhang Fei [5] read the item descriptions one by one. "The Frost Moon Lotus Seed is suitable for Zhang Yue, Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, and Yue Ningxue. However, the last three women are much stronger than my big sister, so I will give it to her."
"The Immortal Soul Crystal is one of the materials for upgrading the Demon Extermination Sword, right?"
[Yes, Master. However, you haven’t found the other four items, so you can’t upgrade your sword yet.]
Zhang Fei [5] sighed, as he had long wanted to upgrade his sword. "The life spring water?"
[The life spring water can increase your lifespan, but I don’t think it’s very useful. With your current cultivation, your lifespan is already tens of millions.]
Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Mei. The life spring water is indeed useless for him, but it is useful for mortals on Earth or low-level cultivators.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "The Ancient Divine Tree Seed?"
[Unfortunately, there are no clues about the Ancient Divine Tree Seed, Master. However, I think it’s similar to the Spirit Willow Tree, but there’s no clue where we should plant it.]
"Speaking of the Spirit Willow Tree, it’s been six and a half years since we planted it in the Jiangshen Domain, right?"
[Yes, Master. However, I’m sure the tree hasn’t grown yet, and it might take another few hundred years or a few thousand years to fully grow.]

Zhang Fei [5] remembered his conversation with the spirit of the Spirit Willow Tree several years ago, and it told him that the tree needed a long time to fully grow. That was why he never visited the Jiangshen Domain again, especially with the Ghost Emperor there.
Zhang Fei [5] felt that the Asura Ancestral Token was useless, but the Asura Blood Origin Crystal caught his attention. "I will get the Asura demon bloodline if I use the blood contained in it?"

[It seems so, Master. However, I think you don’t need that because you already have four forms and various kinds of beast bloodlines in your body. Instead of using it for yourself, I think you can give it to Ye Zhiye.]

Zhang Fei [5] felt a dilemma about it because the Asura demon bloodline was quite extraordinary. However, Mei’s words were true, and he already had too many bloodlines. Although Ye Zhiye was the Eternal Night Demon, Tian Shuixiang was the asura demon, and she was his wife.
Zhang Fei [5] considered giving the Asura Blood Origin Crystal to one of his wives, but he changed his mind on second thoughts and decided to give it to Ye Zhiye.
"The Asura Demon Battle Flag?" Zhang Fei [5] was curious about that. "Hmm? As long as the battle flag is on the battlefield, it will boost the strength of the asura demon race."
[The only woman who will be affected by the Asura Demon Battle Flag’s effects is Shang Xueli, unless you also take Shang Fengxue as your woman.]

"I never had any interest towards Shang Fengxue, so I would never take her as my woman." Zhang Fei [5] ignored the flag and took the Six Paths Asura Tablet. "Shit! This tablet is the true treasure of the Asura Demon Race, Mei! Back then, Tian Shuixiang told me about the Six Paths of Asura, but only Shang Zhanluo managed to learn it."
[Why didn’t Shang Zhanluo use it when he fought you, Master?]

Zhang Fei [5] read the tablet’s details thoughtfully. "Hmm? Shang Zhanluo didn’t use it because it had a deadly backlash, and he would probably be a cripple after using it. Since I’ve already decided to give the Asura Blood Origin Crystal to Ye Zhiye, I’ll give this tablet to her and Tian Shuixiang. However, I want you to copy it, so Shang Xueli can also learn it later, Mei."
[Are you really going to allow Shang Xueli to learn it, Master?]

"Even if Shang Xueli learns it, I will forbid her from using it unless she encounters a critical situation." Zhang Fei [5] was also not interested in the Celestial Ancestral Token, but the Celestial Blood Origin Crystal tempted him. "Do you think I’ll gain Mo Shentian’s abilities if I use the bloodline, Mei?"
[I don’t think so, Master. Even though you have the Celestial Demon Bloodline, you are not a pure Celestial Demon, so I’m not sure if you can obtain Mo Shentian’s abilities.]

Zhang Fei [5] thought that Mei was right, and he decided to give the Celestial Blood Origin Crystal to Morgana. After all, she had been married to Mo Tianshen for a long time, and her husband would replace Mo Shentian in the future. If they succeeded in taking over the Celestial Demon Race, they would become his subordinates.

Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "My business with the demon races in the Paradise Realm is almost done, right? After I defeat Mo Shentian and Qian Yan, I will go to the Radiance Domain to face Tian Qiye. After that, I will settle my affairs with the Divine Samsara Sect, the Huang Clan, and the Ouyang Clan."

[I think the Divine Samsara Sect, the Huang Clan, and the Ouyang Clan are no longer of any importance to you, Master. With your current strength, you can easily destroy them, so you can deal with them whenever you want. In the Paradise Realm, your toughest enemies are only Mo Shentian, Qian Yan, and Tian Qiye remaining. If you send Huo Ling, she will eliminate the three of them instantly.]

Zhang Fei [5] never doubted Huo Ling’s power, but he didn’t want to rely on her too much, which would only be detrimental to him. "Sigh! I will face them with my own abilities, and I will ask for her help if I can’t handle them."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was in his room in the pavilion with Puyang Yeyu, who looked tense. He pulled her onto his lap, hugged her waist, and kissed her. "Why are you so tense, Yeyu?"
"I’m not tense." Zhang Fei smirked and groped around Puyang Yeyu’s body. "Hahaha! Stop it! You tickle me!"
"Are you really ready, Yeyu?"
Puyang Yeyu looked at Zhang Fei, wrapping her arms around his neck. "The first time we met was half a year ago, and I was forced to pretend to be asleep while you treated me."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed. "Do you think I didn’t know you were pretending to be asleep then?"

"Humph!" Puyang Yeyu huffed. "You’re much younger than me, and that was the first day we met. Moreover, I’m a virgin, yet you saw my naked upper body. Even if you did it to treat me, I feel uncomfortable with it. Tell me honestly, you could actually treat me without taking off my top, right?"
Zhang Fei rubbed his nose. "You’re right, I can treat you without removing your top."
"I knew it!" Puyang Yeyu screamed, pinching Zhang Fei’s waist. "You deliberately took off my top because you wanted to take advantage of me!"
"Hiss!" Zhang Fei grimaced. "Stop! Don’t pinch me that hard! I was wrong!"

Puyang Yeyu pouted her lips; she naturally knew that Zhang Fei was pretending to be in pain. "After that, you took me into the dream space, and we lived together there for a year. From that day on, I unconsciously began to like you, and I always waited for you to come to me again. Even though I had to wait a month and a half, my wait was worth it."
"Does that mean you’ve fallen in love with me completely now?"

"I do," Puyang Yeyu admitted with a smile. "After that, you brought me to this training space, and a year and a half has passed since then. At first, I was hesitant to get into a relationship with you because you were too young, but now I can say that I’m ready to be your wife."
"Are you really okay with sharing me with so many women?"

Puyang Yeyu sighed. "I’ve never done that with you, but I’ve heard a lot about you from your other wives, especially regarding your prowess in that regard. If they didn’t share you with so many of them, they wouldn’t be able to handle you because you’re too wild."
"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled and laid her on the bed. "Why don’t you try my prowess in that regard yourself?"
