Mo Qingwen and the other demon gods understood Zhang Fei [5]’s intentions, and they immediately went to prepare some things.
Three days passed quickly.
Xu Yuanzhi and Qian Yan had already arrived at the Myriad Abyss Domain, but the former had no intention of entering.
"You can go by yourself, and you must contact me in a few days."
"Alright." After Xu Yuanzhi disappeared, Qian Yan released his demon aura and entered the domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1817: Anticipating Enemy Movements
paragraphs: After Qian Yan entered the Myriad Abyss Domain, Xu Yuanzhi reappeared in his original position, and a slight smirk formed on his face. "Heh! Even though that brat was deliberately concealing his aura, I could still feel his presence in this domain. Sooner or later, that stupid demon beast will meet him, and they can fight in there."
"Do we need to enter the domain?" Xu Yuanzhi turned to Huang Yuanzhi, who had just arrived. "I arrived in this domain before you two, and I can sense Zhang Fei’s presence here."

Xu Yuanzhi wasn’t surprised to hear that. "For now, we don’t need to make a move against Zhang Fei, and we should leave matters here to that stupid beast. If we make a move now, I’m afraid those creatures will come to us, and we’ll have a hard time dealing with them."
"We—" Huang Yuanzhi stopped talking and looked far away. "Damn it! They found us!"
"Stop talking and leave!" Xu Yuanzhi grabbed Huang Yuanzhi’s collar and flew away at full speed.

Shortly after the two primordial beasts left, several shadowy creatures appeared outside the domain. They sniffed the two beasts’ scent before following them. However, one of them didn’t immediately follow and stared intently at the domain, sensing something familiar from it.
The creature tried to break through the barrier protecting the domain several times to no avail. Eventually, it gave up and followed the others to chase Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi.

Unknown to everyone, Zhang Fei [5] was hiding outside the domain using his invisibility ability. After they left, he canceled his invisibility, and two women stood beside him, who were none other than Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan.
"Are those two men just now those primordial beasts?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded to Gongsun Zhilan. "The white-haired one is Huang Yuanzhi, and he is the Primordial Genesis Beast. The black-haired one is Xu Yuanzhi, and he is the Primordial Nihility Beast."
"Even though they were just their avatars, their presence and aura gave me pressure." Hua Qianmei turned to Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you know their true strength?"

"I’ve never met their true bodies before, so I don’t know their true strength. However, Feng Yao said that they could destroy all the domains in this Ancient Realm in a single attack, so you should have an idea of their true strength." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan swallowed their saliva after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "They are just their avatars, but all the demon gods in this domain won’t be able to defeat them, and you guys will die at their hands."
The Dream Demon God, Tang Zhiyao, suddenly appeared in front of them using her ethereal body. "Did you ever defeat them?"

"I fought them once, and I managed to drive them out of the Paradise Realm." The three female demon gods were shocked to hear this. "However, my strength was insufficient to fight them, and I had to borrow Feng Yao’s strength to defeat them that time."
"How did you borrow that woman’s strength?"

"That’s my secret." Zhang Fei [5] winked at Tang Zhiyao, causing her to pout. However, the three female demon gods’ expressions turned to shock as soon as he activated the soul link; his strength surpassed theirs by borrowing Feng Yao’s power. "Are you guys surprised?"
The three female demon gods nodded several times, as they were truly shocked by the sudden increase in Zhang Fei [5]’s strength. "What level is your current strength at?"

"Feng Yao’s cultivation is at the Supreme God Realm, but I just borrowed a little of her strength, and my current strength is at the God King Realm." Zhang Fei [5] explained to them about the Three God Realms. "You guys must want to reach that stage, right? Unfortunately, it’s impossible to reach that stage in this Ancient Realm, and you have to go to a higher realm to reach it, which is the home of the two primordial beasts."
"The Primordial Realm, right?"

"That’s right," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Even though the cultivation of the three of you is stuck in the Celestial God Realm, you are still several times stronger than cultivators in the Paradise Realm."
Hua Qianmei thought for a moment before asking him. "Since you were able to go to this Ancient Realm from the Paradise Realm, you should know the way to go to the Primordial Realm, right?"

"I don’t know about that, but Feng Yao knows." The three female demon gods wanted to ask again, but Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at them. "She won’t be taking me to the Primordial Realm anytime soon, but she will take me there after my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm in the future. If you guys want to go to that realm, I will take you there in the future, but you must be patient for that because my cultivation is still far from that stage."
"When did your cultivation break through to the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm?"

"About two years ago," Zhang Fei [5]’s answer made the three female demon gods sigh heavily. As experienced cultivators who had already passed that stage, they knew that he would still need a long time to break through again. "The Qi I need to break through to the next stage is much more than that of ordinary cultivators, so I can’t reach that stage quickly. Even if I enter seclusion now, I need a few more years to reach that stage, so you three will have to wait patiently."

The three female demon gods couldn’t say anything, and they could only patiently wait for Zhang Fei [5] to reach the Celestial God Realm because he was the only person who could bring them to the Primordial Realm.
"Gui Ye and the other demon gods must have noticed Qian Yan’s presence, and they will probably meet him soon."
Zhang Fei [5] had anticipated this matter from the start, but he wasn’t too worried about those demon gods, and he had already prepared a plan to prevent them from meeting Qian Yan. "Ling’er."
"Do you want me to watch and stop them, husband?" Huo Ling asked after leaving Zhang Fei [5]’s body.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "I don’t want Qian Yan to notice my presence in this domain, so I leave the matters of the demon gods to you. If they want to meet him, you must immediately stop them, and vice versa."
"Why don’t you let me beat up Qian Yan? That way, you don’t have to worry about him, and you can focus on other matters."
Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "In the Paradise Realm, my only remaining opponents are Mo Shentian and Qian Yan, remember? If you defeat them both for me, how can I improve myself?"
"Alright, I won’t touch Qian Yan, and you can defeat him yourself in the future." After saying that, Huo Ling immediately entered the domain and monitored all the demon gods from afar.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Tang Zhiyao. "Can you imprison other people in dreams?"

"I can do that, but I’m not sure if I can do it against Qian Yan. I haven’t seen his abilities yet, but I can infer from your previous explanation." Tang Zhiyao asked him in turn. "Don’t you also have the dream ability? Why don’t you do it yourself?"

Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "I can only use my dream lordship ability up close, and I have to touch my target first before I can use it. Additionally, I am unsure whether my ability will affect Qian Yan, so I prefer not to appear in front of him, as he might lock onto my aura."
"I see." Tang Zhiyao nodded in understanding. "What exactly is the effect of your dream lordship ability? Is it similar to my dream technique?"

"If I use that ability, I have total authority and control over the dream world, including normal dreams, nightmares, and daydreams. I can dreamwalk and manipulate people’s dreams, and I can also imprison people’s subconscious within the dream." Zhang Fei [5]’s description made Tang Zhiyao think that their two abilities were almost similar but also different at the same time. "If you want to know the effect of my ability, you have to bring your real body out so I can use it on you. You can also use my ability on me, so we can compare the two."

Tang Zhiyao thought about it for a moment. "I’ll come see you in my real body in a few days, and we can use our abilities on each other at that time. I’ll leave now, and I’ll watch over Qian Yan for you."
"Alright," Zhang Fei [5] opened a warp portal before saying to Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan. "You two should return to the dungeon now, and I will pick up someone in the Paradise Realm."

After the two women left, Zhang Fei [5] went to the Slaughter Blood Domain to pick up Shang Xueli. He didn’t spend much time there, and he took her to Hua Qianmei’s secret place to continue her cultivation.

Zhang Fei [5] monitored Qian Yan’s movements from the system map, and he found him going to a city that was the residence of one of the demon gods of that domain. "Yan Washeng, huh? I’ll contact him and ask him to be careful of Qian Yan."

After contacting Yan Washeng, Zhang Fei [5] went to the dungeon to continue searching for the demon materials. Wu Zu had long since finished concocting the Demon Soul Elixir, but he had yet to obtain one of the other four items.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei brought Puyang Yeyu back to the Puyang Clan to meet Puyang Shenmi and Puyang Zong. "Why are you acting so shy, wife?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1818: Liao Hanxue Prepare Two Formations
paragraphs: "I’m not—"
"Little Sister! Zhang Fei!"
Zhang Fei and Puyang Yeyu looked at Puyang Zong, who was flying towards them. Just as he landed in front of them, he was stunned by the change in his sister, who looked more mature than before.
"You two—"
"Brother, Zhang Fei is your brother-in-law now."

Puyang Zong had long known that Zhang Fei wanted his sister to be his wife, and Puyang Yeyu had responded positively. She even decided to live with him, but he never expected that they would become husband and wife in just half a year.

Unfortunately, Puyang Zong knew nothing about Zhang Fei’s dream lordship ability or the timeflow in his training space. In his eyes, Puyang Yeyu had only known him for half a year, but in fact they had been together for more than two and a half years.
"Brother?"

Puyang Zong shook his head slightly before grabbing Puyang Yeyu’s shoulder. "Even though I was surprised by the rapid progress of your relationship, I’m glad that you’ve finally found your happiness, and I hope you will never be disappointed with your choice. After all, Zhang Fei has over a hundred wives, and he has to divide his time between them, so he—"
"You don’t need to worry about that, Brother." Puyang Yeyu held Zhang Fei’s hand. "My husband does have more than a hundred wives, but he also has five clones."
"Huh?" Puyang Zong looked at Zhang Fei in shock. "Does that mean you divide them with your clones?"
Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "My five clones and I each have our own wives, brothers-in-law. Although the six of us are essentially one person, we never touch each other’s wives."
"Does that mean my sister is the wife of your real body?"
"That’s for sure."
"I see." Puyang Zong nodded in understanding. "Yeyu is my only sister, and she chose you as her husband, so I hope you will never disappoint her."
"I promise you, I will never disappoint her, brother-in-law."
"Then, you two—"

"We don’t want to have children right now, brother," Puyang Yeyu interrupted. "There are still many dangers in this universe, and we fear that our enemies will target our children, so we decided to postpone having kids. When this universe is safe, my husband will impregnate me, and we will have two children."

Puyang Zong was a little disappointed after hearing that because he and his sister were quite old, so he wanted to have a nephew or a niece as soon as possible. "Since you two have made that decision, I will not interfere and will wait a little longer to have a niece or nephew. You two are going to meet our grandmother, right?"
"Yes."
"If that’s the case, you two should go to the secret chamber to meet her, and I’ll go take care of other business."
After Puyang Zong left, Puyang Yeyu led Zhang Fei to the secret chamber to meet Puyang Shenmi. "Your brother seems disappointed that we’ve delayed having children, wife."

"My brother has long wanted to have a nephew or niece from me, but I never planned to get married in the past." Puyang Yeyu looked at him. "If it weren’t for you, I definitely wouldn’t have gotten married. Since we’re together now, it’s natural that my brother wants me to have children soon."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Where are your brother’s wife and children?"
"They live in an area far from the clan, and they rarely interfere in clan affairs."
"I see."
"Grandmother!"

Puyang Shenmi, who was cultivating, immediately opened her eyes. She wasn’t surprised to see Puyang Yeyu hugging Zhang Fei intimately, but she was surprised by the change in her aura, and she realized that she had become a grown woman.
"Congratulations, Yeyu. You’ve finally made a decision about your future, and you’ve become his wife." Puyang Shenmi looked at Zhang Fei. "Please protect and make her happy."
Zhang Fei hugged Puyang Yeyu’s waist. "Don’t worry, Grandmother. I will always protect her, and I will also make her happy."
"I believe you." Puyang Shenmi examined Puyang Yeyu’s body, but she couldn’t find any signs of life inside her womb. "When do you two plan to have children?"
Zhang Fei and Puyang Yeyu exchanged glances with wry smiles. "Grandmother, I will impregnate her when the universe is safe, so our child will live freely and safely."

"Since you two have already decided like that, I can only wait until the time comes." Puyang Shenmi took out two white jades and handed them to them. "These two jades may look ordinary, but someone helped me implant a defensive formation into them. I’ve long prepared them for you and your husband, and the formation within is powerful enough to protect you both from those shadowy creatures."
"Thank you, Grandmother."
Since Puyang Yeyu previously told him that she wanted to speak alone with Puyang Shenmi, Zhang Fei decided to leave the place. "I will go to meet Liao Hanxue and the others first."
"Are you happy with your decision, Yeyu?" Puyang Shenmi asked after Zhang Fei left.

"Hehe," Puyang Yeyu sat beside Puyang Shenmi and hugged her. "I’ve never felt this happy in my life, Grandmother. Zhang Fei had so many women, but all of them were good women, and I have a good relationship with them now. They shared their experiences with me, and they also taught me many things I never knew before."
Puyang Shenmi patted her head. "As long as you are happy, I will also be happy for you. What about Zhang Fei’s problems in the Paradise Realm?"
"Sigh! We haven’t taken care of the four perils for long, but we’ll be facing new enemy soon."
"A new enemy?"

"Qian Yan is a demon beast god, and he has terrifying eye abilities, especially his middle eye." Puyang Yeyu explained everything she knew about the demon beast to Puyang Shenmi. "That demon beast is in the Myriad Abyss Domain now, but Zhang Fei doesn’t have the confidence to face him with his own strength yet. He told me that two primordial beasts came to that beast, and they asked them to capture him and Long Wuzhao."
"Doesn’t Zhang Fei have Senior Huo Ling and Senior Feng Yao by his side? Even if he doesn’t have the strength to face Qian Yan yet, they should be able to help him deal with that beast."
Puyang Yeyu sighed. "Zhang Fei is quite stubborn, Grandmother. He doesn’t want to rely on Sister Huo and Sister Feng to deal with Qian Yan, and he wants to defeat him with his own strength."

"Zhang Fei is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, and he will become the ten-tailed fox in the future, so it’s natural for him to act like that." Puyang Yeyu agreed with Puyang Shenmi. "If he needs help like last time, I’ll send some people over. If necessary, I’ll step in myself, and I’m confident that I can defeat that beast. What is that demon beast doing in the Myriad Abyss Domain?"

Puyang Yeyu shook her head. "Zhang Fei doesn’t know Qian Yan’s purpose for going to that domain yet, and he only arrived there today. By the way, I will stay here for a few days to keep you company, Grandmother."
"Haha," Puyang Shenmi laughed. "You’re Zhang Fei’s wife, so you should be accompanying him instead of this old woman."

Puyang Yeyu pouted her lips. "Look at your appearance, Grandmother. You don’t look old at all after taking Zhang Fei’s beauty pills; instead, you look as young as me. Have you ever thought about remarrying?"
"No," Puyang Shenmi shook her head. "I already have several children and grandchildren, and I’m satisfied with my current life."
Puyang Yeyu looked at her seriously. "Even though you already have several children and grandchildren, your life will be boring without a man by your side."
"Foolish child." Puyang Shenmi rubs her granddaughter’s head. "The only thing missing in my life is your child, and I can’t wait for the day to come."
Puyang Yeyu inwardly sighed, and she shifted their conversation.
"Zhang Fei!" Liao Hanxue shouted out. "When did you arrive at this clan?"
"Just now." Zhang Fei approached Liao Hanxue, seeing the many papers scattered on her table. "Have you found any suitable formations to use in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley?"

"Wait." Liao Hanxue searched through the papers before taking out two. "Here! These two formations are suitable for our use in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and those creatures will never be able to enter that domain without permission. The first formation functions as a barrier, and the second formation functions as defense and attack."
Zhang Fei looked at Liao Hanxue’s notes on the two papers seriously. "Isn’t the first formation similar to the formation in this clan?"
"Yes," Liao Hanxue nodded. "I used this clan’s formation as the basis, but I added several things to this formation, and it will become two times stronger than the original."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "What about the materials?"

"Hehehe," Liao Hanxue took out some materials from her storage ring. "I already have three-quarters of the materials, and the people from this clan are helping me find the last two. If they manage to get both, we can go to that domain to set up the formation. No one can enter without permission, so you can finalize your plan to move the people from the Paradise Realm to that domain."
"You work so fast! Truly worthy of being a rank 10 array master!" Liao Hanxue put on a smug smile. "Then, what about the second formation?"

Liao Hanxue sighed in disappointment. "I haven’t found any materials to set up the second formation, but that’s okay because the first formation is enough to protect the domain, and I will continue searching for the materials for the second formation."
"It’s okay, you can look for them slowly." Then, Zhang Fei asked her. "Do you want me to bring Zhuxian Sheng here?"
"Yes! Please bring him here!"

"There are still many dangers in this universe, and we fear that our enemies will target our children, so we decided to postpone having kids.
When this universe is safe, my husband will impregnate me, and we will have two children."
Puyang Zong was a little disappointed after hearing that because he and his sister were quite old, so he wanted to have a nephew or a niece as soon as possible.
"Since you two have made that decision, I will not interfere and will wait a little longer to have a niece or nephew.
You two are going to meet our grandmother, right?"
"Yes."
"If that’s the case, you two should go to the secret chamber to meet her, and I’ll go take care of other business."
After Puyang Zong left, Puyang Yeyu led Zhang Fei to the secret chamber to meet Puyang Shenmi.
"Your brother seems disappointed that we’ve delayed having children, wife."
"My brother has long wanted to have a nephew or niece from me, but I never planned to get married in the past." Puyang Yeyu looked at him.
"If it weren’t for you, I definitely wouldn’t have gotten married.
Since we’re together now, it’s natural that my brother wants me to have children soon."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Where are your brother’s wife and children?"
"They live in an area far from the clan, and they rarely interfere in clan affairs."
"I see."
"Grandmother!"
Puyang Shenmi, who was cultivating, immediately opened her eyes.
She wasn’t surprised to see Puyang Yeyu hugging Zhang Fei intimately, but she was surprised by the change in her aura, and she realized that she had become a grown woman.
"Congratulations, Yeyu.
You’ve finally made a decision about your future, and you’ve become his wife." Puyang Shenmi looked at Zhang Fei.
"Please protect and make her happy."
Zhang Fei hugged Puyang Yeyu’s waist.
"Don’t worry, Grandmother.
I will always protect her, and I will also make her happy."
"I believe you." Puyang Shenmi examined Puyang Yeyu’s body, but she couldn’t find any signs of life inside her womb.
"When do you two plan to have children?"
Zhang Fei and Puyang Yeyu exchanged glances with wry smiles.
"Grandmother, I will impregnate her when the universe is safe, so our child will live freely and safely."
"Since you two have already decided like that, I can only wait until the time comes." Puyang Shenmi took out two white jades and handed them to them.
"These two jades may look ordinary, but someone helped me implant a defensive formation into them.
I’ve long prepared them for you and your husband, and the formation within is powerful enough to protect you both from those shadowy creatures."
"Thank you, Grandmother."
Since Puyang Yeyu previously told him that she wanted to speak alone with Puyang Shenmi, Zhang Fei decided to leave the place.
"I will go to meet Liao Hanxue and the others first."
"Are you happy with your decision, Yeyu?" Puyang Shenmi asked after Zhang Fei left.
"Hehe," Puyang Yeyu sat beside Puyang Shenmi and hugged her.
"I’ve never felt this happy in my life, Grandmother.
Zhang Fei had so many women, but all of them were good women, and I have a good relationship with them now.
They shared their experiences with me, and they also taught me many things I never knew before."
Puyang Shenmi patted her head.
"As long as you are happy, I will also be happy for you.
What about Zhang Fei’s problems in the Paradise Realm?"
"Sigh!
We haven’t taken care of the four perils for long, but we’ll be facing new enemy soon."
"A new enemy?"
"Qian Yan is a demon beast god, and he has terrifying eye abilities, especially his middle eye." Puyang Yeyu explained everything she knew about the demon beast to Puyang Shenmi.
"That demon beast is in the Myriad Abyss Domain now, but Zhang Fei doesn’t have the confidence to face him with his own strength yet.
He told me that two primordial beasts came to that beast, and they asked them to capture him and Long Wuzhao."
"Doesn’t Zhang Fei have Senior Huo Ling and Senior Feng Yao by his side?
Even if he doesn’t have the strength to face Qian Yan yet, they should be able to help him deal with that beast."
Puyang Yeyu sighed.
"Zhang Fei is quite stubborn, Grandmother.
He doesn’t want to rely on Sister Huo and Sister Feng to deal with Qian Yan, and he wants to defeat him with his own strength."
"Zhang Fei is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir, and he will become the ten-tailed fox in the future, so it’s natural for him to act like that." Puyang Yeyu agreed with Puyang Shenmi.
"If he needs help like last time, I’ll send some people over.
If necessary, I’ll step in myself, and I’m confident that I can defeat that beast.
What is that demon beast doing in the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
Puyang Yeyu shook her head.
"Zhang Fei doesn’t know Qian Yan’s purpose for going to that domain yet, and he only arrived there today.
By the way, I will stay here for a few days to keep you company, Grandmother."
"Haha," Puyang Shenmi laughed.
"You’re Zhang Fei’s wife, so you should be accompanying him instead of this old woman."
Puyang Yeyu pouted her lips.
"Look at your appearance, Grandmother.
You don’t look old at all after taking Zhang Fei’s beauty pills; instead, you look as young as me.
Have you ever thought about remarrying?"
"No," Puyang Shenmi shook her head.
"I already have several children and grandchildren, and I’m satisfied with my current life."
Puyang Yeyu looked at her seriously.
"Even though you already have several children and grandchildren, your life will be boring without a man by your side."
"Foolish child." Puyang Shenmi rubs her granddaughter’s head.
"The only thing missing in my life is your child, and I can’t wait for the day to come."
Puyang Yeyu inwardly sighed, and she shifted their conversation.
"Zhang Fei!" Liao Hanxue shouted out.
"When did you arrive at this clan?"
"Just now." Zhang Fei approached Liao Hanxue, seeing the many papers scattered on her table.
"Have you found any suitable formations to use in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley?"
"Wait." Liao Hanxue searched through the papers before taking out two.
"Here!
These two formations are suitable for our use in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and those creatures will never be able to enter that domain without permission.
The first formation functions as a barrier, and the second formation functions as defense and attack."
Zhang Fei looked at Liao Hanxue’s notes on the two papers seriously.
"Isn’t the first formation similar to the formation in this clan?"
"Yes," Liao Hanxue nodded.
"I used this clan’s formation as the basis, but I added several things to this formation, and it will become two times stronger than the original."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"What about the materials?"
"Hehehe," Liao Hanxue took out some materials from her storage ring.
"I already have three-quarters of the materials, and the people from this clan are helping me find the last two.
If they manage to get both, we can go to that domain to set up the formation.
No one can enter without permission, so you can finalize your plan to move the people from the Paradise Realm to that domain."
"You work so fast!
Truly worthy of being a rank 10 array master!" Liao Hanxue put on a smug smile.
"Then, what about the second formation?"
Liao Hanxue sighed in disappointment.

"I haven’t found any materials to set up the second formation, but that’s okay because the first formation is enough to protect the domain, and I will continue searching for the materials for the second formation."
"It’s okay, you can look for them slowly." Then, Zhang Fei asked her.
"Do you want me to bring Zhuxian Sheng here?"
"Yes!
Please bring him here!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1819: Qian Yan Make A Move
paragraphs: After bringing Zhuxian Sheng to the Puyang Clan, Zhang Fei left him with Liao Hanxue. He then went to meet with Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji.

To his surprise, Zhang Fei found Ji Changlan teaching the young men of the Puyang Clan blacksmithing. In the past, the clan did not have blacksmiths, but the arrival of a supreme-rank blacksmith like Old Ji changed that.

After discussing with the senior members of the clan, Ji Changlan agreed to teach them blacksmithing from scratch. He made this decision because Zhang Fei had brought him from the Three Mortal Realms to the Paradise Realm and the Ancient Realm.
With all of Zhang Fei’s abilities, Ji Changlan felt that he had nothing to offer him as a token of gratitude.
Furthermore, the Puang Clan was a close associate of Zhang Fei, so Ji Changlan didn’t refuse the seniors’ request to teach their clan members about blacksmithing.
Apart from Ji Changlan, Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji also enjoyed their time at the Puyang Clan. They focused their time on artifact forging, guided by Puyang Shaodi and Puyang Linzhe.

"Little Ji helped us a lot." Zhang Fei turned to Puyang Shangren. "We have some alchemists, artifact crafters, and others, but we don’t have any blacksmiths. Although they are still beginners in blacksmithing, Little Ji said that some of them have talent in that field, but their talent is not as good as yours, though."

Zhang Fei rubbed his nose. "Actually, my talent in all those areas is just so-so, but I have some other advantages that make it easier for me to learn them. After all, time is the most precious thing, right? As long as we have plenty of time and we don’t waste it, we will succeed in learning many things. But the main key is we must have ambition and be willing to work hard; otherwise, everything will be in vain."

"You’re right." Puyang Shangren looked at him. "The first time we met in the Forbidden Land, your cultivation had just broken through to the Celestial Lord Realm, but you are here now. Back then, I doubted that you would be able to set foot in this realm, but my doubts were unfounded."

Zhang Fei smiled as he recalled his journey from the beginning to today. "I managed to reach this level thanks to the help of all my wives, and Feng Yao brought me to this realm. Without them, my cultivation would definitely not have been this fast, and I would not have known anything about this realm."

"Hahaha," Puyang Shangren laughed, patting his shoulders. "The most important thing is that you never forget the people who have helped you since you started your cultivation path, kid. Many cultivators are ungrateful, and they forget the kindness of those who have helped them in the past."
"You seem to speak from experience, Senior."
"There were two cultivators from my clan who betrayed us after they achieved success, and my ancestor decided to expel them."
"Are they still alive?"
"They are still alive and living in other domains, and they are much more successful there."

A glint flashed across Zhang Fei’s eyes. "I always appreciate the people around me, but betrayal and ingratitude are the things I hate most in life. If I meet people like those two, I will never be merciful to them. I will cripple their cultivation, and I will kill them if their mistakes are too fatal."

"Such a ruthless young man!" Since their first meeting in the Forgotten Realm, Puyang Shangren had a positive opinion of Zhang Fei because he treated the people on his side fairly. "By the way, you should stop addressing me as a senior; instead, you should address me as a brother."
Zhang Fei looked at him in surprise. "Why?"

"Isn’t Puyang Yeyu your wife?" Zhang Fei smiled awkwardly. "Puyang Zong went crazy after he found out about your relationship with his sister, and he couldn’t stop bragging about your relationship. They are both in the same generation as me, so you are also my brother now."
"Haha! Looks like my brother-in-law is too happy because of my relationship with my wife, huh?"
Puyang Shangren sighed. "Puyang Zong’s only worry was his sister, but he doesn’t need to worry about her anymore because she has you as her husband now."
"Yeyu has already told me about that matter." Then, Zhang Fei asked him, "Do you want to meet Leiyu Tianlu?"

"No need." Puyang Shangren shook his head. "Those creatures continue to decrease for some reason, and the situation in this domain has begun to stabilize. Besides, Tianlu has improved significantly since I sent him to you, so I think it would be best if he stayed with you. By the way, Puyang Kongque can’t wait to meet you to discuss alchemy, so you should go see him before leaving."
"Alright."

Zhang Fei had arrived at the alchemy room of the Puyang Clan, where he saw Puyang Kongque concocting pills in front of a huge alchemy furnace. He approached him and checked the ingredients. "Your pill won’t form."
"Hmm?" Puyang Kongque was momentarily taken aback, but then he smiled. "How can you say that?"
"This herb." Zhang Fei picked up a herb from the pile. "The other ingredients won’t clash with each other, but this one will disrupt the final process, and the pill won’t form."
"Do you have a solution for that?"

"Wait." Zhang Fei disappeared into the Sealed World Realm, but he came out again a few moments later, bringing a number of fresh herbs with him. "This herb will neutralize the effect of that one, and it will also increase the effect of your pill."
Puyang Kongque’s eyes widened because the herb in Zhang Fei’s hand was quite rare, and he didn’t have it. "Where did you get this herb?"

"I found a herb field in one of the domains in the Paradise Realm, and this one is one of those herbs." Zhang Fei quickly processed the herbs until they turned into liquid, and he threw the liquid into the furnace afterwards. "Increase your flame a bit and keep the heat stable."

Puyang Kongque nodded and followed Zhang Fei’s instructions. Although the man before him was young, he didn’t underestimate him because their alchemy ranks were the same, and he had consumed his pills a few months ago.
Meanwhile, Yan Washeng observed Qian Yan’s movements in his city; he immediately recognized that the latter was a demon beast god. "How did he come here?"
"That demon beast is no ordinary beast, husband," Su Lan spoke from her husband’s side.
"Yes," Yan Washeng nodded. "Zhang Fei told me that he is the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon God, and his abilities are terrifying, especially his middle eye."
Su Lan titled her head. "Do you think he is Zhang Fei’s enemy?"

"That demon beast is indeed Zhang Fei’s enemy." Yan Washeng and Su Lan turned to Tang Zhiyao in surprise; they did not expect that she would appear. "I helped him to keep an eye on that demon beast because someone brought him to this domain to wreak havoc."
"Who brought that demon beast into our domain?"
"One of the primordial beasts!" Yan Washeng and Su Lan gasped in shock. "In fact, I’m not the only one watching that demon beast, but Mo Qingwen is also watching him."
Yan Washeng and Su Lan weren’t surprised to hear that Mo Qingwen was keeping an eye on Qian Yan. He was, after all, the strongest demon and the leader of their domain.
Yan Washeng, Su Lan, and Tang Zhiyao suddenly had a terrible feeling. They shuddered as they felt Qian Yan’s gaze on them.

Before they could react, Qian Yan had already appeared in front of them. However, his gaze was more focused on Tang Zhiyao, and he furrowed his brows when he realized she was just an ethereal form. "You three are the demon gods of this domain, right? If you three submit to me, I will let you go. If you guys try to challenge me, I will kill you."

Tang Zhiyao said nothing and disappeared, causing Qian Yan to frown even more deeply. He had already locked onto her aura and immediately tried to track her location. However, his expression turned to shock after he failed to track her, something no living creature should be able to do.

"How is this possible? Why can’t I track her? Could it be because she isn’t using her real body?" Qian Yan was furious because he couldn’t find Tang Zhiyao, so he returned his gaze to Yan Washeng and Su Lan. "What’s your choice?"
"We—"

Before Yan Washeng could react, a flame shot towards Qian Yan, who immediately tried to block it. However, his expression turned grim as the flame approached him, and he immediately moved to avoid it. "Who dares to disturb me?"
"Heh!" Qian Yan looked at Huo Ling, who had just appeared. His eyes bulged out in shock; his body also trembled strongly. "Seems like you haven’t forgotten about that day’s events, huh?"

’Crap! How can this brutal woman be in this domain?’ Qian Yan was never afraid of anyone even when he was standing in front of the two primordial beasts, but Huo Ling’s presence frightened him. "You... how did you get here?"
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted and shot her flames towards Qian Yan, forcing him to flee with his tail between his legs. "Do you think you can escape from me?"

Yan Washeng and Su Lan were truly shocked to see Qian Yan so afraid of Huo Ling. They were demon gods, but they didn’t dare make a move in front of the former, yet he was so terrified of her. "Who is that woman, husband?"
"I don’t know the woman’s name, but I saw her with Zhang Fei in the dungeon."

chapters.title: Chapter 1820: Sending Qian Yan Away
paragraphs: *Boom*
A massive explosion occurred some distance away in Yan Wansheng’s city, followed by Qian Yan’s scream of agony. "Argh!"
"Heh!" Huo Ling snorted, making a gesture with one hand. In an instant, four layers of flames shot out from the ground and enclosed Qian Yan within.
Qian Yan tried to escape into the sky, but Huo Ling wouldn’t give her the chance. As soon as she made a move, waves of flames shot from the sky and rained down on the area below.
"Shit!"
Qian Yan transformed into his beast form, but his current form was not as big as the one Zhang Fei encountered in the soul challenge, which was the size of a gigantic mountain.
"Roar!"
Qian Yan’s roar could be heard from almost throughout the domain, which attracted the attention of all demon gods.
Since Zhang Fei had warned him about Qian Yan, Mo Qingwen had also warned all the demon gods on her side, and they chose not to move according to his orders.
Mo Qingwen was actually curious about Qian Yan and wanted to try fighting him. However, he trusted Zhang Fei more because Feng Yao and Huo Ling were by his side.
Gui Ye, Chang Moyu, and Zuo Hentian hurried over to check the situation.
Another group, including Hou Wuyan and several other demon gods, was also interested in checking out the situation.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5], along with three female gods, watched Huo Ling’s fight from a distance far enough to avoid Qian Yan’s detection.
Zhang Fei [5] sent his Demon’s Eye Orb to the battle location so they could watch the battle between Huo Ling and Qian Yan more clearly.

"That demon beast god is truly terrifying." Tang Zhiyao said with a trembling voice. "I’ve never been afraid of anyone, including Mo Qingwen. However, Qian Yan gave me a bad feeling, so I immediately fled the city."

"Qian Yan should have already locked onto your aura, but he couldn’t track your real body because you hid it in your dream space." Zhang Fei [5] only realized this after he observed the demon beast god’s expression when he searched for Tang Zhiyao’s whereabouts. He has the Dream Lordship ability, but his ability is different from hers, and he can only use it if he has touched his opponent’s body beforehand. "Your dream ability is much more useful than mine, since you can use it from a distance, and you can also hide your real body in your dream space."

"Before I escaped, I already used my dream technique on that demon beast god. However, I hesitated to use it because of the ability of his eyes, and I was afraid that he could break free from there." Tang Zhiyao looked at him. "You can also hide your real body in your dream space, right?"
"I do." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "It’s just that I don’t dare approach him, or he’ll lock onto my aura, and he’ll know all my secret places."
Tang Zhiyao herself felt fear towards Qian Yan, so she was not surprised to see Zhang Fei [5] being cautious of the demon beast god.
"Do you think my poison will have any effect on him?" Gongsun Zhilan asked him.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I don’t have detailed information about Qian Yan’s abilities, but Feng Yao told me that his eyes have various abilities. According to her, the person who has the ability to counteract his eyes’ abilities is Jiu Tou Sen."
"Jiu Tou Sen is a beast god like him, and he is the strongest beast in this Ancient Realm. If I’m not mistaken, his true form is the Nine-Headed Serpent Beast." Hua Qianmei added.
"You are right, Jiu Tou Sen is the Nine-Headed Serpent Beast, and he is semi-immortal."
"What? Jiu Tou Sen is a semi-immortal?" The three female demon gods screamed in shock.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled wryly at their frantic expressions. "Jiu Tou Sen isn’t a true immortal, but he’s incredibly difficult to kill because one of his heads has the ability to regenerate. Every time he is injured, the injury will heal itself, even if you cut off one of his heads."
"Even if we cut off his head with the ability to regenerate?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "If we want to kill Jiu Tou Sen, we must decapitate all nine of its heads and destroy its beast core. However, killing it isn’t as easy as turning over our hands because each head has a different ability; otherwise, he wouldn’t be crowned the strongest cultivator in this Ancient Realm, right?"
The three female demon gods nodded in agreement. "Even the Nightmare Lord and Mo Qingwen don’t dare to face Jiu Tou Sen because he once defeated both of them."

"I’m curious about the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhou." Then, Zhang Fei [5] asked Tang Zhiyao. "Have you fought him before? I heard he has a dream ability like us, and he slaughtered Yuan Xiajie’s entire family through dreams."

"Huh?" Zhang Fei, Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan were shocked by Tang Zhiyao’s confession. "What exactly happened between you two? Why did he injure you?"
Tang Zhiyao glanced sideways. "What do you think a man wants most from a woman?
"Hahaha!" Hua Qianmei laughed. "I didn’t expect your beauty to attract Meng Zhuo!"
"Did Meng Zhuo hurt you because you rejected his love?" Gongsun Zhilan asked, but her tone was slightly mocking.
Tang Zhiyao gritted her teeth. "We’ll talk about that later! By the way, what will your wife do to Qian Yan?"

Qian Yan stared at Huo Ling furiously; even all the eyes on his body were open.
Huo Ling picked her nose while staring at him in disgust. "In my life, I’ve seen many disgusting beasts, but your disgusting appearance is on a godly level."
Qian Yan didn’t take Huo Ling’s provocation to heart and focused on the flames raining down on him from the sky. Some of his eyes turned pitch-black, and darkness shot out towards those flames.
"Haish." Huo Ling revealed a disappointed expression. "You already used that technique when my master beat you in the past, and you know it’s useless, yet you foolishly used it again."
Ten thousand small fire arrows appeared above Huo Ling as she raised her hand up, which caused Qian Yan to panic and become agitated.
"Hehe." Huo Ling chuckled. "You seem to still remember my technique, huh?"

’Damn it!’ Qian Yan cursed inwardly, but then Huo Ling launched those arrows at him, targeting his ten thousand eyes, especially his middle eye. After considering the risks, he closed all his eyes; otherwise, he would suffer grave injuries.
Qian Yan also activated all his defenses to protect himself, but Huo Ling’s flames were not ordinary flames; they were primordial flames, rendering all his defenses useless.
In a split second, Huo Ling’s flames shattered Qian Yan’s defenses and struck his body. The flames instantly spread throughout his body, and his pain-filled roar echoed in the domain.
All demons within the radius of their battle area were forced to seal their senses of hearing, as Qian Yan’s roar deafened their ears and caused their heads to grow heavy.

"Hmm?" Huo Ling looked at the gate that opened behind Qian Yan, so she wasted no time and blasted him into it. After that, she removed her flames before looking at Zhang Fei [5] with a pout. "Why are you in such a rush to send him back to the Paradise Realm, husband?"

Zhang Fei [5] smiled bitterly. "If I didn’t do that, Qian Yan would definitely die at your hands, and I would lose a formidable opponent. By the way, how serious is his injury? How long will it take him to recover?"

"Since you forbade me from killing him and needed him to be your opponent, I only used five percent of my strength when I attacked him just now." Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Tang Zhiyao were dumbfounded after Huo Ling said this. "According to my estimation, his injuries won’t recover for ten years, but my estimation might be wrong if the two primordial beasts are helping him recover."
"Ten years, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I think that’s enough to buy time, and I’ll be ready to fight him then."
Huo Ling’s eyes lit up. "Does that mean you will be in seclusion again?"

"After I get those demon materials and defeat Mo Shentian, I will take them all into seclusion again, and we won’t come out for the next ten years." Huo Ling immediately hugged Zhang Fei [5], and her eyes showed impatience. "Are you this happy that we are going into seclusion?"

"That’s for sure!" Huo Ling replied with excitement. "It’s been almost a year since we came out of our seclusion, and you’ve been busy with so many things during this time. I didn’t say anything to you before, but I’m disappointed with your decision. I want you to reach the Celestial God Realm as soon as possible, and I’ll take you to the Primordial Realm afterward so you can break through to the God King Realm."
"Where did you send Qian Yan, Zhang Fei?"
"The Jiangshen Domain."
"One of the domains in the Paradise Realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Another name for the Jiangshen Domain is the Ghost Domain, and the Ghost Emperor reigns there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1821: Qian Yan - The Ghost Emperor
paragraphs: "The ghost emperor?"

Zhang Fei [5] explained to the three women about the ghost emperor. The truth that the ghost emperor was born from the hatred and resentment of the people who lived in the Jiangshen Domain in the past shocked them. "That incident happened in the past, and I heard everything from Feng Yao. By the way, the other demon gods will be here soon, so I’ll take you guys back to the dungeon now. After that, I’ll pick up someone at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I’ll bring her here."
"Who is that woman?"
Zhang Fei [5] gave Gongsun Zhilan a playful smile. "Her name is Qian Qin, and she is one of Qian Yan’s daughters."
"Huh?" Hua Qianmei, Gongsun Zhilan, and Tang Zhiyao were stunned.
"What exactly is your relationship with Qian Yan’s daughter?" Gongsun Zhilan’s tone was a little unpleasant to hear.
Hua Qianmei stole a glance at Gongsun Zhilan before asking. "If Qian Yan’s daughter is your woman, that means he is your father-in-law, right?"

On the contrary, Tang Zhiyao felt that it was impossible for Zhang Fei [5] and Qian Yan to have such a relationship; otherwise, he wouldn’t have allowed Huo Ling to beat the latter. Although she didn’t know the problems between them, in her opinion, the two were more like old enemies than relatives.

"You could say that Qian Yan’s daughter, Qian Qin, is my unofficial woman. As for my relationship with her father, I will explain it later, and it is related to one of my other unofficial women." Gongsun Zhilan furrowed her brows after Zhang Fei [5] said that. He already had many wives, but he still had several unofficial women. "Let’s go to the dungeon now."
"Zhang Fei, I won’t be joining you guys, and I will meet you to discuss our dream techniques later."
"Alright."
After Zhang Fei [5] took Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan away, Tang Zhiyao looked away as she felt the aura of several demon gods moving towards her, but she couldn’t care less about them.

Tang Zhiyao went to see Yan Washeng and Su Lan, informing them not to say anything about Zhang Fei [5] to the other demon gods. She knew that he had enslaved the former, but he didn’t do anything to the latter.
"Don’t worry, I won’t say anything," Su Lan said.
"That’s good." Tang Zhiyao disappeared from their sight instantly.

Su Lan sighed and hugged her husband. "Zhang Fei [5] is truly formidable, and he also has such a powerful woman by his side. I don’t know his plans, but I believe that the situation in this domain will be chaotic soon."

"I agree with you." Yan Washeng’s face turned serious. "Basically, Zhang Fei [5] is my master, and Gongsun Zhilan seems to have a special relationship with him. This way, our group has already collapsed; Gui Ye and the others won’t dare to make a move unless they join Hou Wuyan’s group."
"Do you think they will join Hou Wuyan’s group?"

"I don’t know about Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian, but I believe that Gui Ye will join his group." Yan Washeng looked at his wife. "The two people in Hou Wuyan’s group hate Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu so much, so they will never stop their plans. However, they shouldn’t have information about Zhang Fei [5]’s strength yet, and they will suffer if they make a move now."
Su Lan nodded in agreement. "What do you think Zhang Fei [5] will do to Qian Yan? I feel that he is deliberately avoiding him, and he decided to send Huo Ling to deal with him."

"You don’t need to think about that problem." Yan Washeng led his wife back into their palace. "We don’t have the strength to fight Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling, so we don’t need to meddle in their affairs."
"Yeah."
"Qin’er."

Qian Qin, who was soaking in the Yin-Yang Spirit River, turned to Zhang Fei [5]. She didn’t bother to cover her naked body as he had already seen her naked before, and he had also touched her body. "Did you fight with my father before?"

"Do you really think I fought with your father?" Zhang Fei [5] sat by the river. Then, he created a qi screen that displayed Huo Ling’s and Qian Yan’s fight, so Qian Qin could see everything for herself. "I don’t have the ability to fight your father yet, and I’m also worried about his middle eye, so I asked Ling’er to face him."
Qian Qin watched their fight on the qi screen seriously, but her body trembled slightly when she saw Huo Ling’s techniques hit her father squarely.

Zhang Fei [5] inwardly sighed. "Do you still consider him as your father? He sealed your original soul and implanted his mark within it, remember? Besides, he already knew that you were not my opponent, but he deliberately sent you to me, even though he knew you wouldn’t succeed."
"Let’s not talk about him." Qian Qin jumped out of the river, landed in front of Zhang Fei [5], and started to get dressed. "Are you impatient to sleep with me?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] stood up, pulled Qian Yin close, and kissed her. "I can’t wait to sleep with you, but I don’t dare do it; otherwise, your father’s mark will invade my soul. However, I will face your father in ten years, and I will definitely defeat him then. When I manage to force him to remove his mark from your soul, I will sleep with you then."
Qian Qin said nothing and nodded. "Let’s go back."
"I’ll take you to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and you must cultivate while increasing your demon rank there."
"Won’t that bring trouble to you and all your demon wives?"

"Ling’er’s attack wasn’t fatal, but it was enough to keep your father from leaving for ten years." Qian Qin was stunned after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "Feng Yao told me that your father won’t be able to find you there, so you don’t need to worry about that and focus on your cultivation."
"Alright."
Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] brought Qian Qin to that domain, and he left her with all his demon wives in Hua Qianmei’s secret place.
"Cough... Cough..."

Qian Yan lay on the ground as he coughed up blood. After wiping away his blood, he looked at the surrounding area, and he immediately realized that he was in Jiangshen Domain. "That brat should be in that domain with that damn woman, and he sent me here when I was off guard."
"Who dares to trespass on my territory?"
The shout alerted Qian Yan, and he immediately stood up while mustering his strength. "The ghost emperor."
*Boom*
The ghost emperor landed in front of Qian Yan, shouldering his giant bone sword. "Hmm? The demon beast god?"
"I am." Qian Yan didn’t dare lower his guard because his injuries were too severe. "I didn’t mean to intrude into your territory, and someone sent me here."
"Hmm?" The ghost emperor looked at Qian Yan seriously, but he also didn’t dare to attack him. "Who sent you here?"
"My enemy is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir."
"What? Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Yes!"
"How could Hu Tianlang’s sole heir injure you this badly?"

"It wasn’t him who injured me, but his woman who did it." The ghost emperor looked at Qian Yan with disdain. "If you meet that woman in the future, I’m sure you’ll kneel before her. She is not an ordinary woman, and she is the woman who was always with Empress Huo Yanling in the past."
The ghost emperor trembled, remembering those two fierce women. "Does that mean Empress Huo has returned to this domain?"

’This ghost emperor is afraid of that woman?’ Qian Yan was quite surprised by the ghost emperor’s reaction. "Empress Huo has been back for more than a decade, but she hasn’t done anything in this realm."
"Alright, you have to leave now! I don’t want to meet those two women!"

Qian Yan breathed a sigh of relief after the ghost emperor left. Initially, he believed he would need to fight the ghost emperor to escape the domain, but he was surprised to find that the ghost emperor was actually frightened of the two women.

Qian Yan didn’t think anything further, and he hurriedly left the Jiangshen Domain before the ghost emperor changed his mind. If he were in peak condition, he wouldn’t have feared him, but the injuries Huo Ling had inflicted on him were quite severe.
Although there were many obstacles in the domain, they were not a problem for Qian Yan, and he could avoid them without difficulty.
After Qian Yan left the domain, Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling appeared on top of one of the trees inside.
"Haha," Huo Ling laughed. "Your plan to send Qian Yan here didn’t work, husband."

Zhang Fei [5] sighed, rubbing Huo Ling’s head. "Isn’t it because of you and Yao’er? What exactly did you do to the ghost emperor? I didn’t expect the ghost emperor to be so afraid of you two, and he let Qian Yan off so easily."
"Nothing much! My master beat that stupid ghost emperor for a whole month, husband. In the end, he prostrated himself at my master’s feet, and he begged her to let him go."
"You’re saying that’s nothing much?" Huo Ling grinned in response to Zhang Fei [5]. "I knew that you were inclined towards violence, but I didn’t expect that Yao’er was the same as you."

"Hehe," Huo Ling giggled. "Husband, you know my current master, but you didn’t know her when she lived as Huo Yanling. Let alone the ghost emperor, even Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and the ten demon gods had become victims of her violence. Otherwise, they wouldn’t respect her so much, right?"
"That’s true." Zhang Fei [5] looked towards the location of the Spirit Willow Tree Seed. "Let’s go back, Ling’er."

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] brought Qian Qin to that domain, and he left her with all his demon wives in Hua Qianmei’s secret place.
"Cough...
Cough..."
Qian Yan lay on the ground as he coughed up blood.
After wiping away his blood, he looked at the surrounding area, and he immediately realized that he was in Jiangshen Domain.
"That brat should be in that domain with that damn woman, and he sent me here when I was off guard."
"Who dares to trespass on my territory?"
The shout alerted Qian Yan, and he immediately stood up while mustering his strength.
"The ghost emperor."
*Boom*
The ghost emperor landed in front of Qian Yan, shouldering his giant bone sword.
"Hmm?
The demon beast god?"
"I am." Qian Yan didn’t dare lower his guard because his injuries were too severe.
"I didn’t mean to intrude into your territory, and someone sent me here."
"Hmm?" The ghost emperor looked at Qian Yan seriously, but he also didn’t dare to attack him.
"Who sent you here?"
"My enemy is Hu Tianlang’s sole heir."
"What?
Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Yes!"
"How could Hu Tianlang’s sole heir injure you this badly?"
"It wasn’t him who injured me, but his woman who did it." The ghost emperor looked at Qian Yan with disdain.
"If you meet that woman in the future, I’m sure you’ll kneel before her.
She is not an ordinary woman, and she is the woman who was always with Empress Huo Yanling in the past."
The ghost emperor trembled, remembering those two fierce women.
"Does that mean Empress Huo has returned to this domain?"
’This ghost emperor is afraid of that woman?’ Qian Yan was quite surprised by the ghost emperor’s reaction.
"Empress Huo has been back for more than a decade, but she hasn’t done anything in this realm."
"Alright, you have to leave now!
I don’t want to meet those two women!"
Qian Yan breathed a sigh of relief after the ghost emperor left.
Initially, he believed he would need to fight the ghost emperor to escape the domain, but he was surprised to find that the ghost emperor was actually frightened of the two women.
Qian Yan didn’t think anything further, and he hurriedly left the Jiangshen Domain before the ghost emperor changed his mind.
If he were in peak condition, he wouldn’t have feared him, but the injuries Huo Ling had inflicted on him were quite severe.
Although there were many obstacles in the domain, they were not a problem for Qian Yan, and he could avoid them without difficulty.
After Qian Yan left the domain, Zhang Fei [5] and Huo Ling appeared on top of one of the trees inside.
"Haha," Huo Ling laughed.
"Your plan to send Qian Yan here didn’t work, husband."
Zhang Fei [5] sighed, rubbing Huo Ling’s head.
"Isn’t it because of you and Yao’er?
What exactly did you do to the ghost emperor?
I didn’t expect the ghost emperor to be so afraid of you two, and he let Qian Yan off so easily."
"Nothing much!
My master beat that stupid ghost emperor for a whole month, husband.
In the end, he prostrated himself at my master’s feet, and he begged her to let him go."
"You’re saying that’s nothing much?" Huo Ling grinned in response to Zhang Fei [5].
"I knew that you were inclined towards violence, but I didn’t expect that Yao’er was the same as you."
"Hehe," Huo Ling giggled.
"Husband, you know my current master, but you didn’t know her when she lived as Huo Yanling.
Let alone the ghost emperor, even Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and the ten demon gods had become victims of her violence.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t respect her so much, right?"
"That’s true." Zhang Fei [5] looked towards the location of the Spirit Willow Tree Seed.
"Let’s go back, Ling’er."

chapters.title: Chapter 1822: The Furious Qian Yan
paragraphs: In his beast form, Qian Yan flew swiftly across the dark universe. With the ghost emperor’s appearance earlier, he hadn’t had time to check his injuries, and his expression became grim when he realized that they were quite severe.

"Damn it! That bitch injured me this badly, and it will take me at least ten years to recover from my injuries." Qian Yan shivered, imagining if Huo Ling attacked him using her full strength. "In the past, I’ve met her, but I never fought her. Back then, Empress Huo was too powerful, and all the cultivators were afraid of her, so there was no need for that woman to make a move. What exactly is the relationship between Zhang Fei and Empress Huo? How could that woman be with him?"

Qian Yan tried to contact Qian Qin, but he couldn’t reach her. He opened his middle eye to search for his daughter’s whereabouts in all domains of the Paradise Realm, but he couldn’t find her anywhere. He tried to check the Myriad Abyss Domain, but his eye ability couldn’t reach that domain.

His eye ability could see the void, but he was unable to examine that domain, which made Qian Yan furious. He forgot that the void exists in every realm, including the Paradise Realm. On the contrary, the Ancient Realm was separated by a barrier created by the universe, preventing his ability to examine that domain.

"Could it be that Qin’er has already fallen into Zhang Fei’s hands? Since that brat is in that domain, my useless daughter is probably there too." Qian Yan grew increasingly furious thinking about that possibility, and he thought that Zhang Fei intended to use his daughter against him. "Heh! That brat is truly naive if he thinks he can use my daughter to force me to submit to him! He shouldn’t know the mark inside her soul, and I can use that to kill her."

Qian Yan thought about killing Qian Qin, but he changed his mind and let her stay beside Zhang Fei, and he would use her to destroy him in the future. "For now, I just need to focus on healing my injuries, and I will wait for those two primordial beasts to come at me again."

In the Ten Thousand Beast Grave Domain, the same woman who appeared in the tunnels several years ago suddenly appeared there. She landed at the same location of the portal that Xu Yuanzhi had used to take Qian Yan to the Ancient Realm three days earlier.

The woman waved her hand, and the portal immediately appeared in front of her. She crouched at the side of the portal and destroyed it directly. "I don’t know if Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi know the location of the other portals, but this is enough to temporarily prevent their avatars from descending into this realm."
The woman stood up and checked other areas of the domain. She immediately disappeared from the location of the portal before reappearing in the palace belonging to the four perils.
The woman looked at them with a cold gaze. "Pathetic beasts! The four of you are immortal rank beasts, but your greed makes your fate truly miserable."
Since the four perils were already incapacitated due to their injuries and they would become crippled soon, the woman did nothing to them and disappeared from the palace.
After returning to the Myriad Abyss Domain, Zhang Fei [5] immediately entered the dungeon and went to the fifth ground floor to continue hunting those mindless demons.
Meanwhile, Gui Ye had arrived at the area not far from Yan Wansheng’s city, which was the location of Qian Yan and Huo Ling’s previous fight.

Gui Ye landed in that area, squatted there, and checked the blood remaining on the ground. "Where did the demon actually come from? Did someone kill him? Based on his roar earlier, I’m sure that he is a powerful demon beast, and he should have reached the demon god rank like me."
*Thud... Thud...*
"Old Gui! Did you find anything?"
Gui Ye looked at Chang Moyu and Zuo Hentian, shaking his head. "The demon beast god had already disappeared when I arrived, and the blood on the ground should be his blood."
"A demon beast god?"
Gui Ye nodded. "Judging from his previous roar, I’m certain that he’s a demon beast god. However, I couldn’t find any trace of his opponent in this place, so that person should be stronger than him."
"Who exactly is that powerful mysterious person?" Chang Moyu muttered to himself.

Zuo Hentian looked towards Yan Washeng’s city. "Old Yan should know about their sudden appearance in our domain, and he probably saw that mysterious person. However, I found it strange that Mo Qingwen didn’t come here, so I’m sure that he knows the identity of that mysterious person."

"Gongsun Zhilan didn’t come here either." Chang Moyu looked at his friend. "Could it be that the mysterious person is Zhang Fei? Since he once defeated Old Yan and Old Gui’s two subordinates, he should have the strength to fight that demon beast god."
"Your guess may be correct, but we shouldn’t enter the dungeon to meet Zhang Fei." Cang Moyu agreed with Zuo Hentian. "What are your plans next, Old Gui?"
Gui Ye looked at him. "Since you two and Gongsun Zhilan don’t dare to fight Zhang Fei, I’ll find another way to capture him."
Cang Moyu and Zuo Hentian exchanged glances for a moment. "Since you are so eager to capture Zhang Fei, we won’t bother you anymore, and we will return to our cities."
"Heh! You two are really cowards!" Gui Ye sneered.
Cang Moyu and Zuo Hentian ignored Gui Ye, and they hurriedly left the area.
*Thud... Thud...*
"You guys move so fast, huh?" Gui Ye spoke to Hou Wuyan and the other three.
The other three ignored Gui Ye, but then Hou Wuyan asked him, "What did you find here, Old Gui? Did you get a glimpse of those two mysterious figures?"

"One of them is a demon beast, but I can’t find any trace of the other one, which means the latter is stronger than the former." Hou Wuyan and the other three frowned. "If the four of you want to know their identities, you can go find Old Yan. After all, this area isn’t too far from his city, so he probably watched the two of them fight earlier. Are your preparations to destroy Mo Qingwen ready?"
"Soon! We’ll let you know once everything is ready, and you can send your ghost to his city to help us at that time."
"Alright." Gui Ye didn’t say anything else and flew away from the area.
"Should we go see Yan Washeng?"

"No need." Hou Wuyan shook his head at one of his friends. "I haven’t found any information on Zhang Fei, so we don’t need to trouble him. Instead, we should focus on preparing our plan, and we’ll attack Mo Qingwen once everything is ready."
"Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu often went back and forth between their city and the dungeon in the past month."
"Zhang Fei may have a close relationship with them; otherwise, Mo Qingwen’s son and daughter would not help him hunt those mindless demons."
"Even Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu also helped Zhang Fei; otherwise, they wouldn’t have repeatedly gone into the dungeon."

"Forget it." Hou Wuyan looked at his three friends. "People say that Zhang Fei is too strong, and he might be stronger than Mo Qingwen, so we should avoid him for now. After we get rid of that bastard Mo, we’ll think of another way to deal with him, and we’ll force him to hand over his treasure to us."
The other three agreed with Hou Wuyan. "Let’s go back, or our preparations will be delayed."
In his palace, Mo Qingwen and Gu Yanshu stood side by side on the balcony, looking into the distance. "Are they willing to obey your orders, husband?"
"Gui Ye’s group and Huo Wuyan’s group didn’t follow my orders, but the others didn’t move to that location."
"Do you think Huo Wuyan’s group would dare attack Zhang Fei?"

Mo Qingwen shook his head. "They are not fools, and their subordinates should have already informed them of Zhang Fei’s actions against Yan Washeng. I believe they won’t make a move against him, at least for now. Since he has returned to this domain, we have to go to the dungeon again to help him."
"We’ve been helping him in the past month, but I feel that he’s deliberately keeping his distance from us."

"Isn’t that natural? He came to our domain to look for those materials, and he already knows about our problems with several other demon gods." Mo Qingwen took his wife’s hand. "Alright, you don’t have to worry about that. I’ll find a way out of our problem myself."
Gu Yanshu nodded to Mo Qingwen, and the two of them immediately left their palace.
When Puyang Yeyu entered the alchemy room, Zhang Fei and Puyang Kongque had already finished the pills and were discussing their effects.
"Have you finished talking with your grandmother?"
Puyang Yeyu nodded and walked to Zhang Fei’s side. "I still want to talk to my grandmother, but she told me to go with you and focus on my training."
"It’s okay, I’ll bring you here if you miss her."
"Haha," Puyang Kongque suddenly laughed. "I didn’t expect that you chose him as your husband, Yeyu."
Puyang Yeyu just smiled. "Our soul mate is determined by fate, and Zhang Fei happens to be my soul mate."
"Yes... Yes..."
Puyang Yeyu looked at Zhang Fei. "Shall we go now?"
"I’ll send you inside, and you can train with the others. As for me, I’ll be returning to the Myriad Abyss Domain again, and I hope I can get those materials as soon as possible."
"Alright."
