chapters.title: Chapter 1823: Ask For Help To Upgrade
paragraphs: Six and a half years ago, Zhang Fei visited that clan to upgrade his Demon Extermination Sword. He had long wanted to upgrade his sword, but they didn’t have the Immortal Soul Crystal, and they said it would take at least ten years to find one. Since he already got one from the system, he decided to go see You Feng and You Jian again.
"Oh? What brings you here today?"

"Here." You Feng’s and You Jian’s expressions became ecstatic as soon as Zhang Fei took out the Immortal Soul Crystal. He summoned the Demon Extermination Sword out of his body and handed both items over to the two brothers. "You two already have the remaining materials, right?"
You Jian accepted the sword and the soul crystal. "We already got the remaining items long before you removed those gates, so we can start upgrading your sword today."
"How long will it take you guys to upgrade my sword?"

"Upgrading an item to immortal grade is never easy, and it may take us one to two months to complete the process." Then, You Feng asked him, "Why don’t you upgrade it yourself? Your blacksmithing skills are superior to ours, so you should be able to complete it faster than us."
Zhang Fei shook his head. "I’m busy searching for demon materials in the Myriad Abyss Domain, and my five clones are busy improving my cultivation, so I don’t have time to upgrade my sword."
You Feng and You Jian knew that Zhang Fei was too busy with his cultivation and some other things; he also sent many members of the natural races to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley to rebuild it.
"Do you need your sword in a hurry?"

"I don’t need my sword for a while, so you don’t have to worry about it. If I need a weapon, I can use my other sword." Zhang Fei took out several bottles of pills and gave them to the two brothers. "If you have finished my sword, you can tell Serpentera or Tian Kui directly, and they will inform me."
"Alright! Leave this matter to us, and you won’t be disappointed with the results."
"Thank you."

After Zhang Fei left, You Feng and You Jian hurriedly went to their forging workshop. Since their clan decided to follow him, he had helped them a lot, so they wanted to finish it quickly with the best possible results.
"Master."
Zhang Fei nodded to Serpentera and Tian Kui. "Old Snake and Old Kui, the four perils have finished, and they will be crippled until they die."
"Is that the effect of the items Xu Yuanzhi gave them?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei explained to the two male beasts about the Soulburn Crystals in the bodies of the four perils. "Although they’re not dead yet, you two can consider your old grudge settled. As for Xu Yuanzhi, I will help you two settle accounts with him in the future, and you can kill him yourselves."
Serpentera and Tian Kui were greatly relieved to hear that. "Master, we—"

"No need." Zhang Fei waved his hand. "You two acknowledged me as your master when I was still weak, and you also helped me a lot when I was still living in the Nine Stars Realm. I have long regarded you two as my family, and there is no need for thanks between families. If you two insist on thanking me, you can protect my children in the future."
"Eh? Have you decided to have children soon, Master?" Both Serpentera and Tian Kui were shocked by that.

"In the future," Zhang Fei sighed. "All my wives have long wanted children from me, but this universe is still not safe, and both primordial beasts are targeting me. If I have children now, they will be my weakness, and both beasts will target them."
"Don’t you have your training space and soul world, Master?"
"That’s right, Master. If you have children, you can hide them in one of those places."

"My soul world is still too weak for them to live in, and my training space is like a prison." Zhang Fei glanced at the sect. "If I have children, I don’t want them to live confined, and I want them to be able to enjoy a free life. Thus, I have to improve my cultivation as soon as possible, and I also have to defeat the two primordial beasts before I have children."
Serpentera and Tian Kui nodded in understanding. "So, when are you going to bring everyone to the domain, Master?"

"Liao Hanxue is still gathering materials to create a barrier in that domain, so I will bring everyone there once the barrier is in place." Zhang Fei opened the gate leading to the Myriad Abyss Domain. "I will return to that domain now, and I will leave the security of this domain to both of you."
"Yes, Master."
Serpentera let out a sigh of relief after Zhang Fei disappeared. "Even though we didn’t manage to kill the four perils, they will die a painful death, so I’m satisfied with the outcome."

"Me too." Tian Kui nodded in agreement. "We only have one enemy left, and our old grudge will be settled after he’s dead. Unfortunately, he is too strong for us, so we can only rely on our master to kill him."
"Haha," Serpentera laughed. "Whether we killed that person or not, I don’t think it’s a big deal. Once our master kills him, our old master’s soul can rest in peace."
Tian Kui furrowed his brows. "Do you think our old master has been reincarnated, Old Snake?"

"Did you forget that our old master’s soul disappeared after his death?" Tian Kui shook his head at Serpentera. "Since his soul disappeared from this universe, he can’t be reincarnated. Honestly, I’d like to meet our old master again, but that’s clearly impossible. Instead of thinking about him, we should focus on our current master, and we will protect his future descendants."
"Yeah,"
Tian Kui and Serpentera raised their eyebrows, sensing the auras of two powerful cultivators approaching their domain.
Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi instantly appeared beside them. "The owners of these two auras are Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening."
"Who are those two people?"
"They are the supreme leaders of the Divine Samsara Sect."
Tian Kui and Serpentera exchanged glances for a moment. "Since the two of them have come to our domain, we must capture them for our master."
"That’s right! The Divine Samsara Sect wants to kill our master, so we must capture them, and he can use them to control their sect."
"Let’s go!" The four of them immediately flew away from the sect.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening were amazed when they entered the domain, especially with the dense forest that covered the entire area. The only thing they could see was the floating island, which was the location of the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening didn’t dare move carelessly in the domain; they could sense the unusualness of the forest before them. Furthermore, they couldn’t fly because Zhang Fei had set up a flight-restriction formation in the domain, and only a few people could deactivate it.

"Tch!" Ouyang Xuening clicked her teeth. "How did that brat change the domain this drastically? The forest in front of us is filled with formations, and we can’t fly because of the formations in the air. We’ve been searching for the domain’s location for over half a year, and we finally managed to find it, but the situation is unfavorable for us."

Huang Tianzhun tried to spread his senses to examine the forest, but a formation blocked them. "I heard Zhang Fei is a rank 10 array master, so he should be the one who created all these formations. However, all of these formations are high-grade, and the materials to create them are not easy to obtain."
"So, what should we do now? Should we barge in or leave?"
"We—"
Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening immediately went on alert as soon as they sensed the four powerful auras. They also took out their weapons to prepare for battle.
"Hahaha," Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening frowned when they saw Serpentera and Tian Kui, but they were more shocked by the presence of Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi with the two beasts.
Tian Kui smirked. "Old woman, do you think you can leave this domain today?"
"You two are targeting our master, and Liang Huizhong is trying to kill him." Serpentera stared at the two with murderous intent.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening never expected that Zhang Fei had two powerful guardian beasts, and their cultivation was at the same level as theirs. They looked at Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi, but the two women looked indifferent to them.
"Your guts are truly great, Huang Tianzhun." Huo Mingyi said disdainfully.
Huo Mengyi also spoke, her tone cold. "Are you thinking of challenging my empress, Ouyang Xuening? You already know that Zhang Fei is my empress’s husband, yet you dare to think of killing him."

’Shit! Why did the situation become like this?’ Ouyang Xuening tugged at the corner of Huang Tianzhun’s sleeve, signaling him to escape immediately. Tian Kui and Serpentera were already troublesome, but Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi were even more troublesome.
Huang Tianzhun realized that the situation was unfavorable. "Miss Mengyi and Miss Mingyi, we don’t—"

"Hey, Old Man! Do you think we’re idiots?" Tian Kui shouted at him. "Liang Huizhong and your elders intended to kill our master in the tower, and you also sent Yue Ningxue there to assist them. Unfortunately, you underestimated our master too much, and they didn’t dare to make a move in front of him. Since you two dared to enter our domain, you don’t need to leave anymore, and your two clans will soon face destruction."

sentences.text: Six and a half years ago, Zhang Fei visited that clan to upgrade his Demon Extermination Sword.
He had long wanted to upgrade his sword, but they didn’t have the Immortal Soul Crystal, and they said it would take at least ten years to find one.
Since he already got one from the system, he decided to go see You Feng and You Jian again.
"Oh?
What brings you here today?"
"Here." You Feng’s and You Jian’s expressions became ecstatic as soon as Zhang Fei took out the Immortal Soul Crystal.
He summoned the Demon Extermination Sword out of his body and handed both items over to the two brothers.
"You two already have the remaining materials, right?"
You Jian accepted the sword and the soul crystal.
"We already got the remaining items long before you removed those gates, so we can start upgrading your sword today."
"How long will it take you guys to upgrade my sword?"
"Upgrading an item to immortal grade is never easy, and it may take us one to two months to complete the process." Then, You Feng asked him, "Why don’t you upgrade it yourself?
Your blacksmithing skills are superior to ours, so you should be able to complete it faster than us."
Zhang Fei shook his head.
"I’m busy searching for demon materials in the Myriad Abyss Domain, and my five clones are busy improving my cultivation, so I don’t have time to upgrade my sword."
You Feng and You Jian knew that Zhang Fei was too busy with his cultivation and some other things; he also sent many members of the natural races to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley to rebuild it.
"Do you need your sword in a hurry?"
"I don’t need my sword for a while, so you don’t have to worry about it.
If I need a weapon, I can use my other sword." Zhang Fei took out several bottles of pills and gave them to the two brothers.
"If you have finished my sword, you can tell Serpentera or Tian Kui directly, and they will inform me."
"Alright!
Leave this matter to us, and you won’t be disappointed with the results."
"Thank you."
After Zhang Fei left, You Feng and You Jian hurriedly went to their forging workshop.
Since their clan decided to follow him, he had helped them a lot, so they wanted to finish it quickly with the best possible results.
"Master."
Zhang Fei nodded to Serpentera and Tian Kui.
"Old Snake and Old Kui, the four perils have finished, and they will be crippled until they die."
"Is that the effect of the items Xu Yuanzhi gave them?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei explained to the two male beasts about the Soulburn Crystals in the bodies of the four perils.
"Although they’re not dead yet, you two can consider your old grudge settled.
As for Xu Yuanzhi, I will help you two settle accounts with him in the future, and you can kill him yourselves."
Serpentera and Tian Kui were greatly relieved to hear that.
"Master, we—"
"No need." Zhang Fei waved his hand.
"You two acknowledged me as your master when I was still weak, and you also helped me a lot when I was still living in the Nine Stars Realm.
I have long regarded you two as my family, and there is no need for thanks between families.
If you two insist on thanking me, you can protect my children in the future."
"Eh?
Have you decided to have children soon, Master?" Both Serpentera and Tian Kui were shocked by that.
"In the future," Zhang Fei sighed.
"All my wives have long wanted children from me, but this universe is still not safe, and both primordial beasts are targeting me.
If I have children now, they will be my weakness, and both beasts will target them."
"Don’t you have your training space and soul world, Master?"
"That’s right, Master.
If you have children, you can hide them in one of those places."
"My soul world is still too weak for them to live in, and my training space is like a prison." Zhang Fei glanced at the sect.
"If I have children, I don’t want them to live confined, and I want them to be able to enjoy a free life.
Thus, I have to improve my cultivation as soon as possible, and I also have to defeat the two primordial beasts before I have children."
Serpentera and Tian Kui nodded in understanding.
"So, when are you going to bring everyone to the domain, Master?"

"Liao Hanxue is still gathering materials to create a barrier in that domain, so I will bring everyone there once the barrier is in place." Zhang Fei opened the gate leading to the Myriad Abyss Domain.
"I will return to that domain now, and I will leave the security of this domain to both of you."
"Yes, Master."
Serpentera let out a sigh of relief after Zhang Fei disappeared.
"Even though we didn’t manage to kill the four perils, they will die a painful death, so I’m satisfied with the outcome."
"Me too." Tian Kui nodded in agreement.
"We only have one enemy left, and our old grudge will be settled after he’s dead.
Unfortunately, he is too strong for us, so we can only rely on our master to kill him."
"Haha," Serpentera laughed.
"Whether we killed that person or not, I don’t think it’s a big deal.
Once our master kills him, our old master’s soul can rest in peace."
Tian Kui furrowed his brows.
"Do you think our old master has been reincarnated, Old Snake?"
"Did you forget that our old master’s soul disappeared after his death?" Tian Kui shook his head at Serpentera.
"Since his soul disappeared from this universe, he can’t be reincarnated.
Honestly, I’d like to meet our old master again, but that’s clearly impossible.
Instead of thinking about him, we should focus on our current master, and we will protect his future descendants."
"Yeah,"
Tian Kui and Serpentera raised their eyebrows, sensing the auras of two powerful cultivators approaching their domain.
Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi instantly appeared beside them.
"The owners of these two auras are Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening."
"Who are those two people?"
"They are the supreme leaders of the Divine Samsara Sect."
Tian Kui and Serpentera exchanged glances for a moment.
"Since the two of them have come to our domain, we must capture them for our master."
"That’s right!
The Divine Samsara Sect wants to kill our master, so we must capture them, and he can use them to control their sect."
"Let’s go!" The four of them immediately flew away from the sect.
Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening were amazed when they entered the domain, especially with the dense forest that covered the entire area.
The only thing they could see was the floating island, which was the location of the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening didn’t dare move carelessly in the domain; they could sense the unusualness of the forest before them.
Furthermore, they couldn’t fly because Zhang Fei had set up a flight-restriction formation in the domain, and only a few people could deactivate it.
"Tch!" Ouyang Xuening clicked her teeth.
"How did that brat change the domain this drastically?
The forest in front of us is filled with formations, and we can’t fly because of the formations in the air.
We’ve been searching for the domain’s location for over half a year, and we finally managed to find it, but the situation is unfavorable for us."
Huang Tianzhun tried to spread his senses to examine the forest, but a formation blocked them.
"I heard Zhang Fei is a rank 10 array master, so he should be the one who created all these formations.
However, all of these formations are high-grade, and the materials to create them are not easy to obtain."
"So, what should we do now?
Should we barge in or leave?"
"We—"
Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening immediately went on alert as soon as they sensed the four powerful auras.
They also took out their weapons to prepare for battle.
"Hahaha," Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening frowned when they saw Serpentera and Tian Kui, but they were more shocked by the presence of Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi with the two beasts.
Tian Kui smirked.
"Old woman, do you think you can leave this domain today?"
"You two are targeting our master, and Liang Huizhong is trying to kill him." Serpentera stared at the two with murderous intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1824: Capture The Two Ancestors
paragraphs: Unlike Tian Kui, Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi didn’t say much and immediately attacked Ouyang Xuening.

Although Ouyang Xuening was a powerful cultivator, Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi were far stronger than her; otherwise, Feng Yao wouldn’t have entrusted the safety of the Twin Flames Domain to them. Not to mention, the old woman faced them both at once, which put her under pressure.

As soon as Serpentera attacked Huang Tianzhun, Tian Kui hurriedly moved to assist his friend. In fact, Old Snake could handle the old man alone because he was an ancient beast who had lived for a very long time, while his opponent was simply too young to be a match for him.

Within moments, their battle broke out, alerting the people living in the domain. Serpentera and the other three didn’t give Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening a chance to breathe, and the two of them quickly found themselves in a tight spot.
Several cultivators who had close relations with Zhang Fei arrived in the area. Seeing Serpentera and the other three facing Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening, they also moved to fight the two.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening, already in a tight spot from the start, were even more overwhelmed by the arrival of those cultivators. Neither of them expected the bonds between the people in the Twin Flames Domain to be so strong, which was their mistake from the start.

After all, Zhang Fei had brought those people to settle in the Twin Flames Domain, and he had also given them many benefits since they met him. Not to mention, he had already informed them that he would be taking them to the Ancient Realm in the future, and they knew that it would bring them even more benefits because the people from that realm were clearly stronger than them.

Zhang Fei’s principle was to make as many friends as possible, and he would avoid those who were unworthy of his friendship. As long as they received benefits that helped them, they would be loyal to him. If they had any thoughts of betraying him in the future, he would simply kill them.

Some time later, Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening’s conditions had worsened significantly, leaving their faces battered. Facing Tian Kui and the other three was already troublesome, and then the other cultivators joined in to gang up on them.
Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi directly sealed Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening’s cultivation, which made them even more desperate.

"Haha," Tian Kui laughed out loud at the sight of the two. "Hey! Where was the arrogance you two had when you ordered your sect members to kill my master? Look at you, your faces look like swollen pigs."
Serpentera simply shook his head and contacted Zhang Fei. "Our master will arrive soon."
Upon hearing that, the other cultivators did not linger in that area, and they immediately returned to their respective clans.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening truly regretted their decision to go to the Twin Flames Domain. They regretted it even more because they underestimated Zhang Fei, and they didn’t know that many powerful cultivators were standing behind him.
Soon, Zhang Fei [5] arrived in front of them and stared at the two people coldly. He replicated their souls, merged them with his, and implanted his demon slave mark into their original souls.
"What will you do next to the Divine Samsara Sect, Master?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei [5] pointed to the helpless Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening. "The Divine Samsara Sect has existed for so long, and many young cultivators depend on its resources, so I will not destroy the sect. Furthermore, these two are my slaves now, and they will help me control Liang Huizhong and the others."
Serpentera and the other three nodded in understanding, as they had already expected that Zhang Fei [5] would answer like that.

Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate leading to the Heavenlight Domain. "Go back to your sect and take care of your subordinates for me! As for your Huang and Ouyang clans, I won’t do anything to them, but I will strip them of their power so they can’t act arrogantly in the future."
Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening’s faces turned pale. Their clans were the strongest among the human race, and they possessed countless resources useful for cultivation.

"If you feel my punishment is too light, I will punish your two clans, and I will send them to the demon domain." Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening looked at Zhang Fei [5] tremblingly. "You certainly know the risks if I send them to the demon domain, right? If they turn into demons, other people will hunt them, and your two clans will be wiped out."
"We... we understand, Master." Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening hurriedly answered. "We... we will take care of everything for you, Master."

"Leave!" Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate after Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening disappeared inside. "My remaining opponent from the human race is Hun Lingwu, but I don’t have time to deal with him, and I will meet him in the future."
"How—"
"No need," Zhang Fei [5] interrupted Tian Kui. "You guys don’t need to bother with him because his fate is clear, and you just need to focus on your cultivation."
"Yes, Master."
Zhang Fei [5] quickly disappeared from their sight.
"We will leave now." Huo Mingyi and Huo Mengyi returned to their private quarters afterwards.
Serpentera breathed a sigh of relief. "After today, our sect and this domain should be safe, so we can concentrate on our cultivation."

"Yeah." Tian Kui nodded in agreement. "I’m sure no cultivator will dare to oppose our master again, but he won’t bully them either. I can’t wait to move to the Ancient Realm, but I know that we will have to wait some time for that."
"Hahaha," Serpentera laughed. "Be patient, Old Kui! Our master will definitely take us to the Ancient Realm, and we must strive hard to become strong so that we can protect his future descendants."

Tian Kui nodded with a happy smile. "Our master has over a hundred wives, so his future descendants will be numerous. I’m just curious whether his future descendants will be born as humans, demons, or beasts."

"You’ll get your answer when our master is ready to have children." Serpentera himself couldn’t wait for Zhang Fei [5]’s descendants. "Perhaps his descendants will reach thousands in the future, and people won’t dare touch them because of his prestige."
"Let’s go back."
"Huh? What happened to you two, Ancestors?" Liang Huizhong and the elders were shocked as soon as Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening entered the main hall.

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening certainly wouldn’t tell them the truth. "From today onward, stop causing trouble with Zhang Fei or the Moonlit Passion Temple; otherwise, Empress Huo will destroy our sect and kill everyone."

Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening chose to bring up Feng Yao’s name in front of them. If those people knew that they had been beaten by Zhang Fei [5]’s contract beasts, they would have no face to face anyone else.
As soon as Huang Tianzhun mentioned Empress Huo’s name, Liang Huizhong and the elders’ faces changed. They were old cultivators, and they knew Feng Yao’s brutal history. "What—"
"Don’t ask and do as I say." Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening hurriedly left the main hall, leaving Liang Huizhong and the elders confused.
"What do you think happened to them, Sect Master? Did Empress Huo really beat them up?" Li Guangyu, the vice sect master of the Divine Samsara Sect, asked.

Liang Huizhong nodded. "Behind her calm demeanor, Empress Huo is a brutal woman. The first time she returned to this realm, she ordered her subordinates to slaughter anyone who had troubled them during her absence; even Emperor Long couldn’t stop her."
"So, are we really going to let Zhang Fei go?"

Liang Huizhong glared at the male elder. "Do you think we can do something to Zhang Fei? Never mind us; our strongest ancestor can’t do anything to him. Since our ancestor has given the order, we have to follow it, and we don’t need to look for that brat anymore."
"I didn’t expect that we would end up becoming Zhang Fei’s slaves." Ouyang Xuening desperately said.

Huang Tianzhun shared Ouyang Xuening’s feelings. At first, he thought he could easily capture Zhang Fei as long as Feng Yao wasn’t protecting him, but he didn’t expect that he would have two powerful beasts by his side. "He hid himself so well! Since he ascended to this realm, he has always acted by himself, so we have no information about the power behind him other than Empress Huo. She even sent two of her strongest confidants to protect that domain."

"So, what should we do now? Are we really going to strip both of our clans of their power? If we do that, the people of both of our clans will rebel, and we will have a hard time controlling the situation."

Huang Tianzhun wasn’t worried about his Huang Clan because he had complete control over it, and his people wouldn’t dare rebel against him. On the contrary, Ouyang Xuening wasn’t the strongest member of the Ouyang Clan, and there were several cultivators far stronger than her within the clan, including her father and grandfather.

Huang Tianzhun sighed. "Since Zhang Fei didn’t give us a time limit, we should hold off for now. I’ll take care of my Huang Clan first, and I’ll help you take care of the Ouyang Clan after everything is done."
"Alright."
"Zhang Fei."
Zhang Fei, who was fighting those mindless demons in the fifth underground, immediately stopped. "Why are you back, Tang Zhiyao?"
"I’ll take you to my dream space, and we’ll discuss the differences between our dream techniques there."
"Let’s go then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1825: Dream But Reality
paragraphs: Zhang Fei was perplexed as soon as Tang Zhiyao brought him into his dream space. Unlike his dream lordship ability, which could only pull others’ subconscious into dreams, her ability could bring others’ real bodies into dreams. "This? How did you do this?"

"I told you from the start that my dream techniques are different from yours, right?" Zhang Fei turned to Tang Zhiyao, who had just landed beside them. He realized that the woman in front of him was her real body and not her ethereal body. "You are a lust demon, and your ability can only pull other people’s subconscious into dreams. As for me, I am a pure dream demon, and I can use my ability to bring other people’s real bodies or subconscious into dreams."
"In other words, this is a dream but also a reality."
Tang Zhiyao nodded. "You can put it like that, Zhang Fei. Normally, other people can’t break into my private space, but someone can do it easily."
"The nightmare lord, Meng Zhuo."

"That’s right! I don’t know how he does it, but I always fail to stop him." Tang Zhiyao waved her hand, and many images featuring Meng Zhuo appeared around them. "Look! That bastard invaded my dream space, and he turned it into a nightmare, which drove me crazy."

Six and a half years ago, we went to my dimensional world, but we found my family missing.

"But what?"
"Your father is no longer there." Ju Yingzhi trembled after Qian Qin said that.
"I’m sorry, my father killed your father long ago."
Tears rolled down from the corners of Ju Yingzhi’s eyes.
"Then, what about my mother and little brother?"
"Your mother—" Qian Qin was at a loss to tell Ju Yingzhi the truth.
"She’s still alive, but she’s no longer the same person, and she probably doesn’t remember you anymore."

She wanted to attack Qian Qin, but she was too strong for her, and she was Zhang Fei’s future woman.

"Her name is Qian Hua."
Ju Yingzhi looked at the qi screen, and her tears flowed even more intensely as she saw her mother’s face.
"Mother...
Mother..."
Qian Qin felt guilty seeing Ju Yingzhi so sad, but she had no words to comfort her, as her sadness was caused by her own father.
Xin Yanluo, who had just arrived, immediately frowned when she saw Ju Yingzhi crying.
She sat beside her master and embraced her; her eyes shot a murderous look towards Qian Qin.
"Yanluo, the woman on the qi screen is my mother." Xin Yanluo was stunned for a moment and turned her gaze to the qi screen.
"My father... he’s dead..."
Xin Yanluo glanced at Qian Qin.
"Did that bastard demon god kill your father, Master?"
"He killed my father, and he altered my mother’s memories." Xin Yanluo wanted to attack Qian Qin, but Ju Yingzhi hugged her tightly to stop her.
"She is innocent in this matter, so you don’t need to attack her.
Besides, her situation is also bad, and her father sacrificed her to capture Zhang Fei."
Xin Yanluo glared at Qian Qin.
"Then, where is your brother, Master?
Is he still alive?"
"Her brother is still alive." Ju Yingzhi looked at Qian Qin.
"One of my sisters fancied your brother, and she begged my father not to kill him.
They live together in your palace, and they already have a son."

"Didn’t your father use all his daughters as tools?
Why did he let your sister be with my brother?"

If he thought his daughters were useless, he wouldn’t use them, and he would exile them." Ju Yingzhi and Xin Yanluo frowned in response to Qian Qin’s words.
"My sister who married your brother was one of his useless daughters, so he allowed them to be together.
Even though he didn’t kill my sister, he never considered her as his daughter."
"Your father is a heartless scumbag!" Xin Yanluo furiously shouted.
"Have you told Zhang Fei about this matter, Master?"
Ju Yingzhi shook her head.
"His clone went into the dungeon, so I haven’t told him about this matter.
Moreover, his strength isn’t enough to face Qian Yan, so I won’t tell him about this matter, at least for now."
"I think you should tell him about this matter, Master."
"But—"
"Master, we’ve lived with him for decades, and you know that he’s not hot-headed." Ju Yingzhi knew that, but she was afraid to tell Zhang Fei the truth.
"He has promised you that he will bring your family back, but he is also aware of his own strength, so I believe that he will not act carelessly.
Even if he insists on going to Qian Yan’s domain, Senior Feng Yao and Senior Huo Ling will protect him, and that scumbag will not be able to stop them."
"Yanluo is right, Yingzhi." The three women turned to Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Yushu.
"My husband already has plans to fight Qian Yan, but he won’t be doing it anytime soon, and he plans to challenge him in ten years.
You must tell him the truth when his clone returns so he can prepare everything from now on, and he will bring your family back to you."
Nalan Yushu spoke.
"If my husband wants, he can defeat Qian Yan anytime with the help of Big Sis Yao and Big Sis Ling, so you don’t need to hesitate to tell him the truth."
"Alright, I’ll talk to him when his clone returns."
Nalan Wangzi looked at Qian Qin.
"What will you do if my husband has the intention of killing your father in the future?
Are you going to stop him?"
"You’re a stupid woman if you want to stop my husband." Nalan Yuzhu said harshly.
"Your father never considered you as his daughter, and you’re just a tool in his eyes.
On the contrary, my husband wants you to be his woman, and you’ll gain many benefits by becoming one."
Qian Qin released a soft sigh.
"Ever since my father sent me to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, I no longer consider him my father, so I will never stop Zhang Fei.
I might be sad if he killed my father, but my sadness won’t last long."
"I think it’s great if you think that way."
"There’s no point in grieving for someone who sees you as a tool."
"Yeah."

chapters.title: Chapter 1827: Infiltrate Qian Yan’s Domain I
paragraphs: Ju Yingzhi was surprised when Zhang Fei [5] suddenly appeared in front of her. "Why are you back? Don’t you still need a lot of demon materials?"
"Wangzi told me about your mother and little brother." Ju Yingzhi turned to Nalan Wangzi, who signaled her to explain the details to Zhang Fei [5]. "Have you really met them, Qin’er?"

Qian Qin nodded to him. "One of my sisters is her little brother’s wife, and we are quite close, even though our father abandoned her. I often play at her family’s palace, so I often meet them. By the way, her mother’s other daughter is Qian Hua, and she is one of the candidates for my father’s next wife."
"Hmm?" Ju Yingzhi, Xin Yanluo, Nalan Wangzi, and Nalan Yushu frowned after Qian Qin made that statement.
Qian Qin continued. "Qian Hua is much younger than me, but she is more important than me because she was born with a special physique."
"A special physique?"
"Yes," Qian Qin nodded. "My father once told me that my sister’s special physique is the Sovereign Demon Physique, and he said that she was destined to become the strongest demon in the universe."

"What a naive demon god." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "The Sovereign Demon Physique may be special to demons, but it won’t help your sister much. At best, she will become the strongest demon in the Paradise Realm, but she will never become the strongest demon in the universe."
"Why is that?" Qian Qin was puzzled.
"There is only one best demon in the universe, and he is the former primordial demon."
Qian Qin gasped in shock. "Did the primordial demon really exist in the past?"

"All races had primordial ones in the past, including the demon race." Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen that displays the primordial demon in the Era of the Beginning. "See him? He is the former primordial demon, and the two primordial beasts worked together to kill him. Before his death, he sent his ten demon seeds away, and one of them has been inside my body for a long time."
"Huh?" Qian Qin was shocked. "Then, where are the other nine?"

"The other nine demon seeds are inside their bodies." Qian Qin looked at Janette, Balena, Ilsath, Orith, Zilvora, Eve, Fyr, Angela, and Yan Zhixiu. "I found the ten demon seeds in the past, and each seed chose a different person."
After hearing that, jealousy rose in Qian Qin’s heart, but she immediately suppressed her jealousy.

"If someone is destined to become the strongest demon in this universe, that person is me." Qian Qin looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Based on the information I got some time ago, there is only one main seed from the ten demon seeds, and the seed is in my body. Honestly, I have never used the power of the demon seeds because my nine wives are weak compared to the demons from the Paradise Realm or the Ancient Realm, so I have never brought them to fight by my side."
"So, without those demon seeds, the primordial demon will never be born in this universe, right, husband?"
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at Nalan Wangzi. "I haven’t found the answer to that, but Feng Yao said that there is still a possibility that the primordial demon will return to this universe."

"Since Sister Yao has said so, I believe the primordial demon will be born again in this universe, and you are the one." Nalan Yushu agreed with Nalan Wangzi. "I wonder about your demon strength if they fight by your side, husband."
"I’m curious about that too." Nalan Yushu said.

"Let’s not talk about that for now." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate leading to the Thousand Eyes Demon Domain. "Let’s go, Yingzhi. We’re going to save your mother and little brother! You must come with us, Qin’er."
"But—"

"Your father won’t arrive at your domain anytime soon, so we must take advantage of his absence to rescue Yingzhi’s mother and little brother. After that, I will bring them here, so your father won’t be able to find them."
Ju Yingzhi stood up and walked to Zhang Fei [5]’s side. "Yanluo, you must stay in this domain, or it will be difficult for him to protect us."
"Yes, Master." Xin Yanluo was aware of her weak strength, so she didn’t insist on going with them.
Qian Qin was reluctant to return to her domain, but she had no other choice since Ju Yingzhi’s family’s location was hidden, and only a few people knew about it, including her.
Qian Qin inwardly sighed and stood up. "Let’s go; I’ll take you two to that place."
Moments later, they had already arrived at the Thousand Eyes Demon Domain. A male demon instantly appeared in front of them, causing Qian Qin to frown. "What—"
"He is Wu Mian." Qian Qin stared at Zhang Fei [5] dumbfounded. "We’re going to save Yingzhi’s family."
"Oh?" Wu Mian looked at Ju Yingzhi before looking at Qian Qin. "Since this little girl is Qian Yan’s daughter, she should know their location, right?"
"That’s right," Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Where are they located, Qin’er?"
Qian Qin pointed towards the palace. "My father hid their palace behind ours, and a powerful formation covered it, so no one could find it. I can open that formation, and we can enter there easily."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Before we go there, we’ll go see Qian Hua first. I’m sure your father didn’t let her stay in his palace, and he placed her in a special place, right?"
Qian Qin nodded. "My father didn’t want others to know that Qian Hua possesses the Sovereign Demon Physique, so he hid her carefully, and no outsiders knew of her existence."
"The Sovereign Demon Physique?" Wu Mian was shocked.
"You don’t need to think about it, Old Wu. The Sovereign Demon Physique does have many advantages, but it is not comparable to the ten supreme physiques."
"If I remember correctly, two of your wives have two of the ten supreme physiques, right?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Feng Yao has the Immortal Reincarnation Physique, and my other wife has the Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique."
"Empress Huo, huh?" Wu Mian sucked in a deep breath of air. "No wonder she’s so powerful, and she can also reincarnate multiple times without losing her memories."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "The hostage of the four perils has the Myriad Dao Physique, but they’re hiding him somewhere else."
"The four perils are no longer useful. Why don’t you force them to tell you that person’s location?"
"I wanted to do that, but then I heard about Qian Yan, so I focused on him first." Zhang Fei [5] enveloped the three of them with his aura. "Let’s not talk about that person anymore."
Once they arrived at the palace, Qian Qin led Zhang Fei [5] and the others around until they reached the eastern side. "My father hid Qian Hua in this place."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow, observing the barrier that covered the place. "Can you open it?"
"Yes," Qian Qin took out a token and pressed it against the barrier, and a gap opened on its surface. "Let’s go in."
After they entered, the barrier closed by itself, and they arrived in an area with a large garden. At the northern end, they saw a small luxurious house, and it looked more like a small palace.
"This—"
"A subspace." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Wu Mian. "Back then, you failed to find Ju Yingzhi’s family because Qian Yan hid their palace in a subspace."
Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I don’t know Qian Yan’s true abilities because he has too many abilities, and he rarely fights with other demon gods, except Mo Shentian."

"That’s why I don’t want to fight Qian Yan yet, and I’ll wait another ten years before challenging him." Zhang Fei [5] took Ju Yingzhi’s hand. "Are you ready to meet your half-sister? Since your mother has no memories of you, your half-sister definitely doesn’t know you."
Ju Yingzhi pondered for a while before nodding. "Let’s meet her."
"Let’s go."

When they arrived in front of the small palace, Qian Hua happened to be walking out of it. She was shocked to see Qian Qin bringing three strangers into her subspace. "Who are these three, Big Sis Qin? Why did you bring them here? If our father finds out, he will punish you severely."

Zhang Fei [5] scanned Qian Hua’s status and read it, finding that she indeed possessed the Sovereign Demon Physique. Her cultivation was far below Qian Qin’s, as she was several hundred years younger, to be precise, at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm.
Qian Qin took Qian Hua’s hand. "Hua’er, do you want to leave this place?"
"Huh?" Qian Hua blinked her eyes several times. "What do you mean by that? If—"

"Hua’er, I believe you are not a naive woman. You should already know the fate of our big sisters, right?" Qian Hua opened her mouth without saying anything, and then she nodded to Qian Qin. "Since you already know the fate that awaits us, you surely don’t want to accept it resignedly, right?"
Qian Hua smiled bitterly. "What can we do, Big Sis? Our father has marked our souls with his mark, and we cannot go against his order."
"He can help us." Qian Hua turned to Zhang Fei [5], but she was skeptical that he could help her and Qian Qin free themselves from their father. "His name is Zhang Fei, and he is my future husband."
Qian Hua was stunned. "How—"
"Let’s not waste any time," Zhang Fei [5] interrupted and pulled Qian Hua’s soul out of her body instantly, which shocked her. "There is no Qian Yan’s mark in her soul."

chapters.title: Chapter 1828: Infiltrate Qian Yan’s Domain II
paragraphs: Qian Qin tilted her head, looking at Zhang Fei [5]. "Are you sure about that?"
"Unlike you, your half-sister doesn’t have two souls, and this one is her original soul."
"Two souls?" Qian Hua looked at Qian Qin. "Do you really have two souls, Big Sis?"
Qian Qin sighed as she nodded. "Our father used one of his abilities to duplicate my soul. One soul has my original memories, and the other has my tampered memories."
"So, you’re saying that your current memories aren’t the original?" Qian Hua was baffled.

"You can say it like that." Despite her calm words, Qian Qin felt deep pain in her heart. "I can’t access my original memories because our father sealed my original soul, and I don’t know since when I have been living with tampered memories."
"How did you know about that?"
"Empress Huo." Qian Hua was momentarily stunned after hearing the name. "Zhang Fei is the husband of Empress Huo’s reincarnation, and we met at the Tower of Eternity."

Qian Hua looked at Zhang Fei [5] in shock, not expecting him to be the husband of Huo Yanling’s reincarnation. Although she lived in confinement, she had heard of Huo Yanling, the greatest empress of the Paradise Realm.

"Empress Huo can access my original soul, but she cannot remove our father’s ability from within my soul." Qian Qin tapped Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder. "If he didn’t copy my memories every day, I would definitely forget many things."
"I see." Qian Hua fell into deep thought, but she had no answer regarding her father’s actions.
Zhang Fei [5] returned Qian Hua’s soul into her body. "Qin’er, check her body."
"No need," Qian Hua refused. "You don’t need to check, and I can tell you that our father’s black mark is under my navel."
Qian Qin rubbed the area below her navel. "He implanted his black mark into all of his daughters’ bodies, including you."
"Be patient and wait another ten years."
"I know."
"What’s with another ten years?" Qian Hua asked.

"Zhang Fei will challenge our father in ten years, and he will defeat him then." Qian Hua was stunned, but then Qian Qin pointed to Wu Mian. "He is the Faceless Demon God, Wu Mian. Apart from him, Demon God Ye Mingran and Demon God Qi Qingxiu are Zhang Fei’s wives, and Demon God Nalan Shizhe is his mother-in-law."

Qian Hua was completely shocked after Qian Qin mentioned all that; she looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a look of admiration. The three female demon gods were as powerful as their father, but two of them chose to be his wives, and the other one was his mother-in-law.

"Haha! You don’t need to look at him like that, little girl." Since she already knew Wu Mian’s identity, she had no problem being called a little girl. "This kid has already united eight of the ten demon races, and only two have yet to join him."
"My father and who?"
"Mo Shentian."

Qian Hua wasn’t surprised to hear that because Qian Yan and Mo Shentian were the strongest among the ten demon gods, but she didn’t expect that Zhang Fei [5] could unite eight of the ten demon races, which was unprecedented.
Zhang Fei [5] pulled Ju Yingzhi to his side, confusing Qian Hua. "She is your half-sister."
"Huh?" Qian Hua was confused by that. "What do you mean by that? My mother doesn’t have other children; she only has me and my big brother."
"Your mother is Ju Yuning, and your big brother is Ju Yifan." Qian Hua nodded slightly. "My name is Ju Yingzhi, the daughter of Ju Yuning and Ju Zhichen."
Qian Hua frowned because she didn’t know Ju Zhichen. "How is that possible? My mother and big brother are—"

"Zhang Fei is a lust demon, and he has more than a hundred wives."
Qian Hua massaged the bridge of her nose. "He has too many wives, Big Sis!"

"Really?" Qian Hua didn’t believe it.
Qian Qin nodded. "All of Zhang Fei’s wives live under the same roof, and they have a harmonious relationship."
"Huh?" Qian Hua blinked repeatedly. "Do they really live under the same roof?"
"Yes," Qian Qin looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "He will take you with us, and you will meet some of his wives later, so you can witness the harmony of their relationship firsthand."
Qian Hua nodded slightly. "Have you given your body to him, Big Sis?"
"Not yet," Qian Qin sighed. "If we do that, our father’s black mark will affect his soul, so we haven’t done it."
"Where do you all live now?"
"In the Myriad Abyss Domain."
"Why have I never heard of that domain before?"

"Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1829: Infiltrate Qian Yan’s Domain III
paragraphs: As soon as they arrived at the main garden, Ju Yingzhi froze in place, unable to move forward. Her trembling eyes stared at the middle-aged woman who was chatting with a young man and a young woman.
Tears flowed down from Ju Yingzhi’s eyes, and her body began to tremble. "Zhang Fei... they are my mother and little brother."
Qian Qin looked at Ju Yingzhi, sighing heavily in her heart. ’What will happen if they can’t remember her?’
Zhang Fei [5] held Ju Yingzhi’s hand tightly. "Are you ready to meet them?"

"I—" Ju Yingzhi wanted to meet her mother and little brother, who had been separated from her for a long time. However, there was a nagging feeling in her heart; she was afraid that they wouldn’t recognize her and would reject her.
Qian Hua glanced at Ju Yingzhi before walking towards her mother and big brother. "Mother! Big Brother! I came to visit you."

Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan turned to look at Qian Hua, but the sight of Ju Yingzhi, who was standing beside Zhang Fei [5], caught their attention. They could recognize that she was a member of the Abyssal Rift Demon Race like them, but her face gave off a familiar feeling.

The young woman, who was sitting beside Ju Yifan, felt something unusual in the expressions of her husband and mother-in-law. She followed their line of sight and found Ju Yingzhi in the distance. ’An Abyssal Rift Demon? Who exactly is that woman? Why is she crying? Why is her gaze towards my mother-in-law and husband so strange?’
"Mother." Qian Hua stood beside Ju Yuning, but her mother’s gaze only focused on Ju Yingzhi’s figure.
Ju Yuning’s gaze never left her eldest daughter. "Who is that young lady, Hua’er? Why do I feel so familiar with her face and aura?"
"I feel the same as you, Mother." With his gaze fixed on his big sister, Ju Yifan asked his little sister a question. "Where did you find her?"

Their reactions when they looked at Ju Yingzhi made Qian Hua believe that they were indeed related to each other, especially her mother’s reaction. After all, Ju Yuning was the woman who gave birth to Ju Yingzhi, and they supposedly shared an inexplicable bond.

’It seems true that that woman is my half-sister,’ Qian Hua inwardly muttered. "Mother and Big Brother, you two should be able to recognize that she is an Abyssal Rift Demon like you, right? Her name is Ju Yingzhi, and she—"
"Ju... Yingzhi..." Ju Yuning clutched her chest, feeling a pain in her heart. Tears involuntarily flowed from her trembling eyes. "Ju... Yingzhi..."
Ju Yifan also felt a strange feeling after Qian Hua mentioned Ju Yingzhi’s name, and her name made him feel emptiness in his heart. "Who... who are you?"

Standing beside Zhang Fei [5], Ju Yingzhi trembled even more, and her tears flowed even more freely. She wanted to run and hug them, but her legs somehow wouldn’t move forward due to the fear in her heart.
"Let’s go." Zhang Fei [5] held Ju Yingzhi and teleported in front of Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan.
Qian Qin let out a soft sigh, and she immediately ran towards them. However, she didn’t want to disturb them, and she stood beside Ju Yifan’s wife.

Ju Yifan’s wife was baffled seeing the intense reactions of the three of them. She looked at Qian Hua, but her sister shook her head and signaled her not to ask anything. She frowned at that and then turned her gaze to Qian Qin. ’Who exactly are these two people, Big Sis?’

’Her name is Ju Yingzhi, and she is your sister-in-law, Qian Xian.’ Qian Xian looked at Qian Qin with a questioning and shocked expression. ’She is your mother-in-law’s eldest daughter, and past circumstances separated them for so long.’

Qian Xian didn’t know whether to believe Qian Qin or not; her mother-in-law and husband never mentioned anything about Ju Yingzhi. ’Is she really my mother-in-law’s daughter? Who is the man beside her?’

’I’ve watched her memories from when she was little until they were separated from each other many years ago, so she is truly your mother-in-law’s daughter.’ Qian Xian looked at Ju Yingzhi before looking at Zhang Fei [5]. ’His name is Zhang Fei, and he is her husband.’
Qian Xian didn’t say anything else, waiting for her mother-in-law and husband to speak. Her gaze constantly shifted from Zhang Fei [5] and Ju Yingzhi. ’This is weird! Her husband is a lust demon.’
"Mother... Little Brother..." Ju Yingzhi choked and cried even harder. "I... I am your daughter and big sister, Little Yingzhi."
Ju Yuning’s feelings stirred violently as soon as Ju Yingzhi called her mother. "Little... Yingzhi..."
Ju Yifan opened his mouth, but not a word came out of his mouth. His gaze was fully focused on Ju Yingzhi, and his body visibly trembled, forcing him to hold his wife’s hand.
Zhang Fei inwardly [5] sighed. "Yingzhi, show them all your old memories and let them see the relationship between the three of you firsthand."
Ju Yingzhi said nothing and waved her hand. At that moment, thousands of qi screens appeared around them, displaying her past memories.
Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, Qian Hua, and Qian Xian looked at all those qi screens with solemn expressions.
[Master, judging from Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan’s reactions, Qian Yan never erased their old memories, and those memories are hidden deep in their brains.]

Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Mei; Otherwise, Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan would not have reacted so strongly when they heard that Ju Yingzhi was their daughter and eldest sister. ’Since Qian Yan didn’t erase their old memories, I should be able to restore them, and Yingzhi will reunite with them after this. By the way, have you scanned the area in this palace?’

[I’ve scanned everything, but there’s nothing in this palace, Master.] Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that. [Qian Yan seems to have taken all the valuables long ago, and he left the unimportant items here.]
’That greedy beast not only kidnapped them, but he also robbed them, huh?’ Zhang Fei [5] flicked Qian Qin’s hand. ’Do you know where your father keeps his treasures?’
Qian Qin looked at Zhang Fei [5] bewilderedly. ’Do you intend to rob my father?’
’Well? Your father robbed Ju Yingzhi’s family, and I’m her husband, so I have to take revenge on him, right?’ Zhang Fei [5] nonchalantly answered.

Qian Qin could see the seriousness in Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes. ’Unfortunately, my father never trusted anyone, including all his children. He doesn’t keep all his treasures in the palace, and he keeps them in another place that only he can enter.’
’Tch! Your father is too stingy with his children!’ Qian Qin could only smile wryly. ’How are you supposed to improve your cultivation if he’s that stingy?’

’Even though he didn’t keep all his treasures in the palace, he always provided us with the cultivation resources we needed; otherwise, my cultivation wouldn’t have been able to reach this stage, right?’

Zhang Fei [5] just nodded and didn’t comment anymore. He looked at Ju Yingzhi, who was focused on observing the faces of her mother and little brother. Tears continued to flow from her eyes, but she occasionally laughed softly, seeing all their old memories.
Even though they didn’t say anything, Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan were already crying while watching Ju Yingzhi’s memories. They couldn’t recognize her, but they recognized their figures in her memories.
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t bother them, and he was more interested in Qian Hua, especially her Sovereign Demon Physique. ’Do you think her physique would be useful, Mei?’

[Even though the Sovereign Demon Physique is not comparable to the ten special physiques, it is still useful for her, Master. If she reaches the Celestial God Realm and becomes a demon god in the future, she will become stronger than Qi Qingxiu and the others.]

’After all, Qi Qingxiu and the others don’t have any special physiques. Even though they have been demon gods for a long time, they won’t be able to match Qian Hua if she reaches the same level as them.’ Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his chin in thought. ’If she cultivates in the Myriad Abyss Domain, she will also surpass Mo Qingwen and the others, and she can become the sole ruler of that domain.’

[Are you thinking of helping Qian Hua become the ruler of the Myriad Abyss Domain, Master? She has a special physique, but she’s too young compared to Mo Qingwen and the others, and it will take her a very long time to reach their level. However, you can help her to reach their level faster, and you only need to dual cultivate with her.]
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. ’Compared to Qian Hua, I am more eager to dual cultivate with you, Mei.’
[Humph! Keep dreaming! I’m just the supervisor of the system, and I don’t have a form, so you won’t be able to dual cultivate with me.]

’Hehe,’ Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. ’Tell me the truth, Mei. Have you ever thought about dual cultivating with me? You’ve accompanied me from the beginning of my cultivation path, and you’ve always watched me dual cultivate with all my wives.’
[Humph! I’m not a pervert like you!] After that, Mei didn’t say anything else and ignored Zhang Fei [5].

Qian Hua noticed that Zhang Fei [5] was looking at her, but his gaze wasn’t intense or lewd, and she could tell that he was thinking something about her. ’What is he thinking? Does he intend to take me as his woman? If that’s true, doesn’t that mean I have to share him with Big Sis Qin? Unfortunately, he has more than a hundred wives, and I don’t like a man like him.’

His gaze was fully focused on Ju Yingzhi, and his body visibly trembled, forcing him to hold his wife’s hand.
Zhang Fei inwardly [5] sighed.
"Yingzhi, show them all your old memories and let them see the relationship between the three of you firsthand."
Ju Yingzhi said nothing and waved her hand.
At that moment, thousands of qi screens appeared around them, displaying her past memories.
Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, Qian Hua, and Qian Xian looked at all those qi screens with solemn expressions.
[Master, judging from Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan’s reactions, Qian Yan never erased their old memories, and those memories are hidden deep in their brains.]

Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Mei; Otherwise, Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan would not have reacted so strongly when they heard that Ju Yingzhi was their daughter and eldest sister. ’Since Qian Yan didn’t erase their old memories, I should be able to restore them, and Yingzhi will reunite with them after this.
By the way, have you scanned the area in this palace?’
[I’ve scanned everything, but there’s nothing in this palace, Master.] Zhang Fei [5] frowned at that.
[Qian Yan seems to have taken all the valuables long ago, and he left the unimportant items here.]
’That greedy beast not only kidnapped them, but he also robbed them, huh?’ Zhang Fei [5] flicked Qian Qin’s hand. ’Do you know where your father keeps his treasures?’
Qian Qin looked at Zhang Fei [5] bewilderedly. ’Do you intend to rob my father?’
’Well?
Your father robbed Ju Yingzhi’s family, and I’m her husband, so I have to take revenge on him, right?’ Zhang Fei [5] nonchalantly answered.
Qian Qin could see the seriousness in Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes. ’Unfortunately, my father never trusted anyone, including all his children.
He doesn’t keep all his treasures in the palace, and he keeps them in another place that only he can enter.’
’Tch!
Your father is too stingy with his children!’ Qian Qin could only smile wryly. ’How are you supposed to improve your cultivation if he’s that stingy?’

’Even though he didn’t keep all his treasures in the palace, he always provided us with the cultivation resources we needed; otherwise, my cultivation wouldn’t have been able to reach this stage, right?’
Zhang Fei [5] just nodded and didn’t comment anymore.
He looked at Ju Yingzhi, who was focused on observing the faces of her mother and little brother.
Tears continued to flow from her eyes, but she occasionally laughed softly, seeing all their old memories.
Even though they didn’t say anything, Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan were already crying while watching Ju Yingzhi’s memories.
They couldn’t recognize her, but they recognized their figures in her memories.
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t bother them, and he was more interested in Qian Hua, especially her Sovereign Demon Physique. ’Do you think her physique would be useful, Mei?’
[Even though the Sovereign Demon Physique is not comparable to the ten special physiques, it is still useful for her, Master.
If she reaches the Celestial God Realm and becomes a demon god in the future, she will become stronger than Qi Qingxiu and the others.]
’After all, Qi Qingxiu and the others don’t have any special physiques.

Even though they have been demon gods for a long time, they won’t be able to match Qian Hua if she reaches the same level as them.’ Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his chin in thought. ’If she cultivates in the Myriad Abyss Domain, she will also surpass Mo Qingwen and the others, and she can become the sole ruler of that domain.’
[Are you thinking of helping Qian Hua become the ruler of the Myriad Abyss Domain, Master?
She has a special physique, but she’s too young compared to Mo Qingwen and the others, and it will take her a very long time to reach their level.
However, you can help her to reach their level faster, and you only need to dual cultivate with her.]
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. ’Compared to Qian Hua, I am more eager to dual cultivate with you, Mei.’
[Humph!
Keep dreaming!
I’m just the supervisor of the system, and I don’t have a form, so you won’t be able to dual cultivate with me.]
’Hehe,’ Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. ’Tell me the truth, Mei.
Have you ever thought about dual cultivating with me?
You’ve accompanied me from the beginning of my cultivation path, and you’ve always watched me dual cultivate with all my wives.’
[Humph!
I’m not a pervert like you!] After that, Mei didn’t say anything else and ignored Zhang Fei [5].
Qian Hua noticed that Zhang Fei [5] was looking at her, but his gaze wasn’t intense or lewd, and she could tell that he was thinking something about her. ’What is he thinking?
Does he intend to take me as his woman?
If that’s true, doesn’t that mean I have to share him with Big Sis Qin?
Unfortunately, he has more than a hundred wives, and I don’t like a man like him.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1830: Infiltrate Qian Yan’s Domain IV
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow, seeing the change in Qian Hua’s expression. He could see a faint blush on her cheeks, proving that she was thinking of something indecent.
"Little Yingzhi."

Ju Yuning’s hoarse voice suddenly rang out. She stood up from her seat and approached her eldest daughter. Although she had no memories of Ju Yingzhi, her own feelings and her eldest daughter’s memories already proved their familial relationship.
Ju Yuning looked at Ju Yingzhi with various feelings—confusion, longing, affection, and others. She wanted to hug her eldest daughter, but she felt hesitant to raise her arms.
"Mother."
Ju Yingzhi threw herself into her mother’s embrace, hugged her tightly, and enjoyed the warmth of her body.
"For thousands of years, I have always missed you, but I didn’t have the strength to return to you."
Hearing the longing in Ju Yingzhi’s voice, Ju Yuning no longer hesitated and hugged her eldest daughter straight away, causing her to cry louder than before.
Ju Yuning said nothing and hugged Ju Yingzhi even tighter. Her right hand gently stroked the back of her head, and her left hand lightly patted her back.

Just like his mother, Ju Yifan also has no memories of Ju Yingzhi. However, he believed that she was his missing eldest sister. Some demons could manipulate memories, but no demons could create memories as real as his eldest sister’s memories. In all those memories, he could see their lives were joyful, and their parents loved them very much.

However, Ju Yifan had many questions about their father’s identity because he had no memories of him, but he existed in Ju Yingzhi’s memories. He wanted to ask his eldest sister about that, but he would rather not disturb her reunion with their mother.
"Husband." Ju Yifan turned to his wife, Qian Xian, and held her hand. "She—"
"Yes," Ju Yifan nodded. "Although I don’t have any memories of her, her memories are proof that she is my elder sister, and she is also your sister-in-law."
"Sister-in-law, huh?" Qian Xian mumbled softly, looking at Ju Yingzhi, who was still crying in Ju Yuning’s arms.

Qian Hua was at a loss as she suddenly found her half-sister out of nowhere. She was at a loss to accept the reality, but Ju Yingzhi’s memories were enough to prove that she was her half-sister. Not to mention, Qian Qin had previously told her that their father kidnapped her half-sister’s family, and he also killed her father, which left no room to dispute the facts. ’A half-sister, huh? It’s not that bad, right?’

Qian Qin breathed a sigh of relief; she felt happy because Ju Yingzhi and Ju Yuning could finally reunite after such a long time. She nudged Zhang Fei [5] and pointed at Ju Yifan. "You should restore his memories first."
"Yeah," Ju Yifan raised an eyebrow as Zhang Fei [5] approached him. "Let me check your memories first to see if I can restore your past memories or not."
"Do you have the ability to do that?" Qian Xian didn’t mean to doubt Zhang Fei [5], but the fact was that a lust demon didn’t have that kind of ability.
Zhang Fei [5] cast her a side glance. "Whether I can do it or not, you can see for yourself later, but I have to check his memories first."
"Husband, he—"
"Alright, you don’t need to worry, wife." Ju Yifan looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Please check my memories."
"Good!" Zhang Fei [5] touched Ju Yifan’s forehead and closed his eyes. "Hmm? Luckily, Qian Yan didn’t alter your memories, but he sealed your past memories."
"Can you break the seal?" Ju Yifan and Qian Xian asked at the same time.

"Others might not be able to do it, but it’s a trivial matter for me." Ju Yifan, Qian Xian, and Qian Hua were shocked when Zhang Fei [5]’s cultivation suddenly skyrocketed and surpassed Qian Yan. "It will make you dizzy and nauseous, so you have to endure it for a while.

"Alright." As soon as Zhang Fei [5] used his demon ability, Ju Yifan experienced a severe headache and extreme nausea. Qian Xian panicked a little seeing him like that, and she held his hand tightly. "Ugh!"
"Break!"
Ju Yifan heard a crack in his mind, and a few seconds later, many memories flooded his mind, which were his old ones. "Father... Big Sis Yingzhi..."
Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly and pulled his hand back, looking at Ju Yuning and Ju Yingzhi. "His old memories are back, Yingzhi."
"Is... is that true?" Ju Yingzhi asked Zhang Fei [5], but her eyes were focused on Ju Yifan.
"Have I ever lied to you?"
Ju Yingzhi shook her head at Zhang Fei [5] and sat Ju Yuning on a chair. "Please restore my mother’s memories."
"Alright," Zhang Fei [5] touched Ju Yuning’s forehead, and he used the same method he used on Ju Yifan before. "Done."
Soon, Ju Yuning’s past memories flooded her mind, but she said nothing and suppressed the headache.
Ju Yingzhi knelt beside her mother and held her hands. "How are you feeling, Mother? Have you remembered everything?"

"I have remembered everything." Ju Yuning patted her eldest daughter’s head and looked at her face longingly. "You’ve grown so much, Little Yingzhi. I’m glad that you survived that disaster, and we finally meet again after so long."
"Mother!" Once again, Ju Yingzhi threw herself into her mother’s arms, crying. "Mother... mother... I missed you so much."
Ju Yuning closed her eyes, hugged her eldest daughter’s head, and cried. "I missed you too, Little Yingzhi."

Seeing his mother and eldest sister, Ju Yifan couldn’t hold back his tears, and the sound of his sobbing was heard by the others. He hugged his wife, burying his face into her shoulder. "Wife, I finally met my eldest sister again."
"Congratulations on your family reunion, husband," Qian Xian said sincerely while hugging her husband.

Qian Qin walked beside Qian Hua, who had begun to cry. She hugged her sister and comforted her. "From today onward, the lives of the four of you will change, and we will live better lives in the future."
"Can we really free ourselves from our father, Big Sis?" Qian Hua asked sobbingly.
Qian Qin glanced at Zhang Fei [5]. "We cannot free ourselves from our father with our strength, but Zhang Fei will help us gain our freedom."
*Tap... Tap...*
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow and turned towards the sound of footsteps, seeing Qian Yu standing frozen in the distance while looking at him in shock.

’How did he get in here?’ Qian Yu looked at the people behind Zhang Fei [5]; he frowned when he found Qian Qin with the others. ’Did Qin’er bring him here? Why did she do this? If our father finds out about this matter, he will definitely kill her.’
"Oh? You seem afraid of me, Little Prince," Zhang Fei [5] asked in a calm voice without any hint of mockery.

Qian Qin hurriedly let go of Qian Hua and hugged Zhang Fei [5]’s hand. "Please don’t fight with my brother. I remember the problems between us in the Tower of Eternity back then, but he is my brother, and he is the only person who cares about me."
"Alright," Zhang Fei [5] patted her hand, giving her relief. "As long as he doesn’t stand in my way and oppose me, I won’t do anything to him. After all, he is my future brother-in-law, right?"
"Haha," Qian Qin softly laughed before shouting at Qian Yu. "You can come here now, Brother. Your brother-in-law won’t attack you, so you don’t need to be afraid of him."
"Huh?" Qian Yu was stunned when he heard that. ’Since when did Qin’er become his wife? Didn’t our father previously send her to seduce him? Why do I feel that she fell for his seduction?’
"Geez! Brother! Why are you just standing there in a daze?" Qian Qin shouted again.
Qian Yun took a deep breath and approached them, but he still kept his distance from Zhang Fei [5]. "This... Qin’er, since when did you two become a couple?"
"Since that day in the forest, Brother."
"That day? Which forest?" Qian Yu was confused.

"The forest in the Glazed Heaven Domain." Qian Yu tried to recall all the events in the domain, but his memories were different from the closeness of Qian Qin and Zhang Fei [5] now. "Do you remember when I suddenly disappeared as soon as we left the tower?"
"Yes?"
"At that time, Zhang Fei kidnapped me, and we talked about many things. We—Ahh!" Qian Yin yelped as soon as Zhang Fei [5] slapped her butt. "Why did you do that?"
Zhang Fei [5] smirked. "That day, we weren’t just talking, remember? We also—"
"Stop!" Qian Qin covered Zhang Fei [5]’s mouth; her face was burning hot. "Don’t mention that!"

’So, Qin’er has been in love with this man since that day? But how can she remember what happened that day? Shouldn’t those memories have disappeared from her mind?’ Qian Yu wondered to himself. "Then, what about—"
"Don’t mention that, Brother." Qian Qin sighed heavily and pulled her hand down. "When I arrived at the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Zhang Fei came to me and restored my memories."
"Restore your memories?"
Qian Qin nodded. "Before we parted that day, he had already copied my memories, and he returned them to me when we met again in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."
"I see." Qian Yu nodded in understanding and explored at Ju Yuning, who was crying with Ju Yingzhi in her arms. "Hmm? What exactly is going on here? Who is that female demon?"
Qian Qin looked at Zhang Fei [5], who nodded at her. "Her name is Ju Yingzhi, and she is Ju Yuning’s eldest daughter."
"Huh?" Qian Yu was shocked again. "What do you mean by that, Qin’er?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1831: Infiltrate Qian Yan’s Domain V
paragraphs: "What Qin’er means is that your father is an arrogant asshole!" Qian Yu looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a frown. "Do you think your strength is enough to fight me?"
Qian Yu took a deep breath after learning that Zhang Fei [5]’s cultivation was on the same level as his father, but he didn’t know about his ability to borrow the power of other cultivators.

"Without your father’s presence, I can annihilate your demon race. If I want, I can also kill your father." Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, Qian Xian, and Qian Hua did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] was so domineering. He even dared to say such things in their domain, and his expression did not show the slightest fear. "However, I don’t want to do that now, and I will wait a few more years to kill him."
"Hahaha." All of them turned towards the voice, but only Zhang Fei [5], Qian Qin, and Qian Hua recognized Wu Mian. "You scared this little prince, kid."
’Who is that man, Qin’er? What is his relationship with Zhang Fei?’ Qian Yu asked his sister via voice transmission.
Qian Qin smiled in amusement because of her big brother’s funny expression. ’Brother, he is Demon God Wu Mian.’
’Huh?’ Qian Yu froze. ’Is he really the Faceless Demon God Wu Mian?’
’Yeah.’ Qian Qin nodded. ’Eight out of ten demon gods are already on Zhang Fei’s side; only our father and Mo Shentian are left.’
Qian Yu felt dizzy after hearing that; he didn’t expect that Zhang Fei [5] had such a relationship with the eight demon gods. With his connection, he could easily destroy his demon race.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Wu Mian. "Did you find anything interesting, Old Wu?"
"Tch!" Wu Mian clicked his teeth. "That Qian Yan is greedy but stingy! He didn’t leave any treasure in this palace! So, how’s your business here? Is everything settled?"
"Yeah," Zhang Fei [5] turned to Ju Yuning and Ju Yingzhi. "Yingzhi, we have to take your mother and the others out of here, and Qian Yan won’t be able to find them there."
"Yes," Ju Yingzhi looked up at her mother. "Mother, we—"
"Who is he, Yingzhi?" Ju Yuning asked, looking at Zhang Fei [5].

"He is my future husband, Mother." Ju Yingzhi’s answer surprised Ju Yuning and Ju Yifan. "We met in the Three Mortal Realms, and he brought me back to this Paradise Realm when he ascended here. A few years ago, I brought him to our dimensional world, and we found out that Qian Yan kidnapped all of you."

Ju Yuning wanted to say something, but Zhang Fei [5] interrupted her. "We must leave this place, and we will talk about many things later. You guys don’t need to think about Qian Yan, and I will help you take revenge on him in ten years."
"What do you think about that, Mother?" Ju Yifan asked his mother.
Qian Xian didn’t say anything, but she had already decided to follow her husband and mother-in-law. Her father didn’t need her, and he abandoned her because she was unworthy of his care.

Ju Yuning let out a soft sigh. "My only wish is to avenge your father’s death, but we are no match for Qian Yan. Since Zhang Fei has a safe haven for us, and your big sister has also returned to us, we should go with them."
"Alright." Ju Yifan immediately agreed. "Wife, we have to pack our personal belongings."
"Okay." After Ju Yifan and Qian Xian left, Ju Yingzhi also went with Ju Yuning to help her mother pack.
"What about you? Do you need to pack?" Qian Qin asked her half-sister.
Qian Hua shook her head. "I don’t have many personal belongings, and I keep them in my storage ring, so I can leave at any time."

"Are you really going to go with them?" Qian Yu didn’t expect Zhang Fei [5] to take everyone away, but he didn’t intend to stop them. He was familiar with his father’s character, and he also knew his plans for Qian Hua and Qian Qin.

Qian Hua nodded to Qian Yu. "Brother, my life will be doomed if I stay here, and our father will use my body to produce his new offspring. I don’t want that to happen to me, and I want to live freely like the people out there, so I have to leave this place."
"Do you want to come with us, Brother?" Qian Qin asked while glancing at Zhang Fei [5], but he pretended not to see that. ’Sigh! He hates my brother and father.’

"I am the prince of our demon race, and I have my own responsibilities, so I will not go anywhere." Qian Yu patted the heads of the two women. "I’m sorry, I don’t have the power to change your fate. Since Zhang Fei has the ability to change your fate, you two should go with him."
"Brother!" Qian Qin and Qian Hua hugged Qian Yu. "Take care of yourselves, and we will meet again in the future."
"Haha," Qian Yu laughed, hugging them back. "We’ll definitely meet again in the future, and I hope things will be better for all of us."
The two women released Qian Yu, and then Qian Qin spoke. "Zhang Fei will make things better for us in the future."
"I will wait until the day comes." Qian Yu looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Please take good care of my two sisters."
"As long as they stay with me, I guarantee that no one will harm them, including your father."
"I will remember your words."

After waiting for some time, Ju Yingzhi and the other three had already returned to that place. After that, Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and Qian Qin led them to disappear into it.
