paragraphs: "Oh? You brought them all here, Yingzhi?"
"Nalan Wangzi?" Qian Hua was taken aback for a moment, but then she remembered Qian Qin telling her that Nalan Shizhe was Zhang Fei’s mother-in-law.
"Hmm? Qian Hua?" Nalan Wangzi was a little surprised to see Qian Hua, as she rarely appears in public. "Why are you here?"

"Sister Wangzi, she is Qian Yan’s daughter with my mother." Nalan Wangzi just remembered that Qian Hua and Ju Yingzhi had such a relationship. "Moreover, she is the owner of the Sovereign Demon Physique, so Zhang Fei brought her here with us."
Nalan Wangzi nodded slightly. "I don’t know anything about that physique, but our husband must know something about it, and he has already made plans for her."
"Plans? What does Zhang Fei plan for me?" Qian Hua asked in confusion, but the mysterious smile on Nalan Wangzi’s face gave her goosebumps. ’Ugh! Is he thinking of forcing me to be his woman?’
Nalan Wangzhi didn’t say anything more to Qian Hua, and she spoke to Ju Yingzhi. "You should take your family to the southern area, and you can talk freely there."
"Alright." Ju Yingzhi led her family to that area.
Nalan Wangzi watched them walk away and then asked Qian Qin a question. "Does your father know about their departure?"

"Hmm?" Qian Qin thought for a moment before shaking her head. "I don’t think my father knows about their departure, but Brother Yu knows everything. Even so, we don’t need to worry about that; I’m sure that he won’t tell our father."
"That’s good then." Nalan Wangzi breathed a sigh of relief. "Let’s cultivate again."
"Okay."
Along the way to the southern area, Ju Yingzhi told Ju Yuning and the others about the identities of all the women, including their relationship with Zhang Fei.
Qian Hua, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian were stunned to hear that. They did not expect that Zhang Fei had so many wives, and some of them were powerful demons.

Ju Yuning sighed inwardly, knowing her eldest daughter had to share Zhang Fei with so many women. However, she didn’t intend to interfere in their relationship, so she said nothing. After all, her eldest daughter had been separated for so long, and he helped them to reunite.
"Master, you’re back." Xin Yanluo trotted over to them.

Ju Yingzhi smiled at her loyal friend. "Mother, she is my best friend, Xin Yanluo. I met her when I was stranded in the Three Mortal Realms, and she accompanied me through thick and thin, including when I was seriously injured by a demon hunter’s attack."
"I see." Ju Yuning took Xin Yanluo’s hand. "Thank you for always accompanying my daughter when she faced hardships, Yanluo."
Xin Yanluo shook her head. "Madam, she is my master, and it is my duty to accompany her, so you don’t need to thank me."
"No matter what, I still have to thank you." Ju Yuning looked at her eldest daughter longingly. "She was still young then, and I wasn’t by her side, so I don’t know what she went through there."
"Alright, we don’t need to discuss the past, Mother." Ju Yingzhi took Qian Hua’s hand. "Yanluo, she is my half-sister, Qian Hua."
Xin Yanluo frowned as soon as Ju Yingzhi said that. "Is this woman the daughter of that bastard, Master?"

Qian Hua opened her mouth to scold Xin Yanluo, but she quickly swallowed her words back. Her father had never treated her well except for providing her with cultivation resources, so it was pointless for her to defend him.

"You are right, she is Qian Yan’s daughter." Since they had lived together for so long, Ju Yingzhi was familiar with Xin Yanluo’s character, and she embraced Qian Hua. "She may be his daughter, but she is my half-sister, so you have to treat her well."
Xin Yanluo pursed her lips. "You are my master, so I will follow your words. Then, who are the other two people?"

"They are my little brother and sister-in-law, Ju Yifan and Qian Xian." Xin Yanluo gritted her teeth, realizing that Qian Xian was also Qian Yan’s daughter. "Although my sister-in-law is his daughter, he never considered her one, and he abandoned her."
"Oh." Xin Yanluo nodded slightly. "Sooner or later, that trash will die, and he will die a terrible death. Alright, I won’t disturb your reunion anymore, and I’ll go to the city to buy some things."
Qian Hua watched Xin Yanluo leave and then asked Ju Yingzhi a question. "That woman is so loyal to you, sister."

"Hehe," Ju Yingzhi laughed. "When I met her, she was still small, and she almost died at the hands of a demon hunter. After I saved her, she swore she would serve me for the rest of her life, and she has followed me everywhere since then. I already considered her as my little sister, and I met my husband thanks to her."
"Sister-in-law, how did Zhang Fei manage to get so many wives?" Qian Xian asked.
Ju Yifan was also curious about that. "Many of them are powerful demons, and they are much stronger than us."
"Are they powerful?" Ju Yingzhi smiled playfully, confusing them. "They may be powerful, but Zhang Fei’s other wives are much more powerful than them."
"Huh? Who are they?"

"Empress Huo Yanling’s reincarnation, Demon God Qi Qingxiu, Demon God Ye Mingran, and Demon God Dong Xuanyin." Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian looked at Qian Hua with expressions full of shock. "Big Sis Qin was the one who told me about their relationship, so it should be true."

"Qian Qin didn’t lie to you." Ju Yingzhi created several qi screens that displayed all of Zhang Fei’s wives, including Feng Yao and the three female demon gods. "See? All of them are his wives, and we usually live together at his residence. Since many of them aren’t demons, he didn’t bring them to this domain, and they stayed at his residence."

Ju Yuning looked at all the women with awe. "Empress Huo was a powerful cultivator in the past, and she was famous for being ruthless. However, she was never interested in men, and she repelled all men who tried to approach her. I didn’t expect her reincarnation to be married, and her husband had so many wives."
"All those women possess unparalleled beauty." Qian Xian looked at Ju Yingzhi. "You too possess unparalleled beauty, sister-in-law."
Qian Hua just realized Ju Yingzhi’s beauty. "How can your face be this beautiful, big sis?"
"Hehe," Ju Yingzhi giggled. "Back then, my face wasn’t this pretty, but Zhang Fei gave me his beauty pills."
"Beauty pills? Does that mean Zhang Fei is an alchemist?"
"Yes," Ju Yingzhi nodded. "Zhang Fei is a god-rank alchemist."
"What?" The four people screamed in shock.
"Is that true?"
"Is Zhang Fei really a god-rank alchemist?"
"Zhang Fei is not only a god-rank alchemist, but he is also a supreme-rank blacksmith, a rank ten array master, and a god-rank swordmaster."

Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, Qian Xian, and Qian Hua looked at Ju Yingzhi with shocked expressions. They didn’t expect that Zhang Fei was extremely talented, and he managed to reach the pinnacle of several fields despite his young age.
Ju Yingzhi was amused by their expressions. "Sooner or later, you will learn more about Zhang Fei, and you will understand their reasons for being willing to share him with each other."
After arriving in the southern area, Ju Yifan, Qian Hua, and Qian Xian immediately began their cultivation.
Meanwhile, Ju Yingzhi accompanied Ju Yuning, reminiscing about the past. She also told her mother many things, especially about everything she had been through.
In Tang Zhiyao’s dream space, Zhang Fei talked with Feng Yao and Huo Ling regarding Qian Yan and Mo Shentian.
"Husband, you don’t have to hold yourself back when you meet Mo Shentian again, and you can borrow my strength to defeat him."
Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao. "Back then, I didn’t want to hold back, but I didn’t have any information about his abilities, so I fought him to find out his abilities."
"Are you thinking of mimicking his abilities, husband?"

"His ability to bend reality would be useful to me, so I thought about mimicking it." Feng Yao agreed with Zhang Fei’s wishes. "Unfortunately, I couldn’t move when he used that ability, so I couldn’t mimic it."
Feng Yao nodded in understanding. "If you’re eager to mimic his ability to bend reality, you’ll have to defeat him first, and then you can do that."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei, Feng Yao, and Huo Ling frowned as Tang Zhiyao’s dream space slowly darkened.
"Zhang Fei." Tang Zhiyao suddenly appeared in front of them. "Meng Huo will appear soon."
"Hey! Why are you panicking like this?" Huo Ling asked with a shake of her head. "You were too afraid of Meng Huo that you forgot to get dressed."

Tang Zhiyao was stunned for a moment before looking down, her face flushed red after realizing she was still naked. Zhang Fei was looking at her eagerly, wanting to devour her. She hurriedly took a spare dress and covered her body. ’Ugh! This is because of that bastard Meng Huo!’
Zhang Fei, Feng Yao, and Huo Ling immediately stood up and dressed, awaiting the arrival of the Nightmare Lord, Meng Huo.
"Should we make a move on him, Master?"
Feng Yao responded to Huo Ling with a slight nod. "Currently, our husband is no match for Meng Huo, so we must make a move on him."
"Is Meng Huo’s ability that terrifying, Yao’er?"
Feng Yao sighed and looked at him. "Do you remember how afraid you were of Yuan Xiajie in the past? Meng Huo is stronger and more terrifying than her, so I’m not sure you can fight him."
"Hmm? Let me try fighting him first, okay?"

"Unfortunately, I couldn’t move when he used that ability, so I couldn’t mimic it."

Zhang Fei, Feng Yao, and Huo Ling immediately stood up and dressed, awaiting the arrival of the Nightmare Lord, Meng Huo.

"Is Meng Huo’s ability that terrifying, Yao’er?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1833: Nightmare Lord, Meng Huo II
paragraphs: After some time, Meng Huo finally appeared before them. His appearance was exactly the same as the one Zhang Fei had seen during the soul test at the Tower of Eternity, minus his flaming horse.
Even though she was a demon god, Tang Zhiyao’s neck shrank as soon as she saw Meng Huo. She hid behind Zhang Fei; her expression was filled with fear.
Unlike Tang Zhiyao, Feng Yao and Huo Ling were unperturbed by the appearance of Meng Huo. Instead, there was a glint of disgust and disdain in the female flame spirit’s eyes.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei did not use his lust demon form; instead, he used his half-fox form. He fearlessly looked at Meng Huo, who was also looking at him with a condescending gaze.

Meng Huo frowned as soon as he saw Tang Zhiyao hiding behind Zhang Fei, with a glimmer of killing intent flashing across his eyes. However, he froze as soon as he saw Huo Ling; her presence caused his eyes to shrink and tremble.

Huo Ling noticed Meng Huo’s gaze on her; she snorted coldly without saying anything. If Zhang Fei hadn’t said that he wanted to try fighting the nightmare lord, she would have already made a move and beaten him half to death.

’Isn’t that woman the flame spirit who was always with Guang Zhiyi in the past? How could she appear here with Tang Zhiyao?’ Meng Huo thought to himself as his eyes swept across Feng Yao’s figure. His frown deepened because she didn’t pay attention to him; she didn’t even spare a single glance at him. ’Who exactly is that woman? She should be a female beast, and she is still so young, but her cultivation has already reached the Celestial God Realm.’

If only Meng Huo knew that Feng Yao was deliberately suppressing her cultivation, he would definitely immediately escape from Tang Zhiyao’s dream space. Not even Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi dared to face her openly, let alone a cultivator from the Ancient Realm like him.
"Husband." Meng Huo froze when Huo Ling addressed Zhang Fei as her husband. "Do you really want to fight with that foolish man?"

’Why did she address him as her husband? Meng Huo looked at Zhang Fei, and he just realized that his cultivation was also at the Celestial God Realm. ’How is this possible? He’s less than a hundred years old, but his cultivation is already on par with mine. Besides, his fox form is truly unusual, and I can smell both demon and human scents from him.’
Zhang Fei nodded to Huo Ling. "I’ll be facing Mo Shentian soon, so I want to take this opportunity to spar with this senior."

"Oh." Huo Ling looked at Meng Huo. "His main ability is to create nightmares, so you must be careful. If he takes you into his domain, you will face many terrifying nightmares you have never encountered before."
"Got it." Zhang Fei flew in front of Meng Huo while reading his status, and he immediately used his Demon Mimicry ability, which he had not used for a long time.
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the Nightmare Sovereign Codex of a dream demon named Meng Huo.]

’Oh? I didn’t expect to be able to successfully mimic his main ability.’ Zhang Fei was overjoyed because Meng Huo’s abilities would be ineffective against him. However, he wanted to try something else first, and he used his demon lordship abilities on himself. Since he could control everything, his abilities didn’t affect him, even though many dreams were spinning in his mind. "I’ve heard about you for a long time, but I didn’t expect to meet you so soon, Nightmare Lord."
Meng Huo squinted his eyes. "Who are you?"
"The nine-tailed heavenly fox, Zhang Fei," Zhang Fei replied casually.
"A nine-tailed heavenly fox?" Meng Huo muttered to himself; he was sure that he had never heard of the heavenly fox race in the Ancient Realm. "I’ve never heard of your race before."
"Of course you have never heard of my fox race. After all, my fox race does not exist in the Ancient Realm, and we only exist in the Three Mortal Realms."
Zhang Fei’s words shocked Meng Huo again. Even though he didn’t know about the Three Mortal Realms, he knew about the Paradise Realm, and he believed the former was a lower realm than the latter.
Zhang Fei continued, "The Three Mortal Realms are located behind the boundaries of the Paradise Realm, where the highest cultivation is the Quasi-Divine Realm."
"The Quasi-Divine Realm." Meng Huo furrowed his brows as he observed Zhang Fei seriously.

If the highest cultivation in the Three Mortal Realms was only at the Quasi-Divine Realm, Meng Huo believed that Zhang Fei should not be able to reach the Celestial God Realm at his current age. Yet, the young man standing in front of him had already reached his level, which was simply unbelievable.

Meng Huo knew that there were many talented cultivators in the universe, but he had never met a cultivator who had managed to reach the Celestial God Realm at such a young age as Zhang Fei. Furthermore, cultivators from the Paradise Realm could not ascend to the Ancient Realm due to the barrier separating the two realms, let alone cultivators from the Three Mortal Realms.
Meng Huo glanced at Huo Ling. "Was that female flame spirit the one who brought you to this realm?"
"You could say that."
"I see." Meng Huo nodded slightly. "What is your relationship with Tang Zhiyao?"
"She is my woman." Zhang Fei wasn’t afraid of Meng Huo after he successfully mimicked his Nightmare Sovereign Codex. Even without Huo Ling’s help, he was confident he could face the nightmare lord.

Meng Huo was furious when Zhang Fei said that Tang Zhiyao was his woman. He had long wanted the female demon god to be his woman, but she had never been willing to accept him. Even though he never forced her physically, he repeatedly tried to force her using his abilities, but she remained steadfast in her stance and did not accept him.

Due to her constant rejection, they even fought fiercely in the past, which ended with Tang Zhiyao seriously injured. If Zhang Fei had not come to her domain and given her the healing pills, her injuries would not have healed so quickly, and she would have needed hundreds or even thousands of years to recover.

Usually, Meng Huo wouldn’t exchange pleasantries with his opponents, and he would immediately kill all his enemies. However, the presence of Huo Ling and Feng Yao served as a deterrent to him, and he didn’t dare to move carelessly in front of the two women, especially with the female flame spirit present.

Although they hadn’t seen each other for a long time, Meng Huo still remembered the horror Huo Ling had shown him in the past. Even though her master wasn’t present with her, he still remembered Guang Zhiyi’s terror, which made all cultivators in the Ancient Realm fear her.

Furthermore, Huo Ling addressed Zhang Fei as her husband, which put a lot of pressure on Meng Huo’s shoulders. If he attacked her husband, he was sure the female flame spirit would retaliate against him, which would end in his defeat.

Feng Yao smiled faintly as if she understood Meng Huo’s thoughts. "Didn’t you want to spar with him, husband? You don’t need to make small talk with him, and we’ll continue our activities after your fight."

Meng Huo looked at Feng Yao with an incredulous expression; he did not expect that she was also Zhang Fei’s wife. He didn’t know her exact strengths and abilities, but he knew that she was no simple woman. After all, she acted so calm, and she didn’t seem to be the least bit intimidated by his presence.

Previously, Tang Zhiyao felt immense tension in her heart, but Meng Huo’s attitude significantly lessened her tension. She had known him for a long time, and she knew his character well. He wasn’t usually talkative and acted immediately, but his attitude changed with the presence of Feng Yao and Huo Ling. ’Guang Zhiyi is still Guang Zhiyi! Even though she has been reincarnated, all the cultivators in this realm are still afraid of her.’
"Spar with me, nightmare lord."
Meng Huo looked at Zhang Fei with his jet-black eyes, thinking to himself, "Since Tang Zhiyao is your woman, I won’t bother her anymore from now on."
"Huh?" Zhang Fei was baffled. "Why?"
"I don’t want to offend your two wives." Meng Huo took something out and threw it at Tang Zhiyao, who immediately caught it. "Consider it my compensation."
"Hey—"
"You don’t need to say anything, and we’ll meet again in the future." After saying that, Meng Huo immediately disappeared, and Tang Zhiyao’s dream space brightened again.
"What the fuck!" Zhang Fei shouted in frustration. "I really wanted to fight him, but he just walked away!"
"Hahaha," Feng Yao laughed out loud. "That man has been like that since the past, husband. He realized that his chances of defeating us were zero, so he chose to retreat."

"Damn it! If I knew he would back down, I would have sent you back to my beast space!" Zhang Fei landed in front of the three women. "Do you know which domain he lives in? I will go there to challenge him!"
Feng Yao shook her head. "Meng Huo didn’t have a fixed residence, and he was always wandering around. However, I think he is interested in you, so I’m sure he will come to you again in the future."
"Tch! I’m not interested in men! I just want to fight him!" Zhang Fei was really frustrated because Meng Huo backed out at the last second.
"Hehe," Huo Ling giggled and hugged Zhang Fei from behind. "How about you ’fight’ against me and my master?"
*Slap*
Zhang Fei slapped Huo Ling’s buttocks. "I’m serious about fighting and not ’fighting’ like that."

paragraphs: "Husband, send me back into your beast space." Feng Yao spoke, glancing at Huo Ling.
Huo Ling naturally understood her master’s intentions, and she immediately entered Zhang Fei’s body. ’We’ll have more fun later, husband.’
Zhang Fei smiled faintly, sent Feng Yao back into his beast space, and spoke to Tian Zhiyao. "Since Meng Huo has said he won’t bother you anymore, you can live in peace from now on."
"Yeah." Tang Zhiyao handed the item given by Meng Huo to Zhang Fei. "Take it."
"No need," Zhang Fei refused with a wave of his hand. "Since he gave it to you, you can keep it for yourself. Furthermore, I have many better items than that, so I don’t need it."
"Alright then." After storing the item in her storage ring, Tang Zhiyao slowly took off her dress.
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "What are you doing?"

"I said that I would do anything for you if you could stop Meng Huo from bothering me, including recognizing you as my master." Tang Zhiyao dropped her dress to the ground. "I know that I’m not as beautiful or sexy as all your wives, but I hope you won’t reject me."
"Although you’re not as sexy as some of them, I can tell you that you’re no less beautiful than them." Zhang Fei took out his two beauty pills and gave them to her. "Swallow them."
Tang Zhiyao accepted the two pills. "Are they your beauty pills?"
"Oh? You know about my pills?
"I know you gave them to Hua Qianmei, Gu Yanshu, and Gongsun Jiuxue."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Swallow them first."
"Thank you." Tang Zhiyao sat cross-legged and swallowed the two pills in turn.
[Why don’t you eat Gongsun Zhilan, Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Jiuxue, Master?]

Zhang Fei’s lips twitched. ’Hua Qianmei doesn’t have feelings for me yet, and she helped me in return for my pills. Gongsun Zhilan’s feelings for Mo Qingwen have started to fade, but she still has feelings for him, so I’ll wait until her feelings disappear completely. As for Gongsun Jiuxue, she has already decided to be my wife, but her feelings for me are still in the initial stage, so I’m in no rush to take her as my woman.’
[Tch! You’re a hypocrite! You don’t want to take Gongsun Zhilan and Gongsun Jiuxue as your women, but you want to take Tang Zhiyao as your woman.]
’Compared to them, I’m more impatient to have you as my wife, Mei.’

[Humph!] After that, Mei didn’t say anything else and ignored Zhang Fei. ’If only I had a real body, I would be willing to be your wife, Master. Unfortunately, I’m just an AI created to monitor the system, so I don’t have the chance to be your wife.’

After waiting for some time, Tang Zhiyao finished swallowing the two pills. She took out a mirror from her storage ring and looked at her new appearance. "I still can’t believe that you have such miraculous pills. My face has become much younger, and they have also rejuvenated my body. The most important thing is that the effects of both of your pills are permanent, unlike the beauty pills out there."
"Haha," Zhang Fei handed her some other pills. "For now, you can swallow them, and you’ll experience amazing changes in yourself."
Tang Zhiyao nodded and swallowed all the pills one by one, which took her several hours to absorb their effects.

After everything was done, Tang Zhiyao could feel significant changes in her body. Her dantian expanded and became two times thicker, the flow of qi in her meridians was smoother, and she could absorb demon qi much faster. She felt her cultivation core becoming denser and purer; her bones became stronger; and her soul power became two times stronger.

Tang Zhiyao smiled with satisfaction. "A god-rank alchemist is indeed extraordinary, and the effects of your pills are too amazing, Zhang Fei. I once swallowed pills that were almost the same, but their effects weren’t as potent as yours."

Zhang Fei simply smiled because Tang Zhiyao didn’t know that he bought most of his pills from the system shop, and their effects were indeed much better than all the pills outside. So far, only Feng Yao, Huo Ling, Zhang Lin, and Zhang Chen knew the existence of the system and Mei. "I’ve given all my basic pills to you, Hua Qianmei, and Gongsun Zhilan. If the three of you cultivate more diligence, you guys should be able to surpass Mo Qingwen."

Even though I had cultivated for so long and reached the demon god rank, some cultivators were still much stronger than me, for example, you and Meng Huo."

"In fact, I’m still not as strong as you, Mo Qingwen, and Meng Huo." Zhang Fei clenched his fist. "I can fight with cultivators at your level thanks to one of my advantages, which allows me to borrow Feng Yao’s strength. "The nine-tailed heavenly fox never existed in this Ancient Realm, so I don’t know the truth. The Three Mortal Realms are located behind the boundaries of the Paradise Realm, where the highest cultivation is the Quasi-Divine Realm."

"If that woman is truly Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation, her return to this Ancient Realm will be beneficial to us."

"Have you ever met those strange creatures?
Meng Huo nodded. "I’ve fought those strange creatures, and they are truly powerful. Although I managed to defeat and kill them, it took a lot of time."

"That’s right," Jiu Tou Sen agreed with him. "Those creatures invaded this domain several times, and I also spent a lot of time killing them. Every time they come to this domain, they become even stronger."
"When was the last time those creatures invaded this domain?"

"Do you think Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation and that female flame spirit can get rid of those creatures completely?"

"That’s right."

"You’re right," Jiu Tou Sen agreed. "After all, Mo Qingwen is the third strongest cultivator after the two of us, and his strength is far superior to those demon gods. "Yes."

"Did she give you an answer?
"She cursed at me, and she called me an annoying bug."
"Hahaha," Meng Huo laughed out loud. "Apart from Guang Zhiyi, Long Yuxi is the only living creature who dares to curse you and call you that."

"How fast can you fly to her domain?"
"A full-day flight."
"Let’s go there and help her first."
"Alright." Jiu Tou Sen immediately turned the other way and took Meng Huo away to Long Yuxi’s domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1840: Tian Yaoqin - Xu Ling’er
paragraphs: "Hmm?" Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan looked at Tang Zhiyao suspiciously as soon as she and Zhang Fei arrived at the fifth underground floor of the dungeon.

Most of the time, Tang Zhiyao never took her body out of her dream space, and she used her ethereal body to explore the outside world. However, she was now using her real body, and her aura seemed different from usual.
"She has become Zhang Fei’s woman." Gongsun Zhilan commented with a frown.

Hua Qianmei nodded in agreement. "I don’t know what happened between them before, but Tang Zhiyao clearly isn’t a woman who is easily swayed by sweet talk. Yet, she is no longer a virgin, and her aura is stronger than before."
Zhang Fei did not approach Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan, and he immediately hunted down the mindless demons after sending his fifth clone back to the training space.
Tang Zhilan, on the other hand, walked quickly towards Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan. She pretended not to notice the strange looks from her two female friends.

"Why are you two looking at me like that?" Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan gave Tang Zhiyao a look asking for an explanation. "Meng Huo came to see me again yesterday, and I promised Zhang Fei to become his woman if he managed to stop him from bothering me."
Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan knew that Meng Huo had wanted Tang Zhiyao for a long time, and they also knew that he was a psychopath who was not ashamed to torture her.
"Did Zhang Fei fight with Meng Huo?"
"What was the outcome of their fight?"
Tang Zhiyao took out an item and showed it to them. "Zhang Fei didn’t fight with him, and Meng Huo gave this item to me as compensation for all his actions toward me over the years."
"Oh?" Hua Qianmei was surprised to see the item. "This stone is rich with demon qi."
Gongsun Zhilan nodded in agreement. "At least, this stone is millions of years old, and Meng Huo gave it to you as compensation. Why didn’t that crazy bastard fight him?"

"That’s because of Senior Feng and Senior Ling." Hua Qianmei and Gongsun Zhilan exchanged knowing glances, and Meng Huo was frightened by Feng Yao and Huo Ling. "From now on, I can live freely, and he won’t bother me anymore."

"I think that’s good, Zhiyao. Meng Huo won’t bother you anymore, and you’ve got a wonderful husband." Hua Qianmei turned to Gongsun Zhilan. "Why don’t you give yourself to him? He has kissed you many times, and he has also touched your body."

"Humph! So what if he kissed me and touched my body? I only love Mo Qingwen, so I will never give myself to him." Gongsun Zhilan immediately walked away and started fighting the mindless demons again.
"She’s a hypocrite." Hua Qianmei muttered softly, shaking her head.

Tang Zhiyao agreed with Hua Qianmei, as she could also see that Gongsun Zhilan had begun to fall for Zhang Fei in the past few days. However, she knew that her feelings for Mo Qingwen were still strong, and Zhang Fei didn’t force her to become his woman.
Hua Qianmei tilted her head to the side. "How about your first experience?"

"It was great, but I almost died because of him." Tang Zhiyao’s answer confused Hua Qianmei. "Zhang Fei is a beast! I mean, a real beast! He didn’t hold back at all, and he fucked me non-stop for several days!"
Hua Qianmei’s jaw dropped after Tang Zhiyao said that. "Several days? How could that happen? You two were only gone for a day, right?"

"You already know that Zhang Fei has many secrets, and he took me to his secret place, where the flow of time is faster than the outside world." Hua Qianmei was curious about that, but she wasn’t a nosy woman, so she didn’t ask Tang Zhiyao anything. "He also taught me many techniques, all of which are useful for dual cultivation and soul cultivation."
Hua Qianmei’s ears perked up after hearing Zhang Fei give Tang Zhiyao many techniques. "Can you tell me about those techniques?"

"I can’t do that." Tang Zhiyao shook her head. "Zhang Fei only shared his techniques with all his wives, and he forbade me from sharing them with outsiders. If you are interested in his techniques, you might consider giving yourself to him, and you will never regret it. You have seen for yourself his relationship with all his wives, and he is the only person who can help us to transcend the Five Celestial Realm in this universe, so you can consider that."

Hua Qianmei did not deny Tang Zhiyao’s words, and she was quite interested in Zhang Fei, but she had never thought of giving herself to a man. "Forget it! We have to help him look for those materials again."
"Yeah."
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] stood in front of the black and white cocoon, and Ru Xue was inside it undergoing her evolution process. "Xue has been inside for more than a month."
"How long will it take for my mother to complete her evolution, Big Brother?" Xu Ling’er asked.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Back then, it took me less than two years to complete my evolution, and Lin’er spent more than two years to complete hers."
"Oh." Xu Ling’er nodded slightly. "That means my mother will need two years or more to complete her evolution. Do you think her appearance will change again after she completes her evolution?"
"Haha! Isn’t that obvious, Ling’er?" Zhang Fei [5] hugged her waist. "I can’t wait to see your mother’s new appearance after she finishes evolving, and she will probably be even sexier than before."
Xu Ling’er pursed her lips before teasing him. "Who is sexier between me and my mother, Big Brother?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] smirked. "Under normal conditions, your mother is sexier than you, but you are sexier than her when you use your past form."
Xu Ling’er sighed in her heart as she looked at her chest. "I was so sexy when I lived as Tian Huangjin, but I was less sexy than my mother when I lived as her daughter."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5] patted her head. "Why are you overthinking that? You know that I never cared whether you were as sexy as your mother or not, and I wholeheartedly love you."
Xu Ling’er smiled sweetly. "I know you love me wholeheartedly, and I also love you wholeheartedly. By the way, I had a strange dream, Big Brother."
"Hmm? What kind of dream?"
"My dream has something to do with Tian Qiye and my Holy Radiance Shield."
"Is your Holy Radiance Shield in Tian Qiye’s hands?"
Xu Ling’er nodded. "I don’t know whether it’s true or not, but I repeatedly dream of Tian Qiye holding my Holy Radiance Shield."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned. "Do you think you dreamed that because the shield called you?"
"That’s possible."
"Wait." Before long, Tian Yaoqin arrived in front of them, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked her. "Did you know that Tian Qiye has a golden shield?"
"Eh?" Tian Yaoqin was taken aback. "Tian Qiye does have a golden shield, husband. In fact, her main equipment set is golden, and one of them is a golden shield."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Xu Ling’er, who immediately transformed into her past form.
Seeing her past ancestor, Tian Yaoqin had the urge to kneel before Xu Ling’er, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped her because they were both his wives.
Xu Ling’er looked at Tian Yaoqin and asked. "Does Tian Qiye’s golden shield have the same pattern as my golden armor?"
"No," Tian Yaoqin shook her head. "I’ve often seen Tian Qiye’s equipment sets, but they don’t have the same pattern as your armor, and they lack the aura of holiness."
"I see." Xu Ling’er nodded in understanding.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at her. "Does that mean her shield isn’t yours?"
"Her shield is different from mine, Big Brother," Xu Ling’er pondered for a moment. "Perhaps my golden shield is indeed in Tian Qiye’s hands, but she can’t use it, so she hid it somewhere else."
"Why can’t Tian Qiye use your shield, Ancestor?"

"Sister Yaoqin, we are both his wives, so you should stop addressing me as your ancestor." Tian Yaoqin smiled awkwardly and nodded to Xu Ling’er. "My equipment set was created especially for me, and no one else can use any of them. As for my Holy Radiance Sword, Tian Huangjin could use it, but she couldn’t unleash its full abilities. If she could use its full abilities, Tian Qiye would no longer be her opponent, even though her cultivation was higher than hers."
Tian Yaoqin was confused. "Why is that?"
"Do you know the advantages of my equipment set?" Tian Yaoqin shook her head at Xu Ling’er. "My equipment set was created to suppress all members of the winged race, especially my sword."
"Suppressing our winged race?"

"Yes," Xu Ling’er nodded to her. "Not all members of the winged race are good people, and many of them have personal ambitions that lead to evil, like Tian Qiye. Therefore, my old friend created my equipment set to suppress them, especially those who have evil in their hearts."

Tian Yaoqin nodded in understanding. "Tian Qiye’s ambition is indeed excessive; she desires to dominate our race completely, and she is thinking of suppressing Tian Yizu and the others to smooth her path. Our race and the demon race indeed have hereditary problems, and the enmity between the two races is endless. However, the problems between the two races became deep after she became the leader of our race, and she led us to attack them."
"She led our winged race to attack the demon race?"

"I don’t know whether it’s true or not, but I repeatedly dream of Tian Qiye holding my Holy Radiance Shield."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] frowned.
"Do you think you dreamed that because the shield called you?"
"That’s possible."
"Wait." Before long, Tian Yaoqin arrived in front of them, and Zhang Fei [5] immediately asked her.
"Did you know that Tian Qiye has a golden shield?"
"Eh?" Tian Yaoqin was taken aback.
"Tian Qiye does have a golden shield, husband.
In fact, her main equipment set is golden, and one of them is a golden shield."
Zhang Fei [5] turned to Xu Ling’er, who immediately transformed into her past form.
Seeing her past ancestor, Tian Yaoqin had the urge to kneel before Xu Ling’er, but Zhang Fei [5] stopped her because they were both his wives.
Xu Ling’er looked at Tian Yaoqin and asked.
"Does Tian Qiye’s golden shield have the same pattern as my golden armor?"
"No," Tian Yaoqin shook her head.
"I’ve often seen Tian Qiye’s equipment sets, but they don’t have the same pattern as your armor, and they lack the aura of holiness."
"I see." Xu Ling’er nodded in understanding.
Zhang Fei [5] looked at her.
"Does that mean her shield isn’t yours?"
"Her shield is different from mine, Big Brother," Xu Ling’er pondered for a moment.
"Perhaps my golden shield is indeed in Tian Qiye’s hands, but she can’t use it, so she hid it somewhere else."
"Why can’t Tian Qiye use your shield, Ancestor?"
"Sister Yaoqin, we are both his wives, so you should stop addressing me as your ancestor." Tian Yaoqin smiled awkwardly and nodded to Xu Ling’er.
"My equipment set was created especially for me, and no one else can use any of them.
As for my Holy Radiance Sword, Tian Huangjin could use it, but she couldn’t unleash its full abilities.
If she could use its full abilities, Tian Qiye would no longer be her opponent, even though her cultivation was higher than hers."
Tian Yaoqin was confused.
"Why is that?"
"Do you know the advantages of my equipment set?" Tian Yaoqin shook her head at Xu Ling’er.
"My equipment set was created to suppress all members of the winged race, especially my sword."
"Suppressing our winged race?"
"Yes," Xu Ling’er nodded to her.
"Not all members of the winged race are good people, and many of them have personal ambitions that lead to evil, like Tian Qiye.
Therefore, my old friend created my equipment set to suppress them, especially those who have evil in their hearts."
Tian Yaoqin nodded in understanding.
"Tian Qiye’s ambition is indeed excessive; she desires to dominate our race completely, and she is thinking of suppressing Tian Yizu and the others to smooth her path.
Our race and the demon race indeed have hereditary problems, and the enmity between the two races is endless.
However, the problems between the two races became deep after she became the leader of our race, and she led us to attack them."
"She led our winged race to attack the demon race?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1841: His Wives’ Opinion And Resolution
paragraphs: "Yes," Tian Yaoqin nodded. "That incident happened several millennia ago, and both races suffered great losses. Tian Qiye’s husband died at the hands of Ye Mingran’s ancestor, and my husband died at the hands of Sha Mo’s ancestor. Overall, there were no victors in the war between the Winged Race and the Demon Race, and those who survived suffered severe injuries. If you ask which demon race she hates the most, then the answer is the Eternal Night Demon Race."
"She hates the Eternal Night Demon Race so much, huh?"

Tian Yaoqin nodded. "Ever since those gates disappeared, Tian Qiye ordered us to search for the Eternal Night Demon Domain. However, no one has managed to find it, even though they’ve been searching for over six years."
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow; he suspected that Feng Yao had deliberately arranged everything so that Tian Qiye and the winged race couldn’t find all the demon domains.
’Haha! You’re not wrong about that, husband. My master is the embodiment of the core of this universe, and she can do that easily; otherwise, they will find those demon domains.’
Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly. "What exactly is Tian Qiye’s goal?"

"Her main target is the Eternal Night Demon Race; she wants to eradicate them to take revenge for the death of her husband. After she destroys Ye Mingran’s demon race, she will target the other demon races, starting with the Faceless Demon Race."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "Honestly, I can easily defeat Tian Qiye as long as I borrow Feng Yao’s strength, but I would rather not do that. I want to face her myself, and I will defeat her."

Huo Ling suddenly came out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body. "Tch! You’re really stubborn, husband! In my opinion, you should settle all your matters in the Paradise Realm as soon as possible, and you can focus on your cultivation after that. I know that you don’t want to depend on me or my master, but we are both your wives, so our strength is your strength."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] smiled wryly. "Ling’er, I’m your husband, remember? If I’m always dependent on you guys, then what’s the point of me cultivating?"

Huo Ling shook her head resignedly. "Enemies are not the primary reason we cultivate, and they are only a small part of our journey to reach the pinnacle of cultivation. The ultimate goal of cultivating is not to fight with other cultivators but to achieve longevity and immortality, even though immortality itself doesn’t exist."

"On that matter, I agree with Big Sis Ling, Big Brother." Xu Ling’er returned to her original form. "The fact is that not all cultivators have many enemies, and they are more focused on their personal ambitions to achieve longevity and immortality. I know your pride as a man is too strong, but you mustn’t forget that we are your wives. Since we are your wives, we will accompany you to create a better future for us, and you can borrow our strength if you need it."
"Winning or losing is a common thing in the life of cultivators; sometimes we win, and sometimes we lose." Huo Ling shrugged her shoulders.

Tian Yaoqin looked at him. "I understand your desire to protect us, but we are your wives and not your burden, husband. I have fought too many enemies before you were born, and I have never relied on anyone, so I will not rely on you either."

Zhang Fei [5] did not argue with Tian Yaoqin; she was much older and more experienced than him. If he didn’t have many advantages, he would never have been able to reach her level. However, he did not want all his wives to be involved in the fight, and he would protect them for the rest of their lives.

Xu Ling’er, Tian Yaoqin, and Huo Ling could only sigh in their hearts because Zhang Fei [5] was too stubborn. All of his wives had often said that they didn’t want to depend on him, and they would rather not continue living under his protection, but he simply never listened to them.
Tap... Tap...
Luo Yunxiao walked over to them and hugged Zhang Fei [5] from behind. "Husband, do you think we’re that weak? Are we that useless in your eyes?"
Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly and looked at his other wives, who were gathered around them. Their expressions showed their determination, and they shared the same opinion as Luo Yunxiao.
"We’re not decorative vases, and we have the strength to help you, husband," Liu Qingyu said.
Liu Hua also spoke. "Husband, we have our own pride, and we don’t want to live under your shadow."
"We are always proud of you, but we don’t want you to fight alone, husband," Shen Xueyi uttered.
Helian Yueyi added. "Husband, we want to fight by your side to face all our enemies, whether they are strong or weak."
Shen Huang and the other women nodded to Zhang Fei [5] with looks full of resolution. "Let us fight alongside you, husband."
"Hah..." Zhang Fei [5] exhaled heavily. "I understand your desire to help me, but my enemies are getting stronger, and not all of you can face them."

"Naturally, we understand that, husband," Boitata said with a serious expression. "However, you must remember that not all of our enemies are strong, and many of them are weaker than us, like the four perils’ subordinates before."

Bai Shushi agreed with her. "Overall, our strength is divided into several levels, and your enemies are the same as us. Thus, we will fight opponents equal in strength, and you can fight with their leaders like when we faced the four perils and their subordinates."
"As long as our enemy’s strength is equal to ours, we will have no trouble defeating them." Hong Xinxin chimed in.
Murong Mengying also spoke up. "Long before we met you, we were used to fighting with our enemies, so we were ready to fight at any time."
"You are not an ordinary cultivator; you are stronger than others at your level because you possess numerous advantages." Bai Tian’er also said.
"Moreover, we’ve been practicing using your advantages for decades, and we’re stronger than cultivators at our level, so facing them is not difficult for us." Murong Qianying casually said.

Zhang Fei [5] scratched his head awkwardly listening to them talking one by one. "Alright, I understand your desires to help me, but I haven’t decided to fight Tian Qiye and the winged race because there are still other matters that I need to deal with."
"Other matters? Other enemies?"

"I suspect that some demon gods from the Myriad Abyss Domain will make a move soon, and you guys cannot go to that domain because you are not demons." Luo Yunxiao and the others did not argue with Zhang Fei [5] about that. "Besides, I think Meng Huo won’t give up so easily, and he’ll probably meet me in that domain soon. For now, I won’t go anywhere, and I will focus on searching for demon materials in that domain. After all your sisters have undergone their evolution process, I will clear out the remaining enemies in the Paradise Realm, starting with Tian Qiye."
"Are those demon materials hard to find, husband?"

"I’ve spent over a month in the dungeon, but I’ve only obtained a few. Those item sets are still incomplete, so they can’t evolve yet." Zhang Fei [5] just remembered something. "By the way, I no longer need the qi in my Yin-Yang Space because the qi from those female yin demons is stronger, so a few of you can use it to increase your cultivation."
Shang Xinyu gave him an idea. "Why don’t you release those female prisoners and replace them with those female yin demons, husband?"

"Do you think I haven’t tried that, Xinyu?" Zhang Fei [5] pointed to two female yin demons in the distance. "I’ve tried placing one of them in the Yin-Yang Space, but those chains can’t absorb their yin qi. If only those chains could absorb their yin qi, I would definitely release my old prisoners, and I would replace them with those female yin demons."
"I see." Shang Xinyu nodded in understanding.
Wang Yourou then asked. "Can we also absorb the yin qi from those female yin demons, husband?"
"Let’s try it." Zhang Fei [5] led them in front of the two female yin demons. "Yunxiao, you can try absorbing the yin qi of one of them, but you must do it very slowly."
"Alright." Luo Yunxiao touched one of the female yin demons and absorbed her yin qi, but she hurriedly pulled her hand back a second later. "What the hell?"
"What happened, Yunxiao?" Zhang Chen asked with concern.
Luo Yunxiao exhaled softly and looked at her. "Her yin qi is quite strange, Grandma Chen. I only absorbed a small drop of her yin, but my qi felt like it froze after coming into contact with hers."
"Is that true?" The other woman asked in shock.

"Haha," Huo Ling laughed at their reactions. "None of you can absorb the yin qi from that female yin demon, and your qi will freeze solid if you force yourself, which will end in your death. In fact, our husband also wouldn’t be able to absorb their yin qi if he didn’t have those heavenly flames, especially my primordial flame."
"Does that mean our dragon, phoenix, and vermilion flames are useless, Big Sis Ling?" Long Zhenxia, Zhu Lingyao, Feng Qingmeng, and several others asked.

"Yes," Huo Ling nodded to them. "Dragon, phoenix, and vermilion flames are strong, but these three are much weaker than the cold in the bodies of yin female demons. The only ones that can overcome their cold are my primordial flame and the chaos flame, so you guys won’t be able to absorb their yin qi."

chapters.title: Chapter 1842: Sky Dragon Demihuman - Long Yuxi I
paragraphs: Luo Yunxiao and the other women sighed in disappointment because they couldn’t use the yin from the two female yin demons to improve their cultivation, but they remembered that their husband still had eight female prisoners in the Yin-Yang Space.

Zhang Fei [5] opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space and led them into it. "Since some of you have already reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, you guys should let your sisters absorb the yin qi in this glass tube."

Qing Qiu’er, You Feiling, Puyang Yeyu, Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, Yue Ningxue, and Tian Yaoqin had no problems with his arrangement. They were also happy if their sisters could reach the Celestial Venerable Realm faster, so they would be more useful to their husband.

Zhang Fei [5] looked at his other wives. "All of you can start absorbing the yin qi in the glass tube. Those with higher cultivation will have to absorb less, so the difference in cultivation between all of you will reach balance."
Luo Yunxiao, Helian Xun’er, and Tianshi Shengjie have the highest cultivation among them, even though they haven’t reached the Celestial Venerable Realm like Qing Qiu’er and the others.

Tianshi Shengjie and the other women stood around the glass tube and began absorbing the yin qi within. Zhang Fei [5] himself hadn’t absorbed the yin qi within the glass tube for a long time, so his supply was quite abundant. After all, he had over a hundred wives, and they had quite strong and abundant yin qi, so he didn’t need the yin qi from his female prisoners anymore.

As for his demon and demon beast wives, such as Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, Mo Zainan, Yao Qilin, Fei Lian, Nalan Wangzi, Nalan Yushu, and others, they cultivated in the Myriad Abyss Domain. They needed more demon qi to increase their demon ranks, and he never stopped supplying them with his yang qi. The formation in their secluded place provided the best benefits, and they could use it to speed up their cultivation, combined with his yang qi.
Qing Qiu’er tugged his sleeves. "Husband, why don’t you bring Wang Jingzhi over?"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] looked at her. "You guys have accepted Wang Jingzhi as your new sister, huh?"
You Feiling grinned. "Wang Jingzhi is a beautiful and intelligent woman, and she is also the master of the Mirror of Eternity, so we feel that she is worthy to be part of our big family."
"I agree with them, husband," Yue Xuelian said. "Wang Jingzhi has already made up her mind to be your woman, so you don’t need to hesitate any longer and bring her here."
Yue Qianrou teased him. "Wang Jingzhi has a beautiful face and a sexy figure; we believe she suits your taste, so we have a tacit understanding to accept her as part of us."
Tian Yaoqin nodded to Zhang Fei, agreeing with her sisters.

Although Yue Ningxue didn’t say anything, she shared their opinion about Wang Jingzhi. However, she herself was still confused about her situation, especially since Zhang Fei [5] brought her back to the Celestial Moon Sect. He said that she was his woman, and she had resigned herself to her fate, but he still hadn’t touched her due to his busy life.
Puyang Yeyu patted his shoulder. "Take her as your woman and bring her here."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head without saying anything, and he picked up Wang Jingzhi, who was training at the training ground, bringing her to the Yin-Yang Space. "You can join them to absorb the yin qi in the tube."

Wang Jingzhi was taken aback for a moment, but a beautiful smile spread across her pretty face. She realized that Zhang Fei [5] was willing to accept her; otherwise, he would never brought her there and asked her to absorb the yin qi with his other wives.

Although she had only lived with Zhang Fei [5] for a little over a year, Wang Jingzhi was already familiar with his character. She didn’t thank him because he disliked it, and she joined the others in absorbing the yin qi in the tube.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to himself because Wang Jingzhi already understood him. He looked at Feng Xueling and Feng Jinqiu among his wives; he had long been attracted to the two female ice phoenixes. They had stayed in his training space for decades, but he had not made a move on them.
Zhang Fei [5] shifted his gaze and looked at the Meng Sisters. He had no interest in Meng Guanqiu, but he was quite interested in Meng Qi, and he let her sister live in his pavilion because of her.

However, Zhang Fei [5] had not made a move on Meng Qi, and he was still thinking about Feng Yao’s words about her back then. Unfortunately, the female phoenix was unwilling to explain to him about the woman, and she kept it a secret just like her words about Hun Lingwu.

Zhang Fei [5] looked at Tang Ying and Jing Qiuyue, especially the latter. More than six years had passed since he freed his senior sister from the influence of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror, and she had changed a lot since then.
At that time, Zhang Fei [5] rejected Jing Qiuyue’s feelings because she loved Qiao Liangren, and she had feelings for him because of the effects of the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.

Since then, Jing Qiuyue has spent more than two decades in Zhang Fei [5]’s training space, and she was completely focused on her cultivation and training. During that time, they often spent time talking and doing other things, but they never talked about feelings.

Zhang Fei [5] knew that Jing Qiuyue’s feelings had changed, and she had already forgotten her feelings for Qiao Liangren. His relationship with her became closer, but they never discussed romantic feelings.

As for Tang Ying, Zhang Fei [5] also had an interest in her, but she didn’t have that kind of feeling for him. After all, she was a female lust demon, and he let her cultivate in his training space because he needed her help to enter the Lotus Limbo World in the future.
"What are you thinking, husband?" Puyang Yeyu asked.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "I’ve been thinking about a few things, especially about the Lotus Limbo World."
"What’s wrong?"
"According to Feng Yao, the woman in the Lotus Limbo World is one of the allies I need, and she is the representative of the demon race."
The women’s ears perked up because Zhang Fei [5] had never discussed the matter with them.

"Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race, Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race, Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race, and Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race. That woman is the representative of the demon race, and she lives in the Lotus Limbo World."

Puyang Yeyu and the others were disappointed upon hearing this. They were powerful cultivators, yet they weren’t chosen as representatives. However, they didn’t show their disappointment in their expressions.
"Then, who is the representative of the demihuman race?"
"Is that woman Long Xiaolian?"
"No," Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "The woman who will be the representative of the demihuman race should be Long Yuxi."
"Long Yuxi?"
"Who is that woman?"

"Long Yuxi is the fourth strongest cultivator in the Ancient Realm, after Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen." As a native of the Ancient Realm, Puyang Yeyu had heard of the woman’s name, but she had never met her in person. "She is a dragon demihuman, and her bloodline is the Sky Dragon."
"A demihuman dragon!" They exclaimed with surprise.

Qing Qiu’er immediately teased him. "Husband, you already have wives from the human, beast, demon, natural, and winged races, but you still don’t have a wife from the demihuman race. Since Long Yuxi is the fourth strongest cultivator in the Ancient Realm, she should be worthy of being one of us, so you should go meet her and woo her."
*Smack*
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Qing Qiu’er and slapped her rear hard.
"Ouch!" Qing Qiu’er rubbed her buttocks. "Why did you slap my buttocks?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "I’ve never looked down on demihumans, but I find it strange to seek a wife from that race."
Yue Xuelian shook her head. "Even though Long Yuxi is a demihuman, she can use transformation techniques to turn into a human, right?"
"Therefore, you don’t need to hesitate to woo her, husband," Yue Qianrou added. "This way, you will have wives of all races, and I think that will be a good thing for you."
Zhang Fei [5] glared at them. "Why are you all so supportive of me adding more wives? Have you forgotten that I already have over a hundred wives?"
All of them smiled bitterly while glaring at Zhang Fei [5], except for Yue Ningxue, who had never experienced his sex prowess.

paragraphs: Yue Xuelian’s question made Zhang Fei [5] fall silent. It wasn’t that he didn’t want to answer her, but he was thinking about his future plans.

In fact, Zhang Fei [5] needed his five clones to speed up his cultivation; otherwise, his cultivation would definitely not have reached the Celestial Emperor level if he didn’t have his five clones and all his wives.
If he wanted, Zhang Fei [5] could dual cultivate with all of them without using his five clones, and he would never be exhausted or run out of energy to fulfill their physical satisfaction.
However, Zhang Fei [5] knew what they needed wasn’t just physical satisfaction, but they also needed spiritual satisfaction.
That’s why Zhang Fei [5] divided them with his five clones to fulfill both; he thought that they wouldn’t be satisfied if they had to wait a long time for their turn.
Despite their high cultivation, they were no different from ordinary women, and they couldn’t possibly match a lust demon and a dragon like Zhang Fei [5].
At the beginning of their relationship, they had no problem with Zhang Fei [5]’s arrangement because he had too many wives, so they would rather not wait long to dual cultivate with him.

They assumed their situation was temporary, and Zhang Fei [5] would get rid of his five clones in the future. Even though his five clones were essentially extensions of himself, they hoped that no other men would be part of their family.

After all, Zhang Fei [5] would continue to age, and they thought that his stamina would decrease drastically. This way, their dual cultivation sessions would gradually decrease, so he no longer needed to share them with his clones.
Unfortunately, the reality was the opposite of their expectations; Zhang Fei [5] didn’t weaken but instead grew stronger, and they became overwhelmed to accommodate his lust.
Apart from his status as a lust demon and a dragon, Zhang Fei [5] mastered too many body cultivation techniques, which made his body much stronger than other living creatures.
Previously married women like Qing Yi, Liu Qingyu, Shen Xueyi, Shen Huang, and several others were no longer able to serve Zhang Fei [5] for too long like in the past.
Even lust demons like Orith and Ilsath were overwhelmed like Zhang Fei [5]’s other wives, and they often gave up serving him.
Zhang Fei [5]’s new victim was Tang Zhiyao, and the female demon god was forced to beg him to stop having sex with her, as she was too exhausted after doing it for several days non-stop.

That’s why all pf Zhang Fei [5]’s wives hoped that he would no longer use his five clones to dual-cultivate with some of them, and they would have ample time to rest while he dual-cultivated with others.
Seeing Zhang Fei [5] lost in thought, Yue Xuelian and the others did not disturb him, and they waited for him to finish thinking before talking to him again.
After a few minutes, Zhang Fei [5] exhaled softly and looked at them. "Do you guys hope that I will stop using my clones for dual cultivation?"
"Yes!" They answered in unison, including all the women who were absorbing the qi in the glass tube.

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] nodded in understanding. "I can fulfill your wishes, and I will no longer use my clones to dual-cultivate with some of you in the future. However, you guys will have to wait at least until my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm. What do you think about that?"

Yue Xuelian and the others wanted to say something to Zhang Fei [5], but they were afraid he would disappoint them. They wanted him to stop using his clones to dual-cultivate with some of them from now on, but they also knew that he wanted to reach the Celestial God Realm as soon as possible, which put them at a crossroads.
Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly. "Can’t you guys wait until my cultivation reaches that stage?"
"Husband, I want to ask you about one thing."
"Ask me, Qiu’er."
"Are we your cultivation tools?"
"No way," Zhang Fei [5] shook his head several times. "I have often said that all of you are my wives and not my tools."
Qing Qiu’er took a deep breath. "If we are not your tools, we want you to stop using your clones to dual cultivate with some of us."

"All this time, we’ve never objected to you using your clones to dual cultivate with some of us, husband. However, we’re not as strong as you, and we always get exhausted every time we dual cultivate with you or your clones," You Feiling said.

Yue Xuelian, Yue Qianrou, and Tian Yaoqin spoke to him on behalf of their sisters, particularly those who were partners of his clones. Essentially, they didn’t want the presence of other men among them, even if they were his clones.

Puyang Yeyu didn’t say anything because she had only dual cultivated with him once, and she did it with his real body. Yue Ningxue also chose to remain silent because she had never dual cultivated with him, and she didn’t know when he would want to dual cultivate with her.

Zhang Fei [5] looked at all his wives while thinking things through. "Alright, I will no longer use my clones to dual cultivate with some of you, and all of you will do it with my real body in the future."
All the women perked up after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "Are you really going to fulfill our wishes?"

"As I’ve always said, you guys are my wives, and I love you all. Since some of you no longer want to dual cultivate with my clones, I won’t force you to do so." All the women felt relieved after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "There are countless female yin demons in the Frozen Yin Domain, and my clones need two to three months to absorb all their yin qi. Besides, I’m aware that your physiques aren’t as strong as mine, and you guys are too exhausted every time we dual cultivate, so I don’t have a problem with that."
"Phew." All the women patted their chests in relief.

Zhang Fei [5] continued. "From now on, I won’t dual cultivate with any of you for too long, so you guys don’t have to force yourselves to satisfy me, and we’ll stop after you reach orgasm two or three times."

Even though they had been together for a long time, and most of them had been with him for decades, they still blushed when they heard that. However, they thought it was much better than if they had pushed themselves to their limit like in the past, and they wouldn’t be so exhausted in the future.
"Since you’ve said that, you can’t go back on your words."
Zhang Fei [5] clenched his right fist and smacked his chest. "I am a man of my word, and I will never go back on my word."
"Then, we want to know your answer about the second problem."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow. "The second problem you mean is about children, right?"
"Yes!"
"When do you want to impregnate us?"

Zhang Fei [5] released a heavy sigh. "Regarding children, I will not compromise with you, and I will impregnate all of you after I become unrivaled in this universe. Almost all of you have already stored your egg cells, so you guys don’t need to worry about not being able to get pregnant in the future."
"Huh? What do you mean by saving our egg cells, husband?" Some of them asked in confusion.
Zhang Fei [5] took out the science capsule. "You guys should take turns entering the capsule, and I will retrieve your egg cells so you can get pregnant anytime in the future."
"Hmm?" They were even more confused.

"You two might not know about this, but I come from a realm without cultivators," Zhang Fei [5] explained to them about earth and the process of IVF, which surprised both women. "By using the IVF method, you can get pregnant at any time, regardless of your cultivation level. However, I don’t want to have children yet, so I will keep your egg cells until I’m ready to have children."

Puyang Yeyu, Tian Yaoqin, Yue Xuelian, and the others took turns using the science capsule to retrieve their egg cells. Zhang Fei [5] asked Yue Ningxue to join them, and he also picked up Tang Zhiyao in the dungeon. This way, he kept egg cells from all his wives, and he also kept more of his potent sperm cells.

After everything was done, Zhang Fei [5] sent Tang Zhiyao back to the dungeon, and he sent the few of them back to the training space. He did not join them; instead, he went to the Endless Domain to prepare for his fight with Mo Shentian.
After a day of travel, Jiu Tou Sen flew into a realm, but several shadowy creatures blocked his path. He and Meng Huo immediately engaged those creatures, and their battle was quite intense.
Suddenly, a white light shot toward them, instantly scattering the shadowy creatures.
Jiu Tou Sen opened eight of his nine mouths, and he used eight of his nine elements at the same time to eliminate those creatures.
On Jiu Tou Sen’s back, Meng Huo was already holding his black sword, and he swung it towards those creatures.
After a lengthy battle, they managed to eliminate all the creatures invading the domain. Meng Huo immediately jumped off Jiu Tou Sen’s back, allowing him to revert back to his human form.
The white light floated in front of them and transformed into a woman who had a human-like figure, but her head was that of a white dragon. "What are you two doing in my domain?"
"Didn’t we come here to help you get rid of those creatures, Long Yuxi?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1844: Sky Dragon Demihuman - Long Yuxi III
paragraphs: Long Yuxi possesses an upright posture like a female human, yet nearly every part of her body retains the unmistakable features of a dragon, making her look like a true dragon standing on two legs, not a human with dragon-like features. She wears flowing white-and-silver robes specially tailored to fit around her wings and tail.
Her head is not that of a human but of a white dragon. A pair of long, elegant horns curve back from its crown, smooth as polished jade and marked with faint silver veins.

Her elongated snout is lined with razor-sharp ivory fangs that remain visible even when her mouth is closed. Two white whiskers dangle from either side of her snout, gently drifting with every movement. Her eyes are large and luminous, their golden irises surrounding narrow, vertical pupils that exuded calm authority.

A crest of long crystalline scales grows from the back of her head and down to her neck like a flowing white mane. Smaller decorative spines frame her jaw and cheeks without diminishing her elegant appearance.

Every inch of her body is covered in flawless white dragon scales, shimmering with a soft, pearlescent light. The scales are smooth and soft around her chest, abdomen, and limbs, while larger, overlapping plates reinforced her shoulders, forearms, thighs, and shins.
Her torso is well-defined, with naturally curved hips, a narrow waist, and large breasts protected by flexible layers of dragon scales that contour her physique without sacrificing mobility.

Her arms are long and muscular, culminating in five-fingered dragon hands. Each finger bears curved white claws harder than steel, capable of tearing through armor or gripping rock as if it were soft clay. The strong scales of her forearms overlap like natural gloves, providing exceptional defense.

Her legs are long, built for speed and explosive power. The muscles beneath her scales are clearly visible, allowing her to leap great distances and land unscathed. Her dragon feet have broad claws that can anchor firmly to rocks or cloudstone while maintaining perfect balance.

A magnificent pair of massive white dragon wings rises from her back. The strong ivory wing bones support a wide membrane covered by countless fine scales that shimmer beneath sunlight. A long, thick dragon tail nearly equal to her height extends behind her hips.
Long Yuxi snorted in disdain. "You two aren’t that kind-hearted, especially you, Meng Huo. Speak! I know you two came to see me today with ultimate motives."
"Haha," Meng Huo just laughed listening to her remarks. "The two of us came here without any ulterior motives, and our main reason was those foreign creatures."
"Does that mean you two have encountered those foreign creatures before?" Long Yuxi asked, glaring at them.
Meng Huo nodded slightly. "As you know, I’ve never settled in one domain, but I’ve fought with some of them before, so I can say that they’re powerful and troublesome."

"Those creatures invaded my domain several times, and I also spent a lot of time killing them. Every time they come to my domain, they become even stronger." Long Yuxi looked at Jiu Tou Sen with surprise. "A week ago, dozens of them invaded my domain, and it took me a week to exterminate them. I don’t know if I can fight them again if they continue to get stronger, especially if they come in greater numbers."

"Those foreign creatures invaded my domain about three days ago, which forced me to wake up from my slumber. At first, their numbers weren’t large, but their numbers have been steadily increasing in the past two days, and they’ve become increasingly powerful." Long Yuxi released a tired sigh. "Do you two know their origins?"
Both Meng Huo and Jiu Tou Sen shook their heads. "We don’t know the origins of those foreign creatures, but we know someone who might know something about them."
"Who?"
"Guang Zhiyi."
Long Yuxi was momentarily stunned. "Are you serious about that? Has Guang Zhiyi really returned?"

"She’s back, and she’s stronger than in the past." Meng Huo created a qi screen that showed the situation inside Tang Zhiyao’s dream space. "See? One of those women is the flame spirit who lived by Guang Zhiyi’s side in the past, and their relationship is very close."
Long Yuxi didn’t say anything, and her gaze focused on Feng Yao’s figure. She recognized Tang Zhiyao and Huo Ling, but she could not recognize the phoenix princess.

Long Yuxi could see that Huo Ling and Feng Yao had an unusual relationship, which convinced her that the latter was the reincarnation of Guang Zhiyi. She raised an eyebrow for a moment when she saw Zhang Fei with the three women. "Who is that male fox?"

"His name is Zhang Fei, and he is the husband of the three women." Long Yuxi’s eyes widened in shock as soon as Meng Huo revealed that. "I’m not making up stories, okay? The female flame spirit addressed him as her husband, and Guang Zhiyi also looked at him with an unusually gentle gaze. He claimed to be Tang Zhiyao’s husband, and I chose to believe him because of the presence of the other two women."

Since Huo Ling addressed Zhang Fei as her husband, Long Yuxi chose to believe that he was the husband of the three women. Besides, she had heard a lot about Tang Zhiyao, and she knew that Meng Huo was obsessed with her, but the female demon god was never willing to accept him. "Do you know what kind of fox race that man is? As far as I remember, there are no nine-tailed fox races in this Ancient Realm, but I do remember about the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang."
"He told me that his fox race is the nine-tailed heavenly fox."

"The nine-tailed heavenly fox." Long Yuxi muttered to herself as she searched through her memories. "I’ve heard of several fox races in the past, but all of them disappeared without a trace. There are several fox races, like the moon fox race, the golden fox race, the spirit fox race, and several others, but I’ve never heard of the nine-tailed heavenly fox race."
Meng Huo shrugged his shoulders. "If you haven’t heard of that fox race, then I don’t know anything either."
"What about you?" Long Yuxi glanced at Jiu Tou Sen.

Jiu Tou Sen shook his head. "I’ve never cared about those fox races, so I don’t know anything about them. However, I do know some things about the ten-tailed fox, Hu Tianlang, and he’s as powerful as Guang Zhiyi."
"Hu Tianlang was indeed as strong as Guang Zhiyi, but he suddenly disappeared without a trace, and no one managed to find him, including those beast races."
"Speaking of Guang Zhiyi, Meng Huo and I plan to go see her."
"Oh? Where does Guang Zhiyi live?"
"I don’t know Guang Zhiyi’s whereabouts, but Zhang Fei claims to be that weak female demon god’s husband. She is one of the demon gods of the Myriad Abyss Domain, so we will go there to meet them."
Long Yuxi raised an eyebrow again. "The Myriad Abyss Domain is Mo Qingwen’s territory, right?"
"That’s right." Meng Huo nodded. "The four of us are the only ones left of the ten strongest old cultivators, and we haven’t seen each other in a long time, so we’d like to invite you to join us."
Long Yuxi nodded. "I have nothing to do, and those foreign creatures might attack me again, so I’ll go with you two."
"Let’s go." Jiu Tou Sen transformed into his beast form, and he immediately flew away from the domain after Meng Huo and Long Yuxi climbed onto his back.
"Is that male fox that powerful?"
Meng Huo sighed. "Zhang Fei is still under a hundred years old, but his cultivation has already reached the Celestial God Realm."
"What?" Long Yuxi exclaimed in shock, staring at Meng Huo with wide eyes. "Are you serious? How could he have reached the Celestial God Realm in less than a hundred years?"
"I don’t know for sure," Meng Huo replied with a shake of his head. "However, I can sense the yin qi of countless women in his body, and one of them is Guang Zhiyi’s."
"So, it’s true that Guang Zhiyi is his wife, huh?" Long Yuxi muttered to herself; a glimmer of excitement flashed through her eyes. "Have you tried fighting him before?"
Meng Huo glared at her. "Do you think I’m crazy enough to fight him in front of Guang Zhiyi and that female flame spirit?"

"Aren’t you completely insane?" Long Yuxi replied with a casual shrug. "You already know that the population of this Ancient Realm has significantly decreased, yet you continue to slaughter many of its inhabitants, including the Ancient Nether Race."

"Do you think I slaughtered the Ancient Nether Race for no apparent reason?" Long Yuxi looked at Meng Huo with a serious expression. "I can tell you that the Ancient Nether Race is an evil race, especially when they are consumed by their rage."
Long Yuxi frowned. "Did they lose their minds when they were consumed by their rage?"

"Two people from the Ancient Nether Race massacred the entire population of the True Martial Domain." Meng Huo’s face showed sadness. "When I arrived at that domain, I found a few survivors, but they died shortly after. I checked the domain, and I discovered that people from that race were the perpetrators of the massacre, so I went to their domain and slaughtered them."
Long Yunxi took a deep breath. "You’re as crazy as them! Two people from that race slaughtered the residents of that domain, but you massacred all the members of their race."

"Blood must be paid with blood; a life must be paid with a life," Meng Huo said in a firm tone. "It’s true that only two people from that race were the perpetrators, but you must remember that there were many innocent people in the True Martial Domain. Since they massacred them, I didn’t feel guilty about slaughtering the members of that race."
