chapters.title: Chapter 1845: Mo Shentian Almost Arrives
paragraphs: "Oh? Why did you come here?" Xie Yao asked in surprise.

Zhang Fei [5] was indifferent to seeing Xie Yan naked. Although she was quite a sexy lust demon, she couldn’t compare to all his wives. "Mo Shentian will arrive in this domain in a a week or so, and I will fight him then."
Xie Yao and Xie Yan were shocked to hear that. "Are you really going to fight Mo Shentian in this domain?"

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "The upcoming battle will be our final one, and I will take over the Celestial Demon Race afterward. However, I will not lead that demon race myself, and I will hand it over to Mo Zixiao because he is their crown prince."
The two lust demons weren’t surprised to hear that. "After you took over the Celestial Demon Race, only the Asura Demon Race and the Thousand Eyes Demon Race were left, right?"

"The Asura Demon Race is already on my side, and Shang Zhanluo’s daughter is my future wife." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer stunned Xie Yan and Xie Yao, especially regarding his relationship with Shang Xueli. "I fought Shang Zhanluo a few days ago, and I defeated him. After I defeat Mo Shentian and take over the Celestial Demon Race, my only remaining opponents are Qian Yan and his Thousand Eyes Demon Race."
"Can you defeat Qian Yan?"

"Yes and no." Xie Yan and Xie Yao were confused. "If I fight Qian Yan with my current strength, I can’t defeat him, but I can use a special method to defeat him. By the way, there is a lust demon race in the Ancient Realm, but I don’t know their location. However, my friend should know their location, and I can take you two there if you want."

Xie Yao shook his head. "Naturally, I want to become stronger, but Xie Yan and I are already comfortable in this Paradise Realm. If you unite all the demon races, we won’t face any more danger, so we don’t need to move to the Ancient Realm."

Since Xie Yao and Xie Yan had already made their decision, Zhang Fei [5] did not force them to move. After all, everyone had their ambitions, and many of them were already satisfied with their achievements, so it was difficult for them to start over.
Besides, the members of the lust demon race in the Ancient Realm were stronger than them, and their leader would probably force them to submit to him.
"Since you two don’t want to move, I won’t force you to move." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate. "Wu Mian is in this domain, and he will inform me immediately once Mo Shentian arrives here."
After Zhang Fei [5] disappeared, Xie Yan asked her husband. "Do you really not want to move to the Ancient Realm?"

"No," Xie Yao shook his head. "That kid already said that the cultivation levels in both realms have the same limit, so we don’t need to move there. Moreover, the Lust Demon God in that realm is much stronger than us, and we will only become his subordinates if we move there, so I choose to stay in this realm."

Xie Yan nodded in understanding. "After so long has passed, this Paradise Realm will find peace soon, and it can only happen because of that kid. After that, no one will bother us anymore, and our members can live in peace."
"Yeah." Xie Yao exhaled softly. "I can’t wait to see that kid defeat Mo Shentian and Qian Yan, and all the demon races will unite under him."
Shang Zhanluo and Shang Luohu were a little surprised when Zhang Fei [5] appeared in their palace, but they knew that he came to pick up their daughter and bring her back to the Myriad Abyss Domain.
Zhang Fei [5] chatted with them for about half an hour, and he informed them that Shang Luohu was pregnant, but they would still have to wait several months to find out the baby’s gender.
After conversing with them, Zhang Fei [5] sent Shang Xueli back to Hua Qianmei’s secret place in the Myriad Abyss Domain, and he went to another domain after that.

Shang Zhanluo was overjoyed to hear that his wife was officially pregnant, and he eagerly awaited the arrival of their child, and he informed Shang Fengxue of the matter. However, his sister did not wish to return to their domain, and she preferred to spend her time at the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Shang Zhanluo also announced Shang Luohu’s pregnancy to the members of their demon race, and he held a grand feast to celebrate it.
In a domain, Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi were hiding from the pursuit of those shadowy creatures. Those creatures had been chasing them for three days, and the two finally managed to escape.
"That Qian Yan seems to have failed."
Huang Yuanzhi raised an eyebrow, and he just realized that he couldn’t sense Qian Yan’s presence in the Ancient Realm. "Could Zhang Fei have sent him back to the Paradise Realm?"
"That’s possible." Xu Yuanzhi nodded.
"We have to go down to the Paradise Realm again to look for Qian Yan, and we will bring him back to this realm."

"No need," Xu Yuanzhi refused. "Since Qian Yan has returned to the Paradise Realm, we will wait for him to carry out his task of attacking the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. Capturing Long Wuzhao is our top priority, so we don’t need to disturb him for now."
Huang Yuanzhi agreed with that. "What about Zhang Fei?"

"Sigh," Xu Yuanzhi sighed. "I want to capture Zhang Fei, but you must remember that Shen Yuanzhi and that female flame spirit are by his side. The former still hasn’t regained her past strength, but we are definitely not the latter’s match. That female flame spirit is simply too strong, and she can easily destroy our avatars, so we must not provoke her."

"That’s true." Huang Yuanzhi frowned. "As long as we can capture Long Wuzhao and kill him, the Calamity Demon Dragon will be of no use, so we don’t need to bother with him. The main problem is those creatures, and they keep chasing the two of us. If they capture us, we will suffer greatly."
"Let’s go! We have to hide from them for now!"

Meanwhile, Qian Yan stood on a mountain; he decided to take a rest after flying in the darkness of the universe for three whole days. He swallowed several healing pills because his injuries were still severe, and he would need several years to recover.
Qian Yan activated his middle eye ability to examine his domain, and he found nothing significant there. He also checked on Qian Hua, but he was shocked that his daughter was nowhere to be found.

Qian Yan was furious because Qian Hua was his main weapon, especially with her Sovereign Demon Physique. He calmed himself down and checked the Abyssal Rift Demon Race’s palace, but he was shocked once again because Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian also disappeared from that place.
Qian Yan tried to track their whereabouts in the Paradise Realm, but he couldn’t find them anywhere because Zhang Fei had already moved them to the Ancient Realm.
*Boom*
The mountain under Qian Yan instantly exploded due to his strength. "Bastard! This must be the work of that lust demon bastard! He snuck into my domain while I wasn’t there!"

Qian Yan was furious after learning about the incident, but he couldn’t understand Zhang Fei’s reason for taking the four people away. After all, he didn’t know about his relationship with Ju Yingzhi, and the four people were her family.
Qian Yan contacted his son, Qian Yu, to ask about the situation of the four people. His face darkened, and the frown on his forehead deepened after listening to his son’s answer.
"What actually happened? How could that lust demon bastard infiltrate my domain without being discovered? Could it be that my son lied to me?"
After thinking about it, Qian Yan flew away and transformed into his beast form; he used his fastest speed to return to his domain.
"Damn it! I’ll kill that lust demon bastard one day!"

Mo Shentian floated in the darkness of the universe, and he tried to contact his three sons again, but none of them answered his calls. "Did something happen to them without my knowledge? But who did it? Could it be that Zhang Fei captured them to threaten me?"

Mo Shentian contacted his five guardians, and they told him that they were close to the Endless Domain, about a week’s journey. He ordered them to look for his three sons once they were in the domain, and he also told them that he would arrive there a few days after them.
Thereafter, Mo Shentian immediately continued his journey toward the Endless Domain, using his fastest speed.

In Hua Qianmei’s secret place, Ju Yingzhi was enjoying her time with her mother, brother, half-sister, and sister-in-law. It had been a long time since she felt so happy in her life, and she was truly grateful that she met Zhang Fei in the Three Mortal Realms; otherwise, she would have had to wait much longer to be reunited with her family.
Xin Yanluo also felt happy for her master since Ju Yingzhi had waited so long to be reunited with her family. Moreover, Ju Yuning also treated her as part of their family, which deeply touched her.
"Where’s Zhang Fei, Yingzhi? Why hasn’t he come to see you for the past three days?" Ju Yuning asked.

Ju Yingzhi understands her mother’s worries because Zhang Fei has too many wives. "Mother, he usually accompanies us here, but he is busy with many things now. He wants to bring all his closest people to this realm, so he is busy preparing for that."
"How many people are Zhang Fei’s closest people, sister?"

Huang Yuanzhi raised an eyebrow, and he just realized that he couldn’t sense Qian Yan’s presence in the Ancient Realm.
"Could Zhang Fei have sent him back to the Paradise Realm?"
"That’s possible." Xu Yuanzhi nodded.
"We have to go down to the Paradise Realm again to look for Qian Yan, and we will bring him back to this realm."
"No need," Xu Yuanzhi refused.
"Since Qian Yan has returned to the Paradise Realm, we will wait for him to carry out his task of attacking the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
Capturing Long Wuzhao is our top priority, so we don’t need to disturb him for now."
Huang Yuanzhi agreed with that.
"What about Zhang Fei?"
"Sigh," Xu Yuanzhi sighed.
"I want to capture Zhang Fei, but you must remember that Shen Yuanzhi and that female flame spirit are by his side.
The former still hasn’t regained her past strength, but we are definitely not the latter’s match.
That female flame spirit is simply too strong, and she can easily destroy our avatars, so we must not provoke her."
"That’s true." Huang Yuanzhi frowned.
"As long as we can capture Long Wuzhao and kill him, the Calamity Demon Dragon will be of no use, so we don’t need to bother with him.
The main problem is those creatures, and they keep chasing the two of us.
If they capture us, we will suffer greatly."
"Let’s go!
We have to hide from them for now!"
Meanwhile, Qian Yan stood on a mountain; he decided to take a rest after flying in the darkness of the universe for three whole days.
He swallowed several healing pills because his injuries were still severe, and he would need several years to recover.
Qian Yan activated his middle eye ability to examine his domain, and he found nothing significant there.
He also checked on Qian Hua, but he was shocked that his daughter was nowhere to be found.
Qian Yan was furious because Qian Hua was his main weapon, especially with her Sovereign Demon Physique.
He calmed himself down and checked the Abyssal Rift Demon Race’s palace, but he was shocked once again because Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian also disappeared from that place.
Qian Yan tried to track their whereabouts in the Paradise Realm, but he couldn’t find them anywhere because Zhang Fei had already moved them to the Ancient Realm.
*Boom*
The mountain under Qian Yan instantly exploded due to his strength.
"Bastard!
This must be the work of that lust demon bastard!
He snuck into my domain while I wasn’t there!"
Qian Yan was furious after learning about the incident, but he couldn’t understand Zhang Fei’s reason for taking the four people away.
After all, he didn’t know about his relationship with Ju Yingzhi, and the four people were her family.
Qian Yan contacted his son, Qian Yu, to ask about the situation of the four people.
His face darkened, and the frown on his forehead deepened after listening to his son’s answer.
"What actually happened?
How could that lust demon bastard infiltrate my domain without being discovered?
Could it be that my son lied to me?"
After thinking about it, Qian Yan flew away and transformed into his beast form; he used his fastest speed to return to his domain.
"Damn it!
I’ll kill that lust demon bastard one day!"
Mo Shentian floated in the darkness of the universe, and he tried to contact his three sons again, but none of them answered his calls.
"Did something happen to them without my knowledge?
But who did it?
Could it be that Zhang Fei captured them to threaten me?"
Mo Shentian contacted his five guardians, and they told him that they were close to the Endless Domain, about a week’s journey.
He ordered them to look for his three sons once they were in the domain, and he also told them that he would arrive there a few days after them.
Thereafter, Mo Shentian immediately continued his journey toward the Endless Domain, using his fastest speed.
In Hua Qianmei’s secret place, Ju Yingzhi was enjoying her time with her mother, brother, half-sister, and sister-in-law.

It had been a long time since she felt so happy in her life, and she was truly grateful that she met Zhang Fei in the Three Mortal Realms; otherwise, she would have had to wait much longer to be reunited with her family.
Xin Yanluo also felt happy for her master since Ju Yingzhi had waited so long to be reunited with her family.
Moreover, Ju Yuning also treated her as part of their family, which deeply touched her.
"Where’s Zhang Fei, Yingzhi?
Why hasn’t he come to see you for the past three days?" Ju Yuning asked.
Ju Yingzhi understands her mother’s worries because Zhang Fei has too many wives.
"Mother, he usually accompanies us here, but he is busy with many things now.
He wants to bring all his closest people to this realm, so he is busy preparing for that."
"How many people are Zhang Fei’s closest people, sister?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1846: The Arrival Of The Three Strongest
paragraphs: Ju Yingzhi looked at Qian Hua. "Zhang Fei’s close circle numbers in the thousands or even tens of thousands, and all of them live in his sect now."
"Huh? Does Zhang Fei really have a sect?"

Ju Yingzhi created two qi screens that displayed the Moonlit Passion Temple and the Twin Flames Domain. "That was his original domain in the Paradise Realm, and the sect used to be under the leadership of Qing Qiu’er, but he took over it after she became his wife."
"I’ve heard of the Twin Flames Domain." Qian Hua looked at the sect. "Is that the dual cultivation sect, the Moonlit Passion Temple, Sister?"

"That’s right." Ju Yingzhi nodded. "As you already know, Zhang Fei himself is a dual cultivator, and he has more than a hundred wives. Some of them are powerful demons like Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, Dong Xuanyin, and several others."
"How could Zhang Fei gather all those people in his sect?"
"Moreover, those people come from all races, right?"

Ju Yingzhi explained. "Zhang Fei brought hundreds of people from the Three Mortal Realms, and he also had connections with all races. In fact, all the races in the Paradise Realm chose to follow him, including Emperor Long."

Ju Yuning, Qian Hua, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian were stunned after saying that. They knew Emperor Long, the ruler of the beast race, but they never imagined that a powerful cultivator like him would be willing to follow Zhang Fei.

Xia Yanluo added. "Actually, Zhang Fei already had a lot of connections from when he was still living in the Three Mortal Realms, and all his wives came from various races except the demihuman race. Apart from the three female demon gods, he also married the princess of the celestial dragon race, Tianshi Shengjie. He also took one of the grand elders of the winged race, Tian Yaoqin, as his wife."

They were shocked again when Xian Yanluo mentioned Tian Yaoqin. After all, the winged race hated demons to their core, and Zhang Fei was a lust demon, but one of their grand elders was his wife, which was unbelievable.
"If Zhang Fei were to get a wife from the demihuman race, all races would be bound to him, right?"

Ju Yingzhi nodded to her mother. "Zhang Fei has a good relationship with the demihuman race of the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, and Princess Long Xiaolian lives in his sect, but he has no interest in her. If he were interested in her, she would have been his wife long ago."
"If he wants to get a woman, he won’t be able to resist him. His charm is simply too potent, and his strength can match a strong cultivator like Qian Yan." Xin Yanluo added.

Hearing that, Qian Hua recalled Zhang Fei’s words in her domain. ’Does he really have ideas about me? Hmm? He is handsome, strong, and has a wide network. Unfortunately, he is a fickle lust demon, and he has too many wives.’

Ju Yuning glanced at her second daughter, and she could guess her thoughts from her expression. She inwardly sighed, thinking of her two daughters becoming Zhang Fei’s wives. Besides, Qian Qin was his woman, but Qian Yan’s mark in her body prevented them from being together.
"Do you guys feel comfortable living in this domain?" They turned to Zhang Fei [5], who had just arrived.
Ji Yuning nodded to him. "The demon qi in this domain is truly strong, and we can live freely here, so it is very comfortable for us to live here."

"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] sat beside Ju Yingzhi. "Honestly, I’m rebuilding the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I’ll be bringing my people to live there in the future. However, this domain will be my second base, and all my demon acquaintances will be living here in the future, including some of my wives."
"Two domains? How are you going to take care of both?" Qian Hua asked.

"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Did you forget my ability to create a gate? With my ability, it’s not difficult for me to travel to all domains, so it’s not a big deal. Besides, I have teleportation devices, and they will connect both domains, so everyone can travel between them easily. However, I won’t install them now, and I have to take care of some problems in this domain first."
"Some problems?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "Some demon gods from this domain are already on my side, but many others consider me an enemy, and some others have ambitions to rule this domain."
"Wherever we live, there will always be people who are hostile to us," Ji Yuning sighed.

"It’s inevitable, right?" Zhang Fei [5] shrugged. "Everyone has their own character and ambitions, whether humans or demons, so our problems will never end. However, everything will be different in the future, especially after I become the strongest in this universe."

Ju Yuning, Qian Hua, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian looked at Zhang Fei [5] in a daze; they did not expect that he had such a lofty ambition to become the strongest in the universe. With his strength and connection, they believed he would succeed in realizing his ambitions.
Qian Hua carefully stole a glance at Zhang Fei [5], but her eyes suddenly met his gaze, causing her to blush.
Ju Yingzhi noticed her half-sister’s reaction, and she smiled playfully while sending a voice transmission to Zhang Fei [5]. ’If you have any interest in her, you should take her as your wife.’
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t deny that he was interested in Qian Hua, but he hadn’t considered taking her as his wife.
After chatting with them for a while, Zhang Fei [5] sent Ju Yingzhi into the training space, but she asked him to bring her half-sister with them.
Ju Yuning, Ju Yifan, and Qian Xian were confused by the disappearance of the two women, but they didn’t ask Zhang Fei [5] anything.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] left the place and went to the dungeon, but he did not go to the fifth underground floor. He hunted those mindless demons on the fourth underground floor along with Yuan Xiajie, Mo Cangyue, and several others.
Inside the training space, Ju Yingzhi explained to Qian Hua about the device in the middle of the room, including some features in the training ground.

Qian Hua was shocked to discover that the place had ten levels of gravity, with each level doubling the weight. She looked at Puyang Yeyu, Qian Qin, Shang Xueli, Sha Qingge, and several other women who were still struggling to move.
Qian Hua turned to her. "Have you trained with the heaviest gravity, Sister?"

"Not yet." Ju Yingzhi shook her head. "My cultivation is still at the Celestial King Realm, so I can only train up to level four. Since your cultivation is slightly stronger than mine, you can also train up to that level, and your speed will increase significantly after you adapt to that level."
"I see." Qian Hua was silent for a moment. "Why haven’t you dual-cultivated with Zhang Fei, Sister?"

Ju Yingzhi smiled at her. "He knew that I had a heavy burden in my heart, so he never forced me to dual-cultivate with him. Since the burden on my heart has gone, he will probably invite me to dual cultivate with him soon. Do you like him, Sister?"

"I don’t know." Qian Hua shook her head. "He’s handsome, powerful, and influential. I have some interest in him, but I’ve only known him for three days, so I’m not sure yet whether I simply admire him or like him."
Ju Yingzhi nodded in understanding. "You don’t need to think about that for now, and you can start practicing now. I haven’t practiced here for a long time, so I will accompany you to practice."
"Thank you, Sister."
Four days passed quickly.
Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Long Yuxi finally arrived at the Myriad Abyss Domain. Before entering the domain, one of them contacted Mo Qingwen first, and he asked them to meet him in the dungeon.
"What was he doing in that dungeon?" Long Yuxi asked in confusion.
With Mo Qingwen’s status as the ruler of the Myriad Abyss Domain, he could order all the demons in his domain to work in the dungeon, but he actually went into the dungeon himself.
Jiu Tou Sen and Meng Huo themselves had no answer to Mo Qingwen’s strange behavior. "We don’t need to think about that, and we will get the answer after we meet him there."
"Let’s go, Old Jiu."
With Jiu Tou Sen’s speed, the three of them arrived at the dungeon entrance in the blink of an eye, and Mo Qingwen was already waiting for them there.
After Long Yuxi and Meng Huo got off his back, Jiu Tou Sen immediately reverted to his human form and landed in front of Mo Qingwen. "Hahaha! Long time no see, Old Mo!"

"Tch! You three came here without telling me first." Mo Qingwen looked at Long Yuxi. "However, I never thought that you would join them, and I thought you were still enjoying your deep slumber in your domain."

Long Yuxi shrugged. "I wouldn’t have woken up from my deep slumber if those foreign creatures hadn’t invaded my domain, and they attacked me for several days in a row. Since they came to my domain, I decided to join them. By the way, where is that guy named Zhang Fei?"
"Huh?" Mo Qingwen was taken aback. "How did you know about Zhang Fei?"
"Them." Long Yuxi pointed to Jiu Tou Sen and Meng Huo.
Mo Qingwen looked at the two men with a frown, but Meng Huo explained. "A few days ago, I met Tang Zhiyao in her dream space, and I met Zhang Fei there."
"Are you thinking about fighting Zhang Fei for Tang Zhiyao?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1847: Zhang Fei VS Meng Huo I
paragraphs: Meng Huo frowned. "Do you think I’m stupid enough to fight over a woman?"

"Aren’t you just like that?" Mo Qingwen shrugged. "Everyone knows that you were infatuated with Tang Zhiyao, and you also repeatedly harassed her. However, her status is different now, and she has become Zhang Fei’s wife."

"Oh?" Meng Huo was taken aback, and his heart ached upon realizing the situation. However, he didn’t show it in his expression, and he casually asked, "Does that mean they’ve taken their relationship to the next stage?"
"A week ago."
Meng Huo remembered that he met Tang Zhiyao a week ago, but he never expected that she stepped forward with Zhang Fei that day.
"Haha," Long Yuxi laughed. "Are you heartbroken because the woman you love has fallen in the arms of another man?"
"Stop provoking me, woman." Meng Huo said in a deep voice.
Long Yuxi shrugged, not caring about Meng Huo’s anger. "Hey, Old Mo! Is Zhang Fei really in the dungeon?"
"He is." Mo Qingwen nodded. "In fact, he’s been in the dungeon for the past month and a half, and he won’t be coming out anytime soon."
"Oh?" Long Yuxi and the other two were surprised by that. "What exactly is he looking for in the dungeon?"
"What else if not materials to upgrade demon rank?"
Meng Huo was confused by that because he remembered that Zhang Fei’s demon rank had already reached the overlord rank, and Tang Zhiyao was a demon god, so they shouldn’t need those materials anymore.
Mo Qingwen sighed. "Zhang Fei is a lust demon, and he—"
"What?" Meng Huo screamed. "What do you mean Zhang Fei is a lust demon? Isn’t he a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast?"
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi were also confused about Zhang Fei’s identity, since Meng Huo said that he was a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast, but Mo Qingwen said that he was a lust demon.

Unlike them, Mo Qingwen has long known that Zhang Fei has three identities: a human, a lust demon, and a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast. After all, his daughter, Mo Cangyue, had stayed by his side for quite a while, and she also followed him to the Paradise Realm some time ago.
Mo Qingwen sighed. "Zhang Fei is a unique living creature, and you guys will know his uniqueness if you already know him."
"Hmm?" Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Long Yuxi were curious about that.

"Zhang Fei has three identities: a human, a lust demon, and a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast." Jiu Tou Sen wanted to interrupt, but Mo Qingwen stopped him. "I know the three of you won’t believe it because I also found it hard to believe at first, but it’s the truth. If he were an ordinary living being, do you think Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation would accept him as her husband?"
"So, it’s true that Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation is Zhang Fei’s wife, huh?" Long Yuxi mumbled to herself. "Old Mo, take us to see Zhang Fei, and we want to talk to him about a serious matter."
"Those foreign creatures, right?" The three nodded to Mo Qingwen. "In fact, Zhang Fei had difficulty defeating them, and he told me that there was a creature leading them."
"Another creature?"
Mo Qingwen nodded. "That creature is their leader, and it’s much stronger than them; even Guang Zhiyi chose to flee."
Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Long Yuxi took a deep breath, exchanging looks of shock. Guang Zhiyi was the strongest among them in the past, yet she was forced to flee by the leader of those creatures.
"Take us to see Zhang Fei now, Old Mo."
"Let’s go." Mo Qingwen led the three into the dungeon, but they did not stay on the first underground floor, and he directly led them to the fourth underground floor.
Long Yuxi looked at the surrounding area. "Why aren’t the children of those demon gods in this dungeon?"

"This is because of Zhang Fei." Long Yuxi and the other two turned to Mo Qingwen. "He killed Yan Tianling in front of his father, and Yan Washeng couldn’t do anything to avenge his son’s death. Several demon gods had sent their children to monitor him, but they had returned long ago after he showed his true strength."
Jiu Tou Sen put his arm around Mo Qingwen’s shoulders. "How strong is Zhang Fei exactly, Old Mo?"
"He’s stronger than all of us."
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi were a little doubtful about it, but they knew that Meng Huo would not back down if Zhang Fei did not have high strength.
"Old Meng has met Zhang Fei before, so he should already know his strength."
Meng Huo smiled bitterly. "Although I don’t want to admit it, Zhang Fei is indeed stronger than me. If I try to fight him, I will probably die at his hands."
"I didn’t expect you to be afraid of someone, Old Meng." Long Yuxi said sarcastically.
Meng Huo responded indifferently. "If you think you’re stronger than me, you can try fighting him, woman. Since he is a lust demon, he might be lenient towards you."
"Humph!" Long Yuxi snorted in disgust, but she was curious to test Zhang Fei’s strength due to her dragon nature, and a dragon was a prideful creature.
Similar to Long Yuxi, Jiu Tou Sen also wanted to test Zhang Fei [5]’s strength; however, he had to reconsider engaging in a fight because Feng Yao and Huo Ling were by his side.

Sometime later, the four of them arrived at the fourth underground floor, but Meng Huo’s expression turned fierce as soon as he saw Yuan Xiajie. With just one look, he could immediately recognize that she was a member of the Ancient Nether Race.
Meng Huo believed he had slaughtered all the members of the Ancient Nether Race, but he didn’t expect there to be a single survivor from that race.

Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen were confused by Meng Huo’s reaction. They followed his line of sight, and they saw Yuan Xiajie and Mo Cangyue fighting against the mindless demons in the distance.
Before they could speak, Meng Huo had already disappeared from their side, and he had moved in front of Yuan Xiajie in the blink of an eye.

Yuan Xiajie froze as soon as she saw Meng Huo. Her anger welled up as she remembered all her family and clansmen who had died at his hands. However, she also felt a deep fear of him, and her body trembled violently in his presence.
Mo Cangyue felt that Yuan Xiajie’s behavior was quite unusual, and she immediately moved to her side. "What’s wrong, Xiajie?"
"He—"
Before Yuan Xiajie could answer Mo Cangyue’s question, Meng Huo had already reached out to strike her, causing her mind to go blank and her body to lose the strength to move.
However, Zhang Fei [5] suddenly appeared in their midst, and he kicked Meng Huo’s chest with full force, sending him propelling several steps back.
Meng Huo hurriedly stabilized himself, landed in the distance, and took several steps back.
*Plop*
Yuan Xiajie fell onto her butt, looking at Zhang Fei [5]’s back with tears streaming from the corners of her eyes. "Please... please save me... Zhang Fei..."

Mo Cangyue didn’t recognize Meng Huo, but she was enraged because he tried to attack her best friend and lover. She squatted beside Yuan Xiajie, hugged her, and fiercely glared at the enemy in front of them.
Mo Qingwen immediately moved in front of them, protecting his daughter and Yuan Xiajie from Meng Huo.

Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi also moved beside them, and they were taken aback for a moment after recognizing Yuan Xiajie’s identity as a sole member of the Ancient Nether Race, giving them an answer to Meng Huo’s strange behavior. They turned their attention to Zhang Fei [5], whose cultivation had already reached the Celestial God Realm.
’He really is a lust demon.’
’How could he reach that level at such a young age?’

Meng Huo looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a frown, and his black sword appeared in his right hand. He released his killing intent, his jet-black eyes became increasingly black, and black flames enveloped his sword. "Leave that woman to me."

"Do you think you can do as you please in front of me?" Zhang Fei [5] also released his killing intent, which shocked Meng Huo and the others. "I know that you massacred the Ancient Nether Race in the past, but Yuan Xiajie is my friend. If you want to kill her, I will kill you right here right now."
’Hahaha! Old Meng has finally met his match!’ Long Yuxi laughed in her heart, looking at Zhang Fei [5] in admiration.

Jiu Tou Sen did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] would stand up for Yuan Xiajie, and he even dared to say such words against Meng Huo. However, he was more curious about the familiar aura from his body, which was similar to his. ’No wonder Guang Zhiyi chose him as her husband.’
*Swoosh*
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi held their breaths as soon as Huo Ling shot out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body, but the latter’s expression turned to joy after seeing the female flame spirit.
Huo Ling looked at the two people, and she was a little surprised by Long Yuxi’s presence. She ignored her and asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Do you need my help, husband?"

"He may be strong, but he is not my opponent, and I am not afraid of his nightmare techniques." Zhang Fei [5] answered with a deep and firm voice. Since the demon extermination sword was in the process of being upgraded, he took out another sword and pointed it at Meng Huo. "You should leave while you still have time, or this place will be your burial ground."

sentences.text: Meng Huo frowned.
"Do you think I’m stupid enough to fight over a woman?"
"Aren’t you just like that?" Mo Qingwen shrugged.
"Everyone knows that you were infatuated with Tang Zhiyao, and you also repeatedly harassed her.
However, her status is different now, and she has become Zhang Fei’s wife."
"Oh?" Meng Huo was taken aback, and his heart ached upon realizing the situation.
However, he didn’t show it in his expression, and he casually asked, "Does that mean they’ve taken their relationship to the next stage?"
"A week ago."
Meng Huo remembered that he met Tang Zhiyao a week ago, but he never expected that she stepped forward with Zhang Fei that day.
"Haha," Long Yuxi laughed.
"Are you heartbroken because the woman you love has fallen in the arms of another man?"
"Stop provoking me, woman." Meng Huo said in a deep voice.
Long Yuxi shrugged, not caring about Meng Huo’s anger.
"Hey, Old Mo!
Is Zhang Fei really in the dungeon?"
"He is." Mo Qingwen nodded.
"In fact, he’s been in the dungeon for the past month and a half, and he won’t be coming out anytime soon."
"Oh?" Long Yuxi and the other two were surprised by that.
"What exactly is he looking for in the dungeon?"
"What else if not materials to upgrade demon rank?"
Meng Huo was confused by that because he remembered that Zhang Fei’s demon rank had already reached the overlord rank, and Tang Zhiyao was a demon god, so they shouldn’t need those materials anymore.
Mo Qingwen sighed.
"Zhang Fei is a lust demon, and he—"
"What?" Meng Huo screamed.
"What do you mean Zhang Fei is a lust demon?
Isn’t he a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast?"
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi were also confused about Zhang Fei’s identity, since Meng Huo said that he was a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast, but Mo Qingwen said that he was a lust demon.
Unlike them, Mo Qingwen has long known that Zhang Fei has three identities: a human, a lust demon, and a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast.
After all, his daughter, Mo Cangyue, had stayed by his side for quite a while, and she also followed him to the Paradise Realm some time ago.
Mo Qingwen sighed.
"Zhang Fei is a unique living creature, and you guys will know his uniqueness if you already know him."
"Hmm?" Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Long Yuxi were curious about that.
"Zhang Fei has three identities: a human, a lust demon, and a nine-tailed heavenly fox beast." Jiu Tou Sen wanted to interrupt, but Mo Qingwen stopped him.
"I know the three of you won’t believe it because I also found it hard to believe at first, but it’s the truth.
If he were an ordinary living being, do you think Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation would accept him as her husband?"
"So, it’s true that Guang Zhiyi’s reincarnation is Zhang Fei’s wife, huh?" Long Yuxi mumbled to herself.
"Old Mo, take us to see Zhang Fei, and we want to talk to him about a serious matter."
"Those foreign creatures, right?" The three nodded to Mo Qingwen.
"In fact, Zhang Fei had difficulty defeating them, and he told me that there was a creature leading them."
"Another creature?"
Mo Qingwen nodded.
"That creature is their leader, and it’s much stronger than them; even Guang Zhiyi chose to flee."
Jiu Tou Sen, Meng Huo, and Long Yuxi took a deep breath, exchanging looks of shock.
Guang Zhiyi was the strongest among them in the past, yet she was forced to flee by the leader of those creatures.
"Take us to see Zhang Fei now, Old Mo."
"Let’s go." Mo Qingwen led the three into the dungeon, but they did not stay on the first underground floor, and he directly led them to the fourth underground floor.
Long Yuxi looked at the surrounding area.
"Why aren’t the children of those demon gods in this dungeon?"
"This is because of Zhang Fei." Long Yuxi and the other two turned to Mo Qingwen.
"He killed Yan Tianling in front of his father, and Yan Washeng couldn’t do anything to avenge his son’s death.
Several demon gods had sent their children to monitor him, but they had returned long ago after he showed his true strength."
Jiu Tou Sen put his arm around Mo Qingwen’s shoulders.
"How strong is Zhang Fei exactly, Old Mo?"
"He’s stronger than all of us."
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi were a little doubtful about it, but they knew that Meng Huo would not back down if Zhang Fei did not have high strength.
"Old Meng has met Zhang Fei before, so he should already know his strength."
Meng Huo smiled bitterly.
"Although I don’t want to admit it, Zhang Fei is indeed stronger than me.
If I try to fight him, I will probably die at his hands."
"I didn’t expect you to be afraid of someone, Old Meng." Long Yuxi said sarcastically.
Meng Huo responded indifferently.
"If you think you’re stronger than me, you can try fighting him, woman.
Since he is a lust demon, he might be lenient towards you."
"Humph!" Long Yuxi snorted in disgust, but she was curious to test Zhang Fei’s strength due to her dragon nature, and a dragon was a prideful creature.
Similar to Long Yuxi, Jiu Tou Sen also wanted to test Zhang Fei [5]’s strength; however, he had to reconsider engaging in a fight because Feng Yao and Huo Ling were by his side.

chapters.title: Chapter 1848: Zhang Fei VS Meng Huo II
paragraphs: ’Hehehe! If he defeats Old Meng, the ranking of the strongest cultivators will change after so long, and he will become the second strongest cultivator in this realm.’ Long Yuxi gave Zhang Fei [5] a thumbs up, glancing at Meng Huo. She didn’t expect such a young lust demon to threaten the mighty nightmare lord.

Jiu Tou Sen was quite surprised to hear Zhang Fei [5]’s threat to Meng Huo. Moreover, he forbade Huo Ling to help him, which showed his confidence to face the nightmare lord. ’Show me your true strength, kid.’

Meng Huo looked ugly because Zhang Fei [5] insisted on protecting Yuan Xiajie. He didn’t want to fight with her because Feng Yao and Huo Ling were his wives, and he didn’t want to fight the two women, but the situation suddenly changed just for the sake of a female demon.
"If you don’t want to give up, then don’t blame me."
Long Yuxi, Jiu Tou Sen, and Meng Huo gasped in shock as Zhang Fei [5] disappeared from their sight; the worst thing was that they couldn’t sense his aura.

Unlike them, Mo Qingwen appeared calm because he had fought alongside Zhang Fei [5] for over a month in the dungeon, so he already had an idea of his strength and abilities. He pitied Meng Huo because he was about to face something he had never imagined, and he would die if he didn’t give up. ’I hope that kid won’t kill him because we still need him, especially with those foreign creatures threatening this realm.’

Meng Huo tried to look for Zhang Fei [5]’s whereabouts, but he couldn’t feel his aura and movement at all, as if he had disappeared completely. A jet-black sphere quickly spread from his torso to several meters away, forcing Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi to jump away.

Mo Qingwen didn’t expect Meng Huo to activate his domain from the start, but he moved quickly by grabbing Mo Cangyue and Yuan Xiajie’s shoulders. He carried the two women away from the domain’s range; otherwise, they would be caught up in its effects.
Meanwhile, Huo Ling remained calm, and she looked at Meng Huo with a look of disdain. "Just a single domain, huh? What a show-off!"
Meng Huo did not respond to Huo Ling’s taunts, and he continued trying to find Zhang Fei [5]’s location. However, several other domains suddenly overlapped his domain, which shocked him.

Long Yuxi and Jiu Tou Sen were stunned after seeing the domains, one of which was similar to Meng Huo’s domain. Even though they didn’t see it directly, they were sure that all the domains belonged to Zhang Fei [5], but he didn’t understand how he could create a domain similar to that of the nightmare lord.
No one except Feng Yao and Huo Ling knew that Zhang Fei [5] had already mimicked Meng Huo’s Nightmare Sovereign Codex, so it wasn’t difficult for him to create a domain similar to his.
However, Zhang Fei [5]’s new domain was different from Meng Huo’s, and he combined it with his own domains to enhance its effect.

Meng Huo’s jet-black eyes trembled; he didn’t understand how Zhang Fei [5] could mimic his domain, which had always been his mainstay. However, he quickly realized that his opponent’s domain was not completely similar to his, and it had some other effects that his own domain did not have.
"Do you understand the difference in our abilities now?"
Meng Huo spun around and swung his sword, but his attack sliced through empty air.
"I have to admit that your Nightmare Sovereign Codex is amazing, but you won’t be able to use all your techniques against me."
"Gah!" Meng Huo suddenly screamed, and blood flowed from the deep slash wound in his chest. He unleashed his cultivation and killing intent at full strength to exert pressure on Zhang Fei [5].

However, Zhang Fei [5] immediately suppressed Meng Huo’s killing intent with his own, shocking everyone who witnessed it. They knew the nightmare lord’s killing intent was quite terrifying, but a young cultivator suppressed it with his own.

Although he said he would kill Meng Huo, Zhang Fei [5] never intended to kill him from the start. There were still many powerful enemies out there, especially those shadowy creatures. Not even Feng Yao could defeat those creatures, so he needed many powerful allies to eradicate them and defeat the core creature.

Meng Huo suddenly felt pressure from above, so he hurriedly looked up and saw countless qi swords of different colors hovering there. His pupils dilated after he sensed the power of those qi swords; he just realized that Zhang Fei [5] was a god-rank swordmaster.
Meng Huo gritted his teeth and glared at Yuan Xiajie, but Mo Qingwen swiftly protected her, realizing that the nightmare lord was targeting her. "Old Meng, your opponent is Zhang Fei."

"You—Gah!" Meng Huo looked at his chest, finding a white sword stabbing him from behind. He swung his sword backward, but Zhang Fei [5]’s speed was simply much faster than his, and he dodged his attack while pulling his sword out of his body. "Damn it!"
Meng Huo hurriedly swallowed a pill to stop the bleeding, but his blood didn’t stop; instead, it flowed even faster.

"As long as you’re in my domain, your bleeding will never stop." Zhang Fei [5] moved again and slashed Meng Huo’s chest several times, causing his bleeding to become even worse. "I will give you one more chance: give up or die."

"Hah... Hah..." Meng Huo fell to one leg and breathed heavily; he had not expected that he would be completely helpless in front of a cultivator who was much younger than him. Even his ultimate ability didn’t work in front of him, which had never happened before.
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi exchanged shocked glances; they did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] could suppress Meng Huo from the start, and he also rendered his abilities useless.

"If you don’t give up now, you will really die, and people will forget your name." After Zhang Fei [5] said that, fourteen silhouettes of beasts appeared in the area around them, and their gazes were completely focused on Meng Huo. "Live or die, it is your choice."
’This crazy kid!’
Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi were equally shocked, their gazes constantly shifting from one beast to another.
The nine-tailed heavenly fox.
The fire phoenix.
The dark phoenix.
The ice phoenix.
The golden crow.
The vermillion bird.
The golden fox.
The flame dragon.
The azure dragon.
The mythical deer.
The azure emperor roc.
The rainbow-shelled tortoise.
The white tiger.
What shocked Long Yuxi and Jiu Tou Sen the most was the last beast, the Calamity Demon Dragon.

’The one and only Calamity Demon Dragon, whose strength is equal to the Five-Clawed Golden Dragon,’ Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi muttered in their hearts. ’How did this kid get all those beast bloodlines? No! How could his body accommodate so many beast bloodlines at once? How absurd!’

Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi looked at Huo Ling, who was smiling proudly while she looked at Zhang Fei [5]. They finally knew the reason behind the female flame spirit and Feng Yao’s decision to choose him as their husband.

Meng Huo looked at all those beasts with fear; he knew that he would die if Zhang Fei [5] ordered them to attack him. Not to mention, those countless qi swords were still aimed at him, and they had different elements. Throughout his life, he had never experienced such humiliation, including when he fought against Guan Zhiyi in the past.
*Swoosh*
A woman suddenly appeared in the battle arena, and they immediately recognized her identity as Guang Zhiyi. However, she was different from the original Guang Zhiyi, and her aura was much gentler.
Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow because she was the same woman as the one in the Era of the Beginning, but then he remembered that Feng Yao was the embodiment of Xin, the core of this universe.
Guang Zhiyi looked at him with a smile. "You should stop, husband. We still need Meng Huo to fight those creatures, so you can’t kill him."
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] removed all his techniques. "If I wanted to kill him, I would have done it from the start."

"Hehe," Guang Zhiyi looked at Meng Huo. "Old friend, your cultivation is indeed high, and your abilities are also frightening to others. However, my husband is different from you or other cultivators, and he has a much harder task to save this universe. You may feel humiliated now, but you will not lose face because of your defeat to him, so I advise you to give up and help him to stop those creatures."
Meng Huo looked at Guang Zhiyi before letting out a soft breath, and he also retracted his cultivation and killing intent. "I’m lost."
"Haha," Guang Zhiyi laughed. "There’s nothing wrong with losing to a stronger cultivator. Didn’t you experience it when I beat you up in the past?"
Meng Huo’s mouth twitched. "You are still as shameless as in the past, Guang Zhiyi."
"Well? I’m really shameless." Guang Zhiyi nodded with a smile.
"Why can’t I detect any signs of life from you?" Meng Huo asked as he stood up, and his injuries began to heal slowly.
Guang Zhiyi smiled. "Because the body is not my real body, and it is just a projection of the memories I left behind."
"Hey! What do you mean by that, Guang Zhiyi?" Long Yuxi asked, jumping in front of her.
Guang Zhiyi shrugged. "I won’t explain it to you, little dragon. However, I can tell you that my real body lives inside my husband’s beast space, and I’m always watching everything from there."
"Huh? Does that mean you reincarnated as a beast in this lifetime?"

Guang Zhiyi shrugged.
"I won’t explain it to you, little dragon.
However, I can tell you that my real body lives inside my husband’s beast space, and I’m always watching everything from there."
"Huh?
Does that mean you reincarnated as a beast in this lifetime?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1849: The Four And Guang Zhiyi I
paragraphs: "Well? I was born a fire phoenix this lifetime."
"Huh?" Long Yuxi hugged Guang Zhiyi’s arm. "Quick! Bring your real body here! I want to see your phoenix form!"
Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "My real body can’t leave my husband’s beast space, so I can’t show you my phoenix form."
"Why is that?" Long Yuxi was puzzled.
Guang Zhiyi looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "Why don’t you show her the truth, husband?"
"Are you sure that won’t make them come to me?" Zhang Fei [5] was hesitant.
"No," Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "They won’t come to you because it’s not your real strength."
"Hey! What are you two talking about?" Long Yuxi irritably asked.
"Just wait."
Zhang Fei [5] took a deep breath before activating the soul link to its maximum level.
Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen stared at Zhang Fei [5] with wide eyes, sensing his strength had increased significantly.
"How could this be?"
"His strength surpasses ours."
"I can’t tell his cultivation level."
"That means his cultivation level has surpassed the Celestial God Realm."
Long Yuxi turned to Guang Zhiyi. "Tell me the truth, Zhiyi! Your husband borrowed your strength, right? What level is your cultivation now?"
"I think we should talk somewhere else." Guang Zhiyi looked at Zhang Fei [5] again. "Take us all to that domain, husband."
"Wait a minute."

Before long, Zhang Fei arrived in front of them, which shocked them again. They were aware of the clone technique, but they had never seen a clone and its real body share the same cultivation level, as a clone typically possesses only half the cultivation of the real body.
Zhang Fei ignored their reactions and opened the gate to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. "Let’s go there now."

After they disappeared, Zhang Fei [5] approached Yuan Xiajie. He lifted her to her feet and hugged her. "It’s okay, you don’t have to be afraid anymore, Xiajie. From now on, Meng Huo won’t target you anymore, and I’ll beat him up if he dares to do that again."
"Mhmm..." Yuan Xiajie nodded slightly, nestling in his chest. "Thank you, Zhang Fei. Back then, I—"

"Alright, no need to discuss the past." Zhang Fei [5] certainly remembered his unpleasant first encounter with Yuan Xiajie, but he had forgotten about it since she decided to follow him. "You just need to live for now and the future."
"Thank you." Yuan Xiajie broke free from his embrace, stood on tiptoe, and kissed him.

Mo Cangyue, who watched from the side, felt annoyed and jealous because Yuan Xiajie kissed Zhang Fei [5]. She had forbidden her to kiss a man, but her lover blatantly kissed him in front of her eyes. ’Tch! I’ll punish her later!’
Zhang Fei [5] could feel Mo Cangyue’s angry gaze on him, but he didn’t care about her. He hugged Yuan Xiajie’s waist and gave her a deep, passionate kiss.
They kissed for a minute before Zhang Fei [5] separated their lips; he rubbed Yuan Xiajie’s cheek and gave her a meaningful look.
Yuan Xiajie blushed as she understood Zhang Fei [5]’s hidden meaning. She brought her face to her ear and whispered to him. ’Should we take Mo Cangyue with us?’

’No! I’ve never been attracted to her.’ Even though Mo Cangyu had an attractive face, Zhang Fei [5] didn’t feel the slightest attraction to her. Besides, he didn’t have such a relationship with her family, as it would be troublesome for him.

"Hey!" Yuan Xiajie and Zhang Fei [5] turned to the irritated Mo Cangyue. "Can you two stop being so lovey dovey in front of me? I feel nauseous seeing your closeness! And you, Xiajie, you are my lover, but you kissed him in front of me!"
Yuan Xiajie shrugged. "Aren’t you wrong about that, Sister Cangyue? I’m Big Sis Qianmei’s lover, and you’re the one forcing our relationship."

"You—" Mo Cangyue huffed and turned to leave, realizing that she was the one who forced Yuan Xiajie into a relationship with her. Fortunately, she had her father as her backer, and Hua Qianmei never said anything about it. ’Tch! This is all Zhang Fei [5]’s fault! If he hadn’t appeared here, Xiajie wouldn’t have fallen in love with him!’
However, Mo Cangyue quickly realized that she was mistaken, as it was Yuan Xiajie who had brought Zhang Fei [5] to their domain, and the two of them had known each other for several years.
Zhang Fei [5] shook his head and said to Yuan Xiajie. "Let’s continue our hunt."
"Okay."

Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen looked around in surprise, especially after they saw hundreds of people working there. They recognized the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, but it had long been destroyed, yet Zhang Fei brought his subordinates to rebuild it.
Long Yuxi turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you planning to bring those closest to you to move to this domain?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei pointed in several directions. "There are many facilities left over from the old residents, and they are useful for dual cultivation, so I think this domain is most suitable for them."
"Does that mean everyone close to you is a dual cultivator?"

"No," Zhang Fei shook his head. "More of them are dual cultivators, but the rest are just ordinary cultivators. Even though they aren’t dual cultivators, they can use all the facilities in this domain with their respective husbands or wives."
Mo Qingwen looked up at the sky. "Unfortunately, this domain doesn’t have a barrier yet, so other people and those creatures can invade it at any time."

"That’s true." Meng Huo nodded in agreement. "He may not be afraid of the other cultivators, but those creatures are truly troublesome. If we defeat the weak ones, they will send stronger ones, and so on."

Jiu Tou Sen looked at Guang Zhiyi. "Where do those creatures actually come from? Their numbers are endless, and they keep getting stronger. I’m afraid we won’t be able to face them one day, and they will invade all domains in this Ancient Realm."

"They were born along with this universe." Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen looked at Guang Zhiyi in confusion and shock. "I can’t explain the details to all of you, but I’m telling you the truth. In the past, they were sealed within the core of this universe, but something happened and freed them from that place. Currently, they are targeting all the powerful cultivators in this realm, but the four of you are their primary targets. Besides you guys, they are also targeting my husband, but they will never be able to capture him."
"Old Mo previously said that those creatures have a leader; have you two ever met it?"
Zhang Fei shook his head. "We’ve never met their leader, but my wife said it destroyed the Cangxuan Domain."
"The Cangxuan Domain has been empty for a long time, so it’s not a big deal, right?"
"Although it’s not a big deal, we can’t rest assured. With their leader’s power, it should be able to destroy all the domains in this Ancient Realm," Jiu Tou Sen said glumly.

Mo Qingwen nodded in agreement. "Back then, those creatures attacked my domain and killed many people, but we eventually managed to drive them out of our domain, and we worked together to set up the current barrier."
"So, how should we defeat those creatures?" Long Yuxi looked at Guang Zhiyi and Zhang Fei. "Besides, you haven’t explained to us about your current strength, so you have to explain everything now."

"Haha," Guang Zhiyi touched their foreheads one by one, and she shared information about the Three God Realms with them. "Those three realms are the advanced stages after the Five Celestial Realms, but unfortunately, you will never be able to reach them as long as you stay in this realm."

The four of them didn’t answer Guang Zhiyi directly, and their thoughts were more focused on the Three God Realms. Since they couldn’t sense her true cultivation, they looked at Zhang Fei, who was still borrowing her strength.
"How did you borrow her strength?" Long Yuxi curiously asked.
Zhang Fei simply smiled. "That’s my secret, and none of my wives know about it except for Feng Yao and Huo Ling. Moreover, our relationship is still so-so, so I won’t explain it to you."
"Tch! Cheapskate!" Long Yuxi grumbled.

Meng Huo spoke. "You said that we can’t break through to the Three God Realms as long as we stay in this Ancient Realm, right? So, how did you break through to that stage? Where can we cultivate to reach that stage?"
"Since I was reincarnated with full memories, you guys should be able to guess it, right?"
Jiu Tou Sen immediately said. "That means there is a realm higher than this Ancient Realm, and you lived in that realm in the past."

"Smart!" Guang Zhiyi waved her hand and created a qi screen, which showed the Primordial Realm. "That realm is the highest in this universe, and you guys can only reach the Three God Realm by cultivating there. Unfortunately, the path to that realm has long gone, and no one can find it except me."
Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen looked at Guang Zhiyi intensely.
"What is the name of that realm?"
"The Primordial Realm."
Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, Meng Huo, and Mo Qingwen’s eyes widened in shock. They never expected Guang Zhiyi to be the reincarnation of a primordial being.

"Haha! You guys are right, I am indeed the reincarnation of a primordial being named Shen Yuanzhi, and I was able to reach the Three God Realm because I sealed my past cultivation before I reincarnated as Guang Zhiyi."
"This—" They were speechless, and they finally realized why Guang Zhiyi could be so strong in the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 1850: The Four And Guang Zhiyi II
paragraphs: Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen looked at Zhang Fei with solemn gazes.
Since Guang Zhiyi’s cultivation had reached the Three God Realm, and Zhang Fei could borrow her strength, that meant the two of them were the strongest cultivators in the Ancient Realm.
Even if the four of them joined forces and fought both of them at the same time, they would never be able to defeat either of them.
Jiu Tou Sen inwardly sighed, but his gaze toward Zhang Fei was a little strange. ’He’s still young, but his abilities are already terrifying, and he has Guang Zhiyi as his backer.’

’Sigh! I must forget that woman from the Ancient Nether Demon Race.’ Meng Huo finally conceded defeat; he had no other choice but to recognize Zhang Fei’s strength. Even if he didn’t borrow Guang Zhiyi’s strength, he still had many other abilities, including his multiple domains.

Long Yuxi felt pressured by Zhang Fei’s presence, but she didn’t think too much about it, and she was happy if there was a cultivator who was much stronger than her. ’I have to work harder to improve myself, or I will fall far behind him.’

Mo Qingwen was the most relaxed among the four of them; he could see from the start that Zhang Fei was not an ordinary cultivator, especially with his action of defeating Yan Washeng. ’Unfortunately, my daughter only likes women, so she can’t possibly like him.’
"Hey, Zhiyi! Is there a way to go to the Primordial Realm?" Long Yuxi asked.

"Normally, we can’t go to the Primordial Realm because all paths are gone, but the Primordials have their method of traveling back and forth between the two realms." The eyes of the four people sparkled, and they hoped that Guang Zhiyi would be willing to show them the way to that realm. "Forget it! You guys will die if you go to that realm now."
"Why is that?" Mo Qingwen asked.

"Some primordials are still alive, and two of them are vile." They gasped in shock. "Do I need to lie to you about them? Two of them even sent their avatars to this realm, and they are targeting my husband."
"Who are those two primordials?"

Guang Zhiyi looked at Jiu Tou Sen. "You are the Nine-Headed Serpent Beast, but those two primordial beasts are far superior to you. They never come to you because they consider you unworthy, and they can kill you with a snap of their fingers."
"What can I say about that?" Jiu Tou Sen responded helplessly. "Come on! Tell us their identities."

Guang Zhiyi created two qi screens that displayed two different beasts. "The black one is Xu Yuanzhi, and he is the Primordial Nihility Beast. The white one is Huang Yuanzhi, and he is the Primordial Genesis Beast. Their real bodies are in the deep slumber, but their avatars are always wandering in this realm."
"Why are they targeting your husband? Is there something special about him?" Meng Huo asked, looking at the images of the two primordial beasts.
Guang Zhiyi looked at them. "Do you guys remember the two powerful beasts that lived in this realm in the past?"
"The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, and—" Long Yuxi stopped talking and looked at Zhang Fei. "The Calamity Demon Dragon."
Jiu Tou Sen was shocked after realizing that. "Does that mean your husband is the current Calamity Demon Dragon?"

"He is indeed the current Calamity Demon Dragon; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to summon the silhouette of that beast in the previous battle." Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi looked at Zhang Fei with awe and fear. "In the past, Xu Yuanzhi killed the old Calamity Demon Dragon, and Huang Yuanzhi killed the old Five-Clawed Golden Dragon."
"Why did the two primordial beasts go to such lengths to kill the two dragons?"
"They’re scared."
"Scared?"

Guang Zhiyi nodded to Jiu Tou Sen. "Just like the two primordial beasts, the two dragons are the only ones of their race, and they have great potential. Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi were afraid that the two dragons would surpass them, so they killed both of them, and they hunted for their reincarnation."
"Even the two primordial beasts are affected by fear, huh?" Jiu Tou Sen muttered while nodding in understanding.
"Hahaha," Guang Zhiyi laughed. "There is no living creature who does not have fear in their life, including me."
Their ears perked up as soon as Guang Zhiyi said that, but they didn’t believe her considering her past character.
"Do you really have fear in your life, Zhiyi?" Long Yuxi doubtfully asked.
Jiu Tou Sen rubbed his chin, looking at Guang Zhiyi. "As far as I remember, you were never afraid of anyone in the past, so where does your fear come from now?"
"As if I will believe you, Zhiyi!" Meng Huo scoffed.
Mo Qingwen agreed with his three friends. "All living creatures may have fears in their lives, but you will never have fear in your life."

"Why do you guys think I don’t have fear in my life?" The four of them responded to Guang Zhiyi with heavy snorts. "Seriously, there’s one thing that always haunts me, and I know that it will become a reality in the future."
Zhang Fei frowned as he realized that. "Hey! I told you to forget about that! You’re my wife, and I won’t let that happen to you!"
"Can you see the future, husband?"
Zhang Fei shrugged. "Even if I can’t see the future, I still won’t let anything bad happen to you. If something happens to you, this universe will be destroyed along with you."
Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen exchanged confused looks, not understanding the meaning of Zhang Fei and Guang Zhiyi’s conversation.

"Alright, let’s not talk about that matter for now." Guang Zhiyi looked at the four of them. "I specifically met with you four today and revealed some things to you because I need your help in the future, which is related to the future of this universe. If this universe is destroyed, you guys will die along with it."
"What kind of help do you need from us?"

"Our main problem is those creatures." The expressions of the four of them turned serious. "Since you guys have fought them before, you should already know their strength. My husband and I cannot eradicate these creatures on our own, so we need your help to do so."
"But—"

Guang Zhiyi waved her hand. "I’m not asking the four of you to fight their leader because you will never be able to defeat it, let alone kill it. My husband will face their leader in the future, and I will support him from behind along with Huo Ling. Their numbers are enormous, and the three of us can’t possibly face them all at once, so we need your help to deal with them."

"How can we face those creatures if they keep getting stronger, Zhiyi?" Long Yuxi released a heavy sigh. "Before the three of us went to Old Mo’s domain, we fought against those creatures in my domain. They might have succeeded in capturing me if Old Jiu and Old Meng hadn’t come to my domain."

Jiu Tou Sen agreed with her. "Before Old Meng came to my domain, I fought with those creatures for a whole week, and their strength continued to increase. I don’t have the confidence to fight them continuously, and I might lose to them in the end."

"The last time I fought those creatures, I suffered quite a bit of injury, though it wasn’t life-threatening." Mo Qingwen paused. "The barrier in my domain can keep those creatures out, but it won’t last forever, and I need to find a way to improve it. Besides, you know the situation in my domain, and the other demon gods are constantly eyeing my position."

Meng Huo felt sorry for his three friends. "Unlike you guys, I’m always moving from one domain to another, so I rarely encounter those creatures. Even if I do meet them, I can imprison them in my nightmare domain, but I can’t imprison them forever. That’s why I’ve been looking for other ways to deal with them, but I haven’t found the right solution yet."

"Husband." Zhang Fei took out some pills and gave them to the four people. Their grade shocked Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, and Long Yuxi. "My husband is a god-rank alchemist, and he concocted these pills himself."
"Huh? Are you kidding us?" Long Yuxi asked in a high voice.

Jiu Tou Sen and Meng Huo also found it difficult to believe, especially after Zhang Fei had previously demonstrated his abilities in the way of the sword, which indicated that he was a god-rank swordmaster. Even if he possessed exceptional talent and learned both paths simultaneously, he wouldn’t be able to reach the pinnacle of both, yet Guang Zhiyi said that he succeeded in achieving both.
Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "Do you think I would accept him as my husband if he were an ordinary cultivator, Yuxi?"
"Well?" Long Yuxi scratched her head without being able to refute her.
Zhang Fei took out his Heaven Creation Furnace and some herbs. "Since you guys doubt my alchemy skills, I’ll show it to you."
After saying that, Zhang Fei prepared all the herbs and heated the furnace. Ten minutes later, all the herbs were ready, and the furnace had reached the required temperature.

Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen watched Zhang Fei perform alchemy seriously. However, they were puzzled when he tossed all the herbs into the furnace. Although they were not alchemists, they knew that each herb required different heat and processing, yet he threw them all into the furnace at once.
Guang Zhiyi shook her head. "Use your senses to see the inside of his furnace."

"Normally, we can’t go to the Primordial Realm because all paths are gone, but the Primordials have their method of traveling back and forth between the two realms." The eyes of the four people sparkled, and they hoped that Guang Zhiyi would be willing to show them the way to that realm.
"Forget it!
You guys will die if you go to that realm now."
"Why is that?" Mo Qingwen asked.
"Some primordials are still alive, and two of them are vile." They gasped in shock.
"Do I need to lie to you about them?
Two of them even sent their avatars to this realm, and they are targeting my husband."
"Who are those two primordials?"
Guang Zhiyi looked at Jiu Tou Sen.
"You are the Nine-Headed Serpent Beast, but those two primordial beasts are far superior to you.
They never come to you because they consider you unworthy, and they can kill you with a snap of their fingers."
"What can I say about that?" Jiu Tou Sen responded helplessly.
"Come on!
Tell us their identities."
Guang Zhiyi created two qi screens that displayed two different beasts.
"The black one is Xu Yuanzhi, and he is the Primordial Nihility Beast.
The white one is Huang Yuanzhi, and he is the Primordial Genesis Beast.
Their real bodies are in the deep slumber, but their avatars are always wandering in this realm."
"Why are they targeting your husband?
Is there something special about him?" Meng Huo asked, looking at the images of the two primordial beasts.
Guang Zhiyi looked at them.
"Do you guys remember the two powerful beasts that lived in this realm in the past?"
"The Five-Clawed Golden Dragon, and—" Long Yuxi stopped talking and looked at Zhang Fei.
"The Calamity Demon Dragon."
Jiu Tou Sen was shocked after realizing that.
"Does that mean your husband is the current Calamity Demon Dragon?"

"He is indeed the current Calamity Demon Dragon; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to summon the silhouette of that beast in the previous battle." Jiu Tou Sen and Long Yuxi looked at Zhang Fei with awe and fear.
"In the past, Xu Yuanzhi killed the old Calamity Demon Dragon, and Huang Yuanzhi killed the old Five-Clawed Golden Dragon."
"Why did the two primordial beasts go to such lengths to kill the two dragons?"
"They’re scared."
"Scared?"
Guang Zhiyi nodded to Jiu Tou Sen.
"Just like the two primordial beasts, the two dragons are the only ones of their race, and they have great potential.
Xu Yuanzhi and Huang Yuanzhi were afraid that the two dragons would surpass them, so they killed both of them, and they hunted for their reincarnation."
"Even the two primordial beasts are affected by fear, huh?" Jiu Tou Sen muttered while nodding in understanding.
"Hahaha," Guang Zhiyi laughed.
"There is no living creature who does not have fear in their life, including me."
Their ears perked up as soon as Guang Zhiyi said that, but they didn’t believe her considering her past character.
"Do you really have fear in your life, Zhiyi?" Long Yuxi doubtfully asked.
Jiu Tou Sen rubbed his chin, looking at Guang Zhiyi.
"As far as I remember, you were never afraid of anyone in the past, so where does your fear come from now?"
"As if I will believe you, Zhiyi!" Meng Huo scoffed.
Mo Qingwen agreed with his three friends.
"All living creatures may have fears in their lives, but you will never have fear in your life."
"Why do you guys think I don’t have fear in my life?" The four of them responded to Guang Zhiyi with heavy snorts.
"Seriously, there’s one thing that always haunts me, and I know that it will become a reality in the future."
Zhang Fei frowned as he realized that.
"Hey!
I told you to forget about that!
You’re my wife, and I won’t let that happen to you!"
"Can you see the future, husband?"
Zhang Fei shrugged.
"Even if I can’t see the future, I still won’t let anything bad happen to you.
If something happens to you, this universe will be destroyed along with you."
Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen exchanged confused looks, not understanding the meaning of Zhang Fei and Guang Zhiyi’s conversation.
"Alright, let’s not talk about that matter for now." Guang Zhiyi looked at the four of them.
"I specifically met with you four today and revealed some things to you because I need your help in the future, which is related to the future of this universe.
If this universe is destroyed, you guys will die along with it."
"What kind of help do you need from us?"
"Our main problem is those creatures." The expressions of the four of them turned serious.
"Since you guys have fought them before, you should already know their strength.
My husband and I cannot eradicate these creatures on our own, so we need your help to do so."
"But—"
Guang Zhiyi waved her hand.
"I’m not asking the four of you to fight their leader because you will never be able to defeat it, let alone kill it.
My husband will face their leader in the future, and I will support him from behind along with Huo Ling.
Their numbers are enormous, and the three of us can’t possibly face them all at once, so we need your help to deal with them."
"How can we face those creatures if they keep getting stronger, Zhiyi?" Long Yuxi released a heavy sigh.
"Before the three of us went to Old Mo’s domain, we fought against those creatures in my domain.
They might have succeeded in capturing me if Old Jiu and Old Meng hadn’t come to my domain."
Jiu Tou Sen agreed with her.
"Before Old Meng came to my domain, I fought with those creatures for a whole week, and their strength continued to increase.
I don’t have the confidence to fight them continuously, and I might lose to them in the end."
"The last time I fought those creatures, I suffered quite a bit of injury, though it wasn’t life-threatening." Mo Qingwen paused.
"The barrier in my domain can keep those creatures out, but it won’t last forever, and I need to find a way to improve it.
Besides, you know the situation in my domain, and the other demon gods are constantly eyeing my position."
Meng Huo felt sorry for his three friends.
"Unlike you guys, I’m always moving from one domain to another, so I rarely encounter those creatures.
Even if I do meet them, I can imprison them in my nightmare domain, but I can’t imprison them forever.
That’s why I’ve been looking for other ways to deal with them, but I haven’t found the right solution yet."
"Husband." Zhang Fei took out some pills and gave them to the four people.
Their grade shocked Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, and Long Yuxi.
"My husband is a god-rank alchemist, and he concocted these pills himself."
"Huh?
Are you kidding us?" Long Yuxi asked in a high voice.

Jiu Tou Sen and Meng Huo also found it difficult to believe, especially after Zhang Fei had previously demonstrated his abilities in the way of the sword, which indicated that he was a god-rank swordmaster.
Even if he possessed exceptional talent and learned both paths simultaneously, he wouldn’t be able to reach the pinnacle of both, yet Guang Zhiyi said that he succeeded in achieving both.
Guang Zhiyi shook her head.
"Do you think I would accept him as my husband if he were an ordinary cultivator, Yuxi?"
"Well?" Long Yuxi scratched her head without being able to refute her.
Zhang Fei took out his Heaven Creation Furnace and some herbs.
"Since you guys doubt my alchemy skills, I’ll show it to you."
After saying that, Zhang Fei prepared all the herbs and heated the furnace.
Ten minutes later, all the herbs were ready, and the furnace had reached the required temperature.
Meng Huo, Jiu Tou Sen, Long Yuxi, and Mo Qingwen watched Zhang Fei perform alchemy seriously.
However, they were puzzled when he tossed all the herbs into the furnace.
Although they were not alchemists, they knew that each herb required different heat and processing, yet he threw them all into the furnace at once.
Guang Zhiyi shook her head.
"Use your senses to see the inside of his furnace."
